seg.abda31761e23.src: Plain answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.
seg.abda31761e23.t: गिरायक आमकां विचारतात तांच्या प्रस्नांक सरळ जापो, घरा हळदीचो पिठो कसो तपासचो हाचे पासून सुरवात.
seg.abda31761e23.back: Straight answers to the questions customers ask us, starting from how to check turmeric powder at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI च्या मानका प्रमाण हळदीच्या पिठ्यांत भायल्यान घाल्लो रंग आसूंक फावना, लेड क्रोमेट धरून, आनी भायलो स्टार्चूय आसूंक फावना. ताच्या तपासणी पुस्तिकेंत इन्स्पेक्टर हळदींत कितें कितें तपासतात तें दिलां: मेटानिल येलो सारके घाल्ले रंग, लेडाचे क्षार, आनी खडूचो पिठो.
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: As per the FSSAI standard, turmeric powder must not have colour added from outside, including lead chromate, and must not have outside starch either. Its testing manual gives what inspectors check in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, salts of lead, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: हातूंतलें कांय तुमी तुमच्या रांदचिकुडींत तपासूं येता, आनी कांय फकत लॅबूच सोदून काडूं शकता. हें मार्गदर्शक दोनूय विशीं सांगता, आनी हळदीक लागू नाशिल्ल्या दोन नामनेच्या चांचण्यां विशींय. तुमी विकतें घेतात त्या खंयच्याय हळदीचेर, आमच्या हळदीचेर लेगीत, त्यो करून पळयात.
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find out. This guide tells about both, and also about two famous tests that do not apply to turmeric. Do them on any turmeric that you buy, even on our turmeric.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: हळदीच्या तपासणी उपरांत उदकाचे दोन पेले. दाव्या वटेन: फिकट हळडुवें उदक, पिठो बुडाक बसला. उजव्या वटेन: गाढ हळडुवें उदक, आनी पिठ्यांतल्यान सकयल देंवपी हळडुवे रेघो.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. On the left side: light yellow water, powder settled at the bottom. On the right side: dark yellow water, and yellow streaks going down from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧उदकाची तपासणी⟦/1⟧दाव्या वटेन: पिठो बुडाक बसला आनी उदक फिकट हळडुवें आसा. उजव्या वटेन: पिठो बुडटना ताचे थावन गाढ हळडुवे रेघो सुटल्यो, आनी उदक गाढ हळडुवें जालें. ताची लॅब चांचणी करपाक जाय.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧On the left side: the powder has settled at the bottom and the water is light yellow. On the right side: as the powder sank, dark yellow streaks came out from it, and the water became dark yellow. A lab test of it should be done.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: एका पेलो उदकाचेर एक ल्हान चमचो हळद शिंपडात आनी ढवळनासतना बसूंक दियात. हळद बुडटा आनी उदक फिकट हळडुवें उरता; उदक रोखडेंच गाढ हळडुवें जालें जाल्यार, तें घाल्ल्या रंगा कडेन बोट दाखयता. ही तपासणी लेड क्रोमेट वा खडू सोदून काडूंक शकना, देखून निश्चीत जापेखातीर फूड टेस्टिंग लॅब वापरात. आयोडीन चांचणी सोडात: हळदींत मुळांतूच स्टार्च आसता.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it sit without stirring. Turmeric sinks and the water stays light yellow; if the water becomes dark yellow immediately, it points a finger towards added colour. This check cannot find out lead chromate or chalk, therefore for a sure answer use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric has starch from the root itself.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: मेटानिल येलो सारके, जे फिकट हळद चड चकचकीत दाखोवंक शकतात. FSSAI हळदींत घाल्ल्या रंगाक परवानगी दिना.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Like metanil yellow, which can make pale turmeric look shinier. FSSAI does not give permission for added colour in turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: लेड क्रोमेट आनी हेर लेडाचे क्षार
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other salts of lead

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड क्रोमेट हो रंगांत (पेंटांत) वापरतात तो एक हळडुवो रंगद्रव्य. 2019 आनी 2024 वर्सा उजवाडाक आयिल्ल्या स्टॅनफर्डाच्या फुडारपणाखालच्या अभ्यासांनी दक्षिण आशियाच्या कांय वाठारांतल्या हळदींत तो मेळ्ळो. FSSAI हळदींत ताका मुळींच परवानगी दिना.
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment which is used in paint. Stanford-led studies brought to light in the years 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from some regions of South Asia. FSSAI does not give it permission in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: वजन वाडोवपी एक स्वस्त धवो पिठो.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: हेर पिकांचें पीठ वा स्टार्च. FSSAI चो मानक ताकाय नाकारता.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. The FSSAI standard rejects this too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: एक पारदर्शक पेलो कुडाच्या तापमानाच्या उदकान भरात.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: वयल्यान एक सपाट ल्हान चमचो हळदीचो पिठो शिंपडात. ढवळूं नाकात.
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: From above sprinkle one level small spoon of turmeric powder. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: पिठो बुडटना पयलें मिनीट लक्ष दवरून पळयात. ताचे थावन सकयल देंवपी रंगीत रेघो आसात काय तें पळयात.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch attentively the first minute while the powder sinks. See whether there are coloured streaks going down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 ते 20 मिनटां तशेंच दवरात. मागीर पेलो धव्या वणटी वा कागदा मुखार धरात आनी बसिल्ल्या पिठ्या वयलें उदक पळयात.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Keep it as it is for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or paper and look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Light yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.back: No sign at all of added colour.

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गाढ हळडुवे रेघो, वा कांय मिनटां भितर गाढ हळडुवें उदक
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Dark yellow streaks, or dark yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: रंग घाल्लो आसूं येता. तो बॅच वापरप बंद करात आनी ताची चांचणी करून घेयात.
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧हें कित्याक चलता.⟦/1⟧ हळदीचो आपलो हळडुवो रंग, करक्युमिन, उदकांत कश्टानूच विरगळटा, देखून पिठो बुडटा आनी उदकाक फकत हलको रंग दिता. मेटानिल येलो सारके रंग सोंपेपणान विरगळटात आनी उदक बेगीन रंगयतात.
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, dissolves in water only with difficulty, therefore the powder sinks and gives the water only a light colour. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧हाका कितें दिसना.⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट आनी खडूय उदकांत विरगळनात, देखून ते मिसळिल्ली हळद ही तपासणी पास करूं येता. ते नात हें फकत लॅब चांचणीच निश्चीत सांगूं शकता.
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this does not see.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, therefore turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. That they are not there, only a lab test can tell for sure.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: भोव बारीक पिठो उदक कांय वेळ गढूळ दवरूं येता. गढूळ जाल्यार हरकत ना; नितळ, गाढ हळडुवें उदक आसा काय तें पळोवंक जाय.
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for some time. If cloudy, no problem; what must be seen is whether the water is clear and dark yellow.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: तपासणी 2: तुमी आख्खी हळद विकतें घेतात जाल्यार
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: सुक्या हळदीचें एक कांडें मदीं मोडात. हळद भितर मेरेन हळडुवी-केसरी आसता, देखून भितरलो भाग भायल्या भागा सारकोच दिसूंक जाय. फिकट वा मंद भितरल्या भागाचेर चकचकीत हळडुवी साल आसल्यार, वयल्यान रंग घाल्लो आसूं येता. विकपी कडेन ताचे विशीं विचारात, वा चांचणी करून घेयात.
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a piece of dry turmeric in the middle. Turmeric is yellow-saffron right to the inside, therefore the inner part should look the same as the outer part. If there is a shiny yellow skin over a pale or dull inner part, colour may have been added from above. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: स्टार्च मेळ्ळो जाल्यार आयोडीन निळो-काळो जाता, आनी हळदींत पीठ सोदून काडपाक ताची चड करून सुचोवणी दितात. पूण हळदींत मुळांतूच स्टार्च आसता, देखून दोनूय वेळार तो निळो-काळो जाता. देखूनच FSSAI ची आपली पुस्तिका आयोडीन चांचणी हळद सोडून हेर पिठो केल्ल्या मसाल्यांखातीर वापरता.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: If it meets starch, iodine becomes blue-black, and it is often advised for finding out flour in turmeric. But turmeric has starch from the root itself, therefore it becomes blue-black both times. That is exactly why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हळदींतलें लेड, मेटानिल येलो आनी खडू हांचेखातीर FSSAI च्या चांचण्यांनी घट्ट हायड्रोक्लोरिक वा सल्फ्युरिक एसिड वापरतात. हे एसिड कातीक आनी दोळ्यांक लासतात. तांची सुवात लॅबांत, रांदचिकुडींत न्हय.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. Their place is in the lab, not in the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL मान्यताय आशिल्ली फूड टेस्टिंग लॅब हळदींत लेड आनी घाल्ले रंग हांची चांचणी करूं शकता. लॅबाक कितलो नमुनो जाय तें विचारात, पिठो ताच्या बंद पॅकांत वा नितळ बंद पिशवेंत दवरात, आनी पॅकाचेर छापिल्लो बॅच नंबर बरोवन दवरात. FSSAI आपल्या वेबसायटीचेर अधिसूचित फूड टेस्टिंग लॅबांची वळेरी उजवाडायता.
seg.1883beca4d73.back: A food testing lab with NABL accreditation can test for lead and added colours in turmeric. Ask how much sample the lab needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or in a clean sealed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI लायसन्स वा रजिस्ट्रेशन नंबर. तो तुमी FSSAI च्या FoSCoS वेबसायटीचेर पळोवंक शकतात.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can see it on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: तो तयार केल्ल्याचें वा पॅक केल्ल्याचें नांव आनी पत्तो.
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: Name and address of the one who made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: निव्वळ प्रमाण, MRP, बॅच वा लॉट नंबर, आनी बेस्ट-बिफोर तारीख.
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: ती खंय पिकयल्या. वेगवेगळ्या वाठारांतल्या हळदीचो रंग वेगळो आसता, देखून वाठाराचें नांव आसल्यार तुमकां सारकेपणान तुळा करूंक मेळटा.
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions has different colour, therefore if the region's name is there you can compare properly.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पॅकाची झीप बंद दवरात, वा पिठो सुक्या, हवाबंद बरणेंत घालात.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or put the powder in a dry, airtight jar.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: सुको चमचो वापरात. ओल्या चमच्याकूच लागून हळदींत गुठळ्यो जातात.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. It is because of a wet spoon that lumps form in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: थेट उज्वाडा पासून पयस दवरात, ताका लागून रंग फिकट जाता.
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep away from direct light, because of which the colour becomes pale.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: भोव चकचकीत हळडुवी हळद ही वायट खुण?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very shiny yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: फकत ताचेवयल्यान न्हय. रंग जातीचेर, ती खंय पिकयल्या ताचेर आनी ती कशी सुकयल्या आनी पिठो केल्या ताचेर बदलता, देखून हळदींनी खूब फरक आसता. पळोवंक जाय तें म्हणजे रंग पिठ्या थावन चड सोंपेपणान सुटटा काय, उदकाच्या तपासणींत दिसता तसो.
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not from that alone. The colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and powdered, therefore there is a lot of difference among turmerics. What to watch is whether colour comes off the powder too easily, as seen in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: हळदींत लेड ना हें उदकाची तपासणी दाखोवंक शकता?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check show that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: ना. लेड क्रोमेट उदकांत विरगळना, देखून उदकाची तपासणी ताका पळोवंक शकना. फकत लॅब चांचणीच तें पळोवंक शकता.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, therefore the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can see it.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: ओलसाण. ओलो चमचो वा उक्तें पॅक पिठ्याक उदक ओडून घेवंक दिता. गुठळ्यो सुक्या चमच्यान फोडात आनी पॅक बंद दवरात.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder pull in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: तपासणींत कितेंय चुकीचें दिसल्यार हांवें कितें करचें?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: If something looks wrong in the check, what should I do?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: तो बॅच वापरप बंद करात, पॅक सांबाळून दवरात, आनी बॅच नंबर सांगून विकप्याक संपर्क करात. तुमी FSSAI च्या Food Safety Connect ॲपांतल्यान ताका कळोवंकूय शकतात. तो आमचो आसल्यार, पॅकाचो आनी पेल्याचो फोटो आमकां WhatsApp करात.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack aside, and contact the seller giving the batch number. You can also inform FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: ह्यो तपासण्यो आमच्या हळदीचेरूय करात. कितेंय चुकीचें दिसल्यार, पॅकाचेरल्या बॅच नंबरा सयत एक फोटो ⟦1⟧आमकां WhatsApp करात⟦/1⟧.
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these checks on our turmeric also. If anything looks wrong, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number on the pack.

seg.7d95509f17be.src: How to check turmeric powder (haldi, pasupu) at home: the water check, what it misses, why the iodine test does not work on turmeric, and when you need a lab.
seg.7d95509f17be.t: घरा हळदीचो पिठो (हल्दी, पसुपु) कसो तपासचो: उदकाची तपासणी, ताका कितें दिसना, आयोडीन चांचणी हळदीक कित्याक लागू जायना, आनी लॅबाची गरज केन्ना पडटा.
seg.7d95509f17be.back: How to check turmeric powder (haldi, pasupu) at home: the water check, what it does not see, why the iodine test does not apply to turmeric, and when a lab is needed.

seg.d25dae4babde.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Andhra Kodi Koora · Andhra's chicken curry

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: कोडी कूरा म्हणजे आयतारा दनपारां आंध्राच्या घरांनी जाता तें कोंबयेचें हुमण: हाडां सयत कोंबी मिरसांग आनी हळदींत मुरयतात, गाढ्या भांगरा रंगाच्या कांद्यां-टोमॅटोच्या ग्रेव्हींत शिजयतात, आनी निमाणें गरम मसालो घालतात. तें ऊन शिता वांगडा जेवणाक येता, आनी उरिल्लें रातीं दोशा वा चपाती वांगडा खातात.
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi koora means that chicken curry which is made in Andhra's homes on Sunday afternoon: chicken with bones is marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked in a deep golden-coloured onion-tomato gravy, and at the end garam masala is added. It comes to the meal with hot rice, and the leftover is eaten at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: हांतूंत तिखटपण आमच्या तेजा मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्यांतल्यान येता, गुंटूरची ती खूब तिखट मिरसांग जी आंध्राच्या हुमणांक तांचो चुरचुरीतपण आनी चकचकीत तांबडो रंग दिता, आनी मुरोवपाच्या मसाल्यांत आमचो हळदीचो पिठो आसा. ही रेसिपी 4 जाणांक आसा आनी चड तिखट आसा; सुचोवण्यांनी ताची तिखटसाण कशी उणी करची तें सांगलां.
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: In this the heat comes from our Teja chilli powder, that very hot chilli of Guntur which gives Andhra curries their pungency and glossy red colour, and in the marinade masala there is our turmeric powder. This recipe is for 4 people and is very hot; the tips tell how to reduce its heat.

seg.6037465ed8d2.src: Total includes 30 minutes for the marinade.
seg.6037465ed8d2.back: In the total time the 30 minutes of marinating are counted.

seg.9cb820880217.src: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in a deep-golden onion and tomato gravy. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
seg.9cb820880217.t: कोंबी दहीं, तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालून मुरयात, मागीर गाढ्या भांगरा रंगाच्या कांद्या-टोमॅटोच्या ग्रेव्हींत शिजयात. निमाणें गरम मसालो आनी कोंथिंबीर घालात.
seg.9cb820880217.back: Marinate the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a deep golden-coloured onion-tomato gravy. At the end add garam masala and coriander leaves.

seg.d35e8cdc661c.src: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.t: 750 g कोंबी ⟦1⟧हाडां सयत, हुमणाखातीर कापिल्ले कुडके, धुवन बरें उदक निथळायिल्ले⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.back: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧with bones, pieces cut for curry, washed and well drained of water⟦/1⟧

seg.c84970cf7b6f.t: ½ कप दहीं ⟦1⟧घट्ट, घुसळून गुळगुळीत केल्लें⟦/1⟧

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.t: 2 ल्हान चमचे तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧खूब तिखट; मध्यम तिखटसाणेखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो वापरात⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.t: 1 ल्हान चमचो मीठ ⟦1⟧निमाणें रुची प्रमाण आनीक⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧more at the end as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.t: 3 व्हड चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧आंध्रांत सादारणपणान शेंगदाण्याचें तेल वापरतात⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra groundnut oil is usually used⟦/1⟧

seg.de3654151f5d.t: 3 लवंग, 2 हिरवे वेलची, 1 इंच दालचिनीचो कुडको ⟦1⟧आखे⟦/1⟧
seg.de3654151f5d.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1 inch piece of cinnamon ⟦1⟧whole⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 कप ऊन उदक ⟦1⟧पातळ ग्रेव्हीखातीर थोडें आनीक⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for thin gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: Also goes well with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: कोंबयेक दहीं, तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो आनी मीठ चोळात. 30 मिनटां दवरात. तुमची कुडी ऊन आसल्यार, आयदन धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt on the chicken. Keep for 30 minutes. If your body is hot, cover the vessel and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: एका जाड आयदनांत वा कढयेंत मध्यम उज्याचेर तेल तापयात. लवंग, वेलची आनी दालचिनी घालात आनी थोडे सेकंद तडतडूंक दियात.
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil in a heavy vessel or kadai on medium flame. Add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon and let them crackle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: कांदे, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो घालात.
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onions, green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: कांदे तेलांत गाढ्या भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर भाजात. मध्यम उज्याचेर हाका 12–15 मिनटां लागतात; सारके ढवळात म्हणजे ते करपनासतना सगळे सारके तांबूस जातले.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onions in the oil until deep golden coloured. On medium flame this takes 12–15 minutes; stir regularly so that they become evenly brown without burning.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: आलें-लसणीचें वाटप घालात, मागीर टोमॅटो, आनी मोव जायसर शिजयात. कच्चो वास वता मेरेन वाटप 1 मिनीट भाजात, मागीर टोमॅटो चेपीत 5–6 मिनटां शिजयात, ते विरगळटात आनी देगेक तेल दिसता मेरेन.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add the ginger-garlic paste, then the tomatoes, and cook until soft. Fry the paste 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes 5–6 minutes while pressing, until they melt and oil appears at the sides.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.t: धण्यांचो पिठो घालून ढवळात आनी 30 सेकंद भाजात.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: कोंबी घालात आनी हाडा लागीं गुलाबी रंग उरना मेरेन मध्यम उज्याचेर धांकून शिजयात. पयलीं 5 मिनटां धांपण नासतना भाजात, कुडके अपारदर्शक जायसर, मागीर ऊन उदक ओतात, धांकात आनी मदीं मदीं ढवळीत सुमार 20 मिनटां शिजयात.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium flame until no pink colour remains near the bone. First fry 5 minutes without a lid, until the pieces become opaque, then pour hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes stirring in between.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: एक जाड कुडको तपासात: हाडा लागीं गुलाबी रंग उरना आनी रस नितळ येता तेन्ना कोंबी शिजल्या. ग्रेव्हीची रुच पळयात आनी गरज आसल्यार मीठ घालात.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Check one thick piece: when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes clear, the chicken is cooked. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: गरम मसालो आनी कोंथिंबीर घालून ढवळात. धांपण नासतना 3 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर उकळूंक दियात, ग्रेव्ही तुमकां जाय तितली घट्ट जायसर आनी वयर तेलाचो तांबडो थर तरंगता मेरेन.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Add garam masala and coriander leaves and stir. Let it simmer 3 minutes on low flame without a lid, until the gravy becomes as thick as you want and a red layer of oil floats on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: उजो बंद करात आनी वाडचे आदीं हुमण 10 मिनटां दवरात; ग्रेव्ही थीर जाता आनी रुच एकठांय येता.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Switch off the flame and keep the curry 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the taste comes together.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: कांदे गाढ्या भांगरा रंगाचे भाजात; ग्रेव्हीचो रंग आनी घट्टसाण तांचेवयल्यानूच येता.
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the onions deep golden coloured; the colour and thickness of the gravy come from them only.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो खूब तिखट आसा. मध्यम हुमणाखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो वापरात, वा तांबडो रंग आनी सौम्य तिखटसाणेखातीर सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour and mild heat use Sannam chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: हाडां सयत कुडके वापरात; हाडांक लागून ग्रेव्हीक खोलाय येता.
seg.57940a63282d.back: Use pieces with bones; because of the bones the gravy gets depth.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: कोंबी घालचे आदीं टोमॅटोच्या मसाल्यांतल्यान तेल वेगळें जावंक दियात, नाजाल्यार ग्रेव्हीची रुच कच्ची लागता.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Before adding the chicken let the oil separate from the tomato masala, otherwise the gravy's taste feels raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: कोब्बरी कोडी कूरा: 3 व्हड चमचे किसल्लें नारळ 1 व्हड चमचो खसखस आनी थोडें उदक घालून वाटात, आनी चड दाट ग्रेव्हीखातीर हें वाटप गरम मसाल्या वांगडा घालून ढवळात.
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari Kodi Koora: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut with 1 tablespoon poppy seeds and a little water, and for a thicker gravy add this paste with the garam masala and stir.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: वाटिल्लो मसालो: 1 व्हड चमचो धणे, 1 ल्हान चमचो बडीशेप, 3 लवंग आनी दालचिनीचो ल्हान कुडको तेल बगर भाजात, वाटात, आनी धण्यांच्या पिठ्या आनी गरम मसाल्या बदला वापरात.
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast without oil 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, 1 teaspoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: प्रेशर कुकर: कोंबी आनी उदक घातल्या उपरांत 2 शिट्टयो काडात आनी प्रेशर आपसूक देंवूंक दियात.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water take 2 whistles and let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: वाफेचेर शिजयिल्ल्या शिता आनी एक चमचो तूप वांगडा ऊन ऊन वाडात, आयतारच्या पद्दतीन. चपाती, दोसो वा नाचणेची संगटि वांगडाय बरें लागता.
seg.8b4376996905.back: Serve hot hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, in the Sunday way. Also tastes good with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: धांकून फ्रिजांत 2 दीस मेरेन दवरात; परत तापयतना भितरलेमेरेन वाफ येता इतलें ऊन करात. दुसऱ्या दिसा हुमणाची रुच आनीक खोल जाता.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days; while reheating make it so hot that steam comes through to the inside. On the next day the curry's taste becomes even deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: आंध्राचें कोंबयेचें हुमण उणें तिखट कशें करचें?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How to make Andhra's chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो उणो करून 1 ल्हान चमचो करात, वा सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात, जो तोच तांबडो रंग सौम्य तिखटसाणेन दिता. निमाणें एक चमचो दहीं घालून ढवळल्यारूय तिखटसाण नरम जाता.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce the Teja chilli powder to 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with mild heat. Stirring in a spoon of curd at the end also softens the heat.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: आंध्राचें कोंबयेचें हुमण इतलें तिखट कित्याक आसता?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra's chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: आंध्राच्या रांदपांत तेजा सारक्यो गुंटूरच्यो मिरसांगो वापरतात, ज्यो हेर चड करून वाठारांच्या हुमणांनी वापरतात त्या मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्यापरस खूब चड तिखट आसतात. तिखटसाण ह्या पदार्थाचो एक भाग.
seg.ada87f188506.back: In Andhra cooking Guntur chillies like Teja are used, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in curries of most other regions. Heat is a part of this dish.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: कोंबी भितरलेमेरेन शिजल्या हें म्हाका कशें कळटलें?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How will I know the chicken is cooked through to the inside?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: हाडा लागसार सगळ्यांत जाड कुडको कापून पळयात. हाडा लागीं गुलाबी रंग उरना आनी रस नितळ येता तेन्ना कोंबी शिजल्या.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut and see the thickest piece near the bone. When no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes clear, the chicken is cooked.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: हांव दहीं बगर कोडी कूरा करूं येता?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can I make kodi koora without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: हय. कोंबी मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो, मीठ आनी 1 व्हड चमचो लिंबाचो रस घालून मुरयात, आनी ग्रेव्हींत आनीक एक टोमॅटो घालात.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Marinate the chicken with chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one more tomato in the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · आंध्र कोडी कूराची रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Koora's recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. आंध्राचें आयतारचें कोंबयेचें हुमण: तेजा मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्यांत आनी हळदीच्या पिठ्यांत मुरयिल्ली कोंबी, गरम मसालो घालून गाढ्या कांद्या-टोमॅटोच्या ग्रेव्हींत शिजयिल्ली.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala added.

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: आंध्र कोडी कूरा: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Koora: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.dd8d5de6151e.t: 3 लवंग, 2 हिरवे वेलची, 1 इंच दालचिनीचो कुडको
seg.dd8d5de6151e.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1 inch piece of cinnamon

seg.72a5211d1fa7.t: बेल्लम पोंगली ⟦1⟧(गोड घालून केल्लो गोड पोंगल)⟦/1⟧
seg.72a5211d1fa7.back: Bellam Pongali ⟦1⟧(sweet pongal made with jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: बेल्लम पोंगली म्हणजे संक्रांतीच्या सकाळीं तेलुगू घरांनी करतात तो गोड पोंगल: तांदूळ आनी भाजिल्ली मुगाची दाळ खूब मोव जायसर शिजयतात, मागीर गोड घालून गोड करतात आनी तूप घालून भरभरीत करतात. परबेच्या जेवणा आदीं तो नैवेद्यम म्हूण दाखयतात, आनी जायत्या देवळांनी आनी शुक्राराच्या पुजांनी तो प्रसादूय आसता.
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali means that sweet pongal which is made in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal are cooked until very soft, then made sweet by adding jaggery and made rich by adding ghee. Before the festival meal it is offered as naivedyam, and in many temples and Friday pujas it is also the prasadam.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: उसाच्या गोडाक लागून ताका फिकट तांबूस रंग आनी टॉफीसारकी भरीव गोडसाण येता, आनी आमच्या जीडिपप्पु पॅकांतले तुपांत तळिल्ले आखे काजू कुरकुरीतपण दितात. ही रेसिपी 4 जाणांक आसा.
seg.17053455adbb.back: Because of the sugarcane jaggery it gets a light brown colour and a toffee-like rich sweetness, and the whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack fried in ghee give crunchiness. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: शिजोवपाचो वेळ प्रेशर कुकराचो; आयदनांत सुमार 15 मिनटां आनीक लागतात.
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is of the pressure cooker; in a vessel it takes about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: भाजिल्ली मुगाची दाळ आनी तांदूळ खूब मोव जायसर शिजयात, वितळायिल्लो उसाचो गोड घालून ढवळात आनी चकचकीत जायसर मंद उज्याचेर उकळूंक दियात. निमाणें तुपांत तळिल्ले काजू, किसमिस आनी वेलची घालात.
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook the roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, add melted sugarcane jaggery, stir and let it simmer on low flame until glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ कप मुगाची दाळ ⟦1⟧सालां बगर पिवळी मुगाची दाळ (पेसरपप्पु), सुमार 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧yellow moong dal without skins (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 कप किसल्लो उसाचो गोड ⟦1⟧हळूच दाबून भरिल्लो, सुमार 150 g; चड गोड जाय जाल्यार थोडो आनीक⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed and filled, about 150 g; a little more if you want it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: एक चिमूट खावपाचो कापूर (पच्चा कर्पूरम) ⟦1⟧जाय जाल्यार; खूब ल्हान चिमूट⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachha karpooram) ⟦1⟧if wanted; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: मुगाची दाळ फिकट भांगरा रंगाची जायसर भाजात, मागीर तांदळा वांगडा खूब मोव आनी लगदो जायसर शिजयात. सुरवेक दाळ प्रेशर कुकरांत वा जाड बुडाच्या आयदनांत मंद उज्याचेर, तेल बगर, ढवळीत भाजात, तिका बियांसारको परमळ येता आनी ती फिकट भांगरा रंगाची जाता मेरेन, सुमार 3–4 मिनटां.
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast the moong dal until light golden coloured, then cook with the rice until very soft and mushy. First roast the dal in the pressure cooker or a heavy-bottomed vessel on low flame, without oil, stirring, until it gets a nut-like aroma and it becomes light golden coloured, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: भाजिल्ल्या दाळींत तांदूळ घालात, दोनूय एकठांय 2–3 फावटीं उदक बदलून धुयात, आनी उदक निथळात.
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together changing the water 2–3 times, and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 कप उदक घालात. मध्यम उज्याचेर 4–5 शिट्टयो काडात आनी प्रेशर आपसूक देंवूंक दियात, वा आयदनांत धांकून 25–30 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात, सुकें जालें जाल्यार थोडें ऊन उदक घालात.
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. On medium flame take 4–5 whistles and let the pressure come down by itself, or cook covered in a vessel 25–30 minutes on low flame, adding a little hot water if it becomes dry.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: उगडात आनी डावाच्या फाटल्या वटेन तांदूळ आनी दाळ हळूच चेपात. तें मोव आनी पेजेसारकें जावंक जाय, सुकें न्हय.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and gently mash the rice and dal with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: गोड ¼ कप उदकांत वितळायात आनी शितांत ओतात. गोड आनी उदक एका ल्हान आयदनांत मंद उज्याचेर ढवळीत फकत विरगळटा मेरेन तापयात, सुमार 2–3 मिनटां; उकळपाची गरज ना.
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour into the rice. Heat the jaggery and water in a small vessel on low flame, stirring, only until it melts, about 2–3 minutes; there is no need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: घट्ट आनी चकचकीत जायसर ढवळीत मंद उज्याचेर उकळूंक दियात, 5–7 मिनटां; 2 व्हड चमचे तूप घालून ढवळात. उजो मंद दवरात आनी बुडामेरेन ढवळीत रावात, कारण गोड घातल्या उपरांत पोंगली बेगीन बुडाक लागता.
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Let it simmer on low flame, stirring, until thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; add 2 tablespoons ghee and stir. Keep the flame low and keep stirring to the bottom, because after adding jaggery the pongali quickly sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: रुच पळयात, आनी चड गोड जाय जाल्यार थोडो आनीक वितळायिल्लो गोड घालून ढवळात.
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want it sweeter add a little more melted jaggery and stir.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: काजू उरिल्ल्या तुपांत तळात; वेलची वांगडा घालात. उरिल्लें 2 व्हड चमचे तूप एका ल्हान आयदनांत मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर तापयात आनी काजू भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर ढवळात, सुमार 1 मिनीट, आनी निमाण्या थोड्या सेकंदांनी किसमिस घालात, ते फुगतात मेरेन.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry the cashews in the remaining ghee; add along with cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee in a small vessel on medium-low flame and stir the cashews until golden coloured, about 1 minute, and in the last few seconds add the raisins, until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: काजू, किसमिस आनी तूप पोंगलीचेर ओतात, वेलचीपिठो आनी, वापरता जाल्यार, कापूर शिंपडात, आनी बरें ढवळात.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and, if using, camphor, and stir well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: उजो बंद करात आनी ऊन वाडात. दवरल्यार पोंगली घट्ट जाता; गरज आसल्यार थोडे चमचे ऊन उदक घालून सैल करात.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Switch off the flame and serve hot. If kept, the pongali becomes thick; if needed loosen it by adding a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: तांदूळ आनी दाळ पुरायपणान मोव शिजयात; गोड घातल्या उपरांत ते आनीक मोव जायनात.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; after adding jaggery they do not become any softer.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: मुगाची दाळ भाजल्यार पोंगलीक बियांसारको परमळ येता; उजो मंद दवरात म्हणजे ती भांगरा रंगाची जातली, तपकिरी न्हय.
seg.c5408f916731.back: If the moong dal is roasted the pongali gets a nut-like aroma; keep the flame low so that it becomes golden coloured, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: जाड बुडाचें आयदन वापरात आनी गोड घातल्या उपरांत ढवळीत रावात; तें बेगीन बुडाक लागून करपता.
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Use a heavy-bottomed vessel and keep stirring after adding jaggery; it quickly sticks to the bottom and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: पोंगली अजून थोडी सैल आसतनाच उज्यावयल्यान काडात; थंड जातना ती घट्ट जाता.
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the flame while it is still a little loose; while cooling it becomes thick.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: ताडाचो गोड: तितलोच किसल्लो ताडाचो गोड वापरात; पोंगली काळसर जातली आनी गोडसाण चड खोल, धुंवरासारकी जातली.
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the pongali will become darker and the sweetness will become deeper, smoke-like.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: चक्केरा पोंगली: गोडा बदला ¾ कप साकर वापरात; फिकट रंगाची, साकरेच्या गोडसाणेची पोंगली जातली.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: instead of jaggery use ¾ cup sugar; it will be a light-coloured pongali with sugar's sweetness.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: संक्रांतीच्या सकाळीं ती नैवेद्यम म्हूण दाखयात, मागीर परबेच्या जेवणा वांगडा पुलिहोरा आनी गारेलु सयत ऊन वाडात.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: On Sankranti morning offer it as naivedyam, then serve hot with the festival meal along with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: उरिल्ली पोंगली धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 दिसां भितर खायात. वाडचे आदीं थोडें ऊन उदक आनी थोडें तूप घालून ढवळीत ऊन करात.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Keep leftover pongali covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving heat it stirring with a little hot water and a little ghee added.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: पोंगली आनी चक्केरा पोंगली हांचेमदीं कितें फरक आसा?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: फकत पोंगली म्हणल्यार चड करून मिरीं आनी जिरें घालून केल्ली खारट पोंगली. चक्केरा पोंगली आनी बेल्लम पोंगली गोड प्रकार, साकर वा गोड घालून करतात.
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: When said just pongali it is mostly the salty pongali made with pepper and cumin added. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are sweet kinds, made by adding sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: हांव बेल्लम पोंगली प्रेशर कुकरांत करूं येता?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: हय. भाजिल्ली दाळ आनी तांदूळ 3 कप उदक घालून 4–5 शिट्टयो काडून शिजयात, प्रेशर आपसूक देंवूंक दियात, मागीर वितळायिल्लो गोड घालून उक्त्या कुकरांत मंद उज्याचेर उकळूंक दियात.
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water taking 4–5 whistles, let the pressure come down by itself, then add melted jaggery and let it simmer in the open cooker on low flame.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: थंड जाल्या उपरांत म्हजी पोंगली घट्ट कित्याक जाली?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become thick after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: थंड जातना पोंगली घट्ट जाता, आनी गोड घातल्या उपरांत चड वेळ उकळल्यार ती आनीक घट्ट जाता. ती अजून थोडी सैल आसतनाच काडात, आनी उरिल्ली पोंगली ऊन उदक घालून सैल करात.
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: While cooling pongali becomes thick, and if it is simmered a long time after adding jaggery it becomes even thicker. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftover pongali by adding hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: हांव पोंगलीखातीर ताडाचो गोड वापरूं येता?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: हय. तितलोच किसल्लो ताडाचो गोड (ताटि बेल्लम) वापरात. पोंगली काळसर जाता आनी तिची रुच चड खोल आनी थोडी धुंवरासारकी लागता.
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The pongali becomes darker and its taste feels deeper and a little smoke-like.

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి. संक्रांतीखातीर बेल्लम पोंगली: तांदूळ आनी भाजिल्ली मुगाची दाळ मोव शिजयिल्ली, उसाच्या गोडान गोड केल्ली आनी तुपांत तळिल्ल्या काजूंनी सजयिल्ली. 4 जाणांक.
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery and decorated with cashews fried in ghee. For 4 people.

seg.5f4a98f6c870.t: बेल्लम पोंगली (गोड घालून केल्लो गोड पोंगल) · 1acrefarms
seg.5f4a98f6c870.back: Bellam Pongali (sweet pongal made with jaggery) · 1acrefarms

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: बेल्लम पोंगली: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(चिंचेचें आंध्राचें नुस्त्याचें हुमण)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(tamarind Andhra fish curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: चेपला पुलुसु म्हणजे दर्यादेगेच्या आंध्राचें चिंचेचें नुस्त्याचें हुमण, गोदावरी जिल्ह्यांनी खास काळजी घेवन करतात: नुस्त्याचे जाड कुडके कांदे, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो घालून आंबट, तांबड्या चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हींत मंद उज्याचेर शिजयतात. हें आयतारच्या दनपारच्या जेवणाचें खाण, आनी जायतीं घरां तें मातयेच्या आयदनांत करतात आनी दुसऱ्या दिसाखातीर दवरतात, तेन्ना ग्रेव्ही नुस्त्यांत भितरमेरेन लागिल्ली आसता.
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu means coastal Andhra's tamarind fish curry, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick pieces of fish are cooked on low flame in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves added. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes make it in a clay vessel and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish to the inside.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: आमचो हळदीचो पिठो मुरोवपाच्या मसाल्यांत आनी ग्रेव्हींत वता. सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो पुलुसुक गाढो तांबडो रंग आनी थीर तिखटसाण दिता, जी चिंचेक तोल दिता. ही रेसिपी 4 जाणांक आसा.
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinating masala and into the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and steady heat, which balances the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: तयारेंत मुरोवपाचीं 15 मिनटां धरल्यांत. थोडे वरां दवरल्या उपरांत हुमणाची रुच आनीक बरी लागता.
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: In the preparation the 15 minutes of marinating are counted. After keeping it a few hours the curry's taste feels even better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: नुस्तें मीठ, हळद आनी मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून मुरयात, कांदे आनी मसालो भाजात, ते चिंचेच्या उदकांत उकळयात, मागीर ढवळनासतना नुस्तें ग्रेव्हींत मंद उज्याचेर शिजूंक दियात.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Marinate the fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry the onions and masala, boil them in tamarind water, then let the fish cook in the gravy on low flame without stirring.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g नुस्त्याचे कुडके ⟦1⟧घट्ट मासाचें नुस्तें, जाड वाटकुळे कुडके कापिल्ले: रोहू (बोचा), कोरमीनु (मरल) वा विसवण (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish, cut into thick round pieces: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g चिंच ⟦1⟧लिंबा इतलो गोळो, 2 कप कोमट उदकांत 15 मिनटां भिजयिल्लो⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ ल्हान चमचो हळदीचो पिठो ⟦1⟧¼ ल्हान चमचो मुरोवपाखातीर, ¼ ल्हान चमचो ग्रेव्हीखातीर⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for marinating, ¼ teaspoon for gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 व्हड चमचे सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧1 ल्हान चमचो मुरोवपाखातीर, उरिल्लो ग्रेव्हीखातीर⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for marinating, remaining for gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 ल्हान चमचो मीठ ⟦1⟧ग्रेव्हीखातीर, वा रुची प्रमाण⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for gravy, or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: Also goes well with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: नुस्त्याचे कुडके उदकांत दोन-तीन फावटीं हळूच धुयात आनी उदक बरें निथळात.
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Gently wash the fish pieces in water two-three times and drain the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: नुस्त्याक मीठ, हळद आनी 1 ल्हान चमचो मिरसांगेचो पिठो चोळात; 15 मिनटां दवरात. मुरोवपाखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो मीठ आनी ¼ ल्हान चमचो हळदीचो पिठो वापरात.
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder on the fish; keep for 15 minutes. For marinating use 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: भिजयिल्ली चिंच तिच्याच उदकांत बरी पिळात आनी गाळात. तुमचेकडेन सुमार 2 कप पातळ चिंचेचें उदक जावंक जाय.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its own water and strain. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: एका रुंद आयदनांत वा मातयेच्या आयदनांत मध्यम उज्याचेर तेल तापयात. मेथयो, सांसव आनी जिरें घालात आनी तडतडूंक दियात, मेथयो काळ्यो जावंक नाकात हाची काळजी घेयात.
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat oil in a wide vessel or clay vessel on medium flame. Add fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin and let them crackle, taking care that the fenugreek seeds do not become black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: कांदे, मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो तेलांत मोव जायसर भाजात; मसाल्याचे पिठे घालात. कांदे सुमार 6–8 मिनटां भाजात, ते मोव आनी फिकट भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर, आलें-लसणीचें वाटप आनी टोमॅटो घालून 2 मिनटां शिजयात, मागीर उरिल्लो हळदीचो पिठो, उरिल्लो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी धण्यांचो पिठो घालून 30 सेकंद ढवळात.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes, until they are soft and light golden coloured, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: चिंचेचें उदक ओतात आनी तेल वयर येता मेरेन 10 मिनटां उकळयात. ग्रेव्हीखातीर मीठ घालात; चिंचेचो कच्चो वास गेल्लो आसूंक जाय आनी ग्रेव्ही थोडी घट्ट जावंक जाय.
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Pour the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until the oil comes up. Add salt for the gravy; the raw smell of tamarind should have gone and the gravy should become a little thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: ग्रेव्हीची रुच पळयात. ती स्पश्टपणान आंबट, खारट आनी तिखट जावंक जाय, कारण उपरांत घालपाचें नुस्तें तिचो थोडो भाग शोशून घेवपाचें आसा.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish to be added later is going to soak up some part of it.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: नुस्तें हळूच भितर सोडात आनी धांकून 10–12 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर शिजूंक दियात; आयदन घुंवडायात, ढवळूं नाकात. कुडके एकाच थरांत मांडात, तांचेर चमच्यान ग्रेव्ही ओतात आनी उजो मंद दवरात.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Gently slide in the fish and let it cook covered 10–12 minutes on low flame; swirl the vessel, do not stir. Arrange the pieces in a single layer, pour gravy over them with a spoon and keep the flame low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: एक कुडको ताच्या सगळ्यांत जाड भागाक तपासात: मास भितरमेरेन धवें वा अपारदर्शक जाता आनी हाडावयल्यान सहज सुटता तेन्ना नुस्तें शिजलां.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check one piece at its thickest part: when the flesh becomes white or opaque through to the inside and comes off the bone easily, the fish is cooked.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: कोंथिंबीर शिंपडात, उजो बंद करात आनी वाडचे आदीं पुलुसु धांकून उण्यांत उणीं 30 मिनटां दवरात.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle coriander leaves, switch off the flame and keep the pulusu covered at least 30 minutes before serving.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: ढवळचे बदला आयदन घुंवडायात म्हणजे नुस्तें आखें उरतलें.
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Instead of stirring swirl the vessel so that the fish will remain whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: जाड कुडक्यांचें घट्ट मासाचें नुस्तें वेंचात; पातळ फिले चड वेळ शिजयल्यार मोडटात.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose firm-fleshed fish of thick pieces; thin fillets break if cooked a long time.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो मध्यम तिखटसाण दिता. सौम्य पुलुसुखातीर 1½ व्हड चमचो वापरात, वा आंध्राच्या सादारण तिखटसाणेखातीर पुराय 2 व्हड चमचे.
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a mild pulusu use 1½ tablespoons, or for Andhra's usual heat the full 2 tablespoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: नुस्तें घालचे आदीं चिंचेची ग्रेव्ही बरी उकळयात; नुस्तें घातल्या उपरांत तें मोडनासतना चड वेळ शिजोवंक जायना.
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; after adding the fish it cannot be cooked long without it breaking.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो: चड तिखट पुलुसुखातीर ग्रेव्हींत सन्नमा बदला 1 व्हड चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात. तेजा खूब तिखट आसा; खात्री नासल्यार 2 ल्हान चमच्यांनी सुरवात करात.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu use 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if not sure start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: रोय्याला पुलुसु: 400 g निवळ केल्लीं सुंगटां वापरात आनी फकत 5–6 मिनटां शिजयात, तीं गुलाबी जावन वळटात मेरेन.
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and cook only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: मामिडिकाया पुलुसु: गिमांत गोदावरीचीं घरां तोरांचे कुडके घालतात आनी चिंच उणी वापरतात.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer Godavari's homes add raw mango pieces and use less tamarind.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: ऊन वाफेच्या शिता आनी कापिल्ल्या कांद्यां वांगडा वाडात. गोदावरीचीं जायतीं घरां तें दुसऱ्या दिसा वाडटात, तेन्ना रुची थीर जाल्ल्यो आसतात.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and cut onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: उरिल्लें हुमण धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 दिसां भितर खायात. आयदनांत ढवळनासतना हळूच परत ऊन करात.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Keep the leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Gently reheat in a vessel without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: चेपला पुलुसुखातीर खंयचें नुस्तें सगळ्यांत बरें?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: न्हंयचें वा दर्यांतलें घट्ट मासाचें नुस्तें, जाड कुडके कापिल्लें: रोहू (बोचा), मरल (कोरमीनु), कतला वा विसवण. काट्यांचीं ल्हान नुस्तींय चलतात, पूण तीं हळूच हाताळूंक जाय.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: River or sea firm-fleshed fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Small fish with bones also work, but they must be handled gently.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: चेपला पुलुसुची रुच दुसऱ्या दिसा बरी कित्याक लागता?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu's taste feel better the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: दवरल्यार नुस्त्याक चिंच आनी मिरसांगेची ग्रेव्ही शोशून घेवपाक वेळ मेळटा, आनी आंबटसाण आनी तिखटसाण सारकी जाता. देखून जायतीं घरां तें सकाळीं करतात, रातच्या जेवणाखातीर वा दुसऱ्या दिसाखातीर.
seg.566bd302c316.back: If kept, the fish gets time to absorb the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat become even. That is why many homes make it in the morning, for the night meal or for the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: हुमणांत नुस्तें मोडचें न्हय म्हणून कितें करचें?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: What to do so that the fish does not break in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: जाड कुडके वापरात, ग्रेव्ही उकळल्या उपरांतूच घालात, उजो मंद दवरात आनी चमच्यान ढवळचे बदला आयदन घुंवडायात.
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Use thick pieces, add only after the gravy has boiled, keep the flame low and swirl the vessel instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: सुमार 40 g, लिंबा इतलो गोळो, 2 कप कोमट उदकांत भिजयिल्लो. टोमॅटो वा तोर घालता जाल्यार थोडी उणी वापरात.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups lukewarm water. If adding tomato or raw mango use a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: చేపల పులుసు · आंध्राच्या नुस्त्याच्या हुमणाची रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra fish curry's recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: చేపల పులుసు. गोदावरी पद्दतीचें नुस्त्याचें हुमण: कांदे, आमची हळद आनी सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून आंबट-चुरचुरीत चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हींत शिजयिल्लें नुस्तें. 4 जाणांक, सुचोवण्यो आनी प्रस्न-जाप सयत.
seg.03c44db05afe.back: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish cooked in a sour-pungent tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder added. For 4 people, with tips and questions-answers.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु (चिंचेचें आंध्राचें नुस्त्याचें हुमण) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (tamarind Andhra fish curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: गोंगुरा मामसम म्हणजे गोंगुरा घालून शिजयिल्लें मटण; गोंगुरा म्हणजे तें आंबट पान जें आंध्र, आनी चड करून गुंटूर, आपलें मानता. मटण मिरसांग आनी हळद घालून मोव शिजयतात, मागीर भाजून भाजून काळसर, आंबट-चुरचुरीत वाटप जाल्ल्या गोंगुरा वांगडा, हुमण घट्ट जाता आनी तेल वयर येता मेरेन, मंद उज्याचेर शिजयतात.
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam means mutton cooked with gongura added; gongura means that sour leaf which Andhra, and especially Guntur, considers its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric added, then with gongura that has become a dark, sour-pungent paste by frying and frying, it is cooked on low flame until the curry becomes thick and oil comes up.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: गोंगुराच्या तीख आंबटसाणेक तोंड दिवपाक जोरदार तिखटसाण जाय, आनी ती आमच्या तेजा मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्यांतल्यान, गुंटूरच्या खूब तिखट मिरसांगेंतल्यान, येता, वांगडा आमचो हळदीचो पिठो. शिता वांगडा 4 जाणांक.
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To face gongura's sharp sourness strong heat is needed, and it comes from our Teja chilli powder, from Guntur's very hot chilli, along with our turmeric powder. With rice for 4 people.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: मटण तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो आनी आलें-लसणीचें वाटप घालून प्रेशर कुकरांत शिजयात, मागीर कांद्याचो मसालो आनी भाजिल्लीं गोंगुराचीं पानां घालून घट्ट जायसर आनी वयर तेल तरंगता मेरेन मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात.
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste added, then add the onion masala and fried gongura leaves and cook on low flame until thick and until oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g मटण ⟦1⟧हाडां सयत हुमणाखातीर कापिल्लें, धुवन उदक निथळायिल्लें⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧with bones cut for curry, washed and water drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 कप गोंगुराचीं पानां ⟦1⟧सुमार 2 जुडयो (150 g), देंठांवयल्यान काडिल्लीं, धुवन बरें उदक निथळायिल्लीं⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), removed from the stems, washed and well drained of water⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 व्हड चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧सादारणपणान शेंगदाण्याचें तेल वापरतात⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.back: 4 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: मटण प्रेशर कुकरांत घालात, वांगडा तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो, आलें-लसणीचें वाटप आनी मीठ, बरें मिसळात आनी 15 मिनटां दवरात.
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the mutton in the pressure cooker, along with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and keep for 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: मटण तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळद, आलें-लसणीचें वाटप, मीठ आनी उदक घालून प्रेशर कुकरांत शिजयात. 1½ कप उदक घालात आनी मध्यम उज्याचेर 5–6 शिट्टयो काडात, मागीर प्रेशर आपसूक देंवूंक दियात.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the mutton in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water added. Add 1½ cups water and on medium flame take 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: कुकर उगडात आनी एक कुडको तपासात: मटण मोव जाता आनी चमच्यान हाडावयल्यान सहज सुटता तेन्ना तें शिजलां. ना जाल्यार, आनीक 1–2 शिट्टयो काडात.
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and check one piece: when the mutton becomes soft and comes off the bone easily with a spoon, it is cooked. If not, take 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: मटण शिजता तितले भितर, एका आयदनांत मध्यम उज्याचेर 1 व्हड चमचो तेल तापयात.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the mutton cooks, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a vessel on medium flame.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: गोंगुरा हिरव्यो मिरसांगो घालून थोड्या तेलांत भाजात, तें विरगळून काळसर वाटप जायसर. हाका 8–10 मिनटां लागतात; सारके ढवळात आनी पानां सुकतात तशें चमच्याच्या फाटल्या वटेन चेपात.
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with green chillies in a little oil, until it melts and becomes a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir regularly and press with the back of the spoon as the leaves wilt.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: एका जाड कढयेंत मध्यम उज्याचेर 4 व्हड चमचे तेल तापयात आनी लवंग, वेलची आनी दालचिनी घालात.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 tablespoons oil in a heavy kadai on medium flame and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: कांदे आख्या मसाल्यां वांगडा भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर भाजात. कांद्यां वांगडा कडिपत्तो घालात, आनी सारके ढवळीत 10–12 मिनटां दियात.
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onions with the whole spices until golden coloured. Add curry leaves with the onions, and give 10–12 minutes stirring regularly.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: धण्यांचो पिठो घालून ढवळात आनी 30 सेकंद भाजात. मटण आनी ताचें सार घालात, मागीर गोंगुरा.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its juice, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: घट्ट जायसर आनी वयर तेल तरंगता मेरेन मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात. उजो मंद दवरात, मदीं मदीं ढवळात, आनी 12–15 मिनटां दियात. गोंगुराची आंबटसाण मिसळल्या उपरांत आतां रुच पळोवन मीठ सारकें करात.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Cook on low flame until thick and until oil floats on top. Keep the flame low, stir in between, and give 12–15 minutes. After gongura's sourness has mixed, now taste and adjust the salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: गरम मसालो घालून ढवळात. आनीक 2 मिनटां शिजयात, मागीर उजो बंद करात आनी वाडचे आदीं 10 मिनटां दवरात.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Add garam masala and stir. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off the flame and keep 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: गोंगुरा घातल्या उपरांत रुच पळयात; तिची आंबटसाण दर जुडयेक वेगळी आसता.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding gongura; its sourness is different for every bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो खूब तिखट आसा. मध्यम तिखटसाणेखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो वापरात, वा सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो; तो पुरायपणान काडूं नाकात, नाजाल्यार गोंगुरा फिकें आनी फकत आंबट लागता.
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; do not remove it fully, otherwise the gongura tastes bland and only sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: गोंगुराखातीर ॲल्युमिनियमाचें आयदन वापरूं नाकात; तिची आंबटसाण धातू वांगडा प्रक्रिया करून हुमण काळसर करता. स्टील वा ओताव लोखणाचें आयदन वापरात.
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium vessel for gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and makes the curry dark. Use a steel or cast iron vessel.
