seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: गोंगुरा खूब आंबट आसल्यार, तोल सांबाळपाक मसाल्यांत आनीक 1 कांदो घालात.
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, to maintain balance add 1 more onion in the masala.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: गोंगुरा कोंबी: 750 g हाडां सयत कोंबी वापरात, प्रेशर कुकर नाका, आनी गोंगुरा घालचे आदीं ती मसाल्यांत धांकून 20–25 मिनटां शिजयात, हाडा लागीं गुलाबी रंग उरना मेरेन.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: use 750 g chicken with bones, no pressure cooker, and before adding gongura cook it covered in the masala 20–25 minutes, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: 500 g निवळ केल्लीं सुंगटां वापरात, कांद्यां उपरांत घालात आनी 5–6 मिनटां शिजयात, फकत तीं गुलाबी जावन वळटात मेरेन, मागीर गोंगुरा घालात.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, only until they turn pink and curl, then add gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: तांबडी मिरसांग गोंगुरा: 6 सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो गोंगुरा वांगडा भाजात आनी एकठांय वाटात; हुमण चड काळसर आनी तीख जातलें.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dry red chillies with the gongura and grind together; the curry will become darker and sharper.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: ऊन वाफेच्या शिता आनी एक चमचो तूप वांगडा वाडात, वा जोन्ना रोट्टे (जोंधळ्याची भाकरी) वांगडा. कुशीक एक सादो कच्चो कांदो, ही गुंटूरची पद्दत.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte (jowar bhakri). A plain raw onion on the side, this is Guntur's way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: धांकून फ्रिजांत 3 दीस मेरेन दवरात; परत तापयतना भितरलेमेरेन वाफ येता इतलें ऊन करात. चड करून आंबट हुमणां भशेन, दुसऱ्या दिसा तें आनीक बरें लागता.
seg.a4e072616940.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 3 days; while reheating make it so hot that steam comes through to the inside. Like most sour curries, it tastes even better the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: गोंगुराक इंग्लीशींत सॉरेल (sorrel) म्हणटात, ताका रोझेल वा रेड सॉरेल अशेंय म्हणटात (मराठींत अंबाडी, हिंदींत पितवा). पानां आंबट आसतात आनी शिजून काळसर वाटप जातात.
seg.50430ec58f61.back: In English gongura is called sorrel (sorrel), it is also called roselle or red sorrel (in Marathi ambadi, in Hindi pitwa). The leaves are sour and on cooking become a dark paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: हांव गोंगुराच्या पानां बदला गोंगुराचें लोणचें वापरूं येता?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: हय, गरज पडल्यार. भाजिल्ल्या पानां बदला 3–4 व्हड चमचे गोंगुराचें लोणचें घालून ढवळात आनी मीठ आनी मिरसांगेचो पिठो उणो करात, कारण लोणच्यांत दोनूय आदींच आसतात.
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, if needed. Instead of the fried leaves add 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and stir and reduce the salt and chilli powder, because the pickle already has both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: गोंगुरा मामसमाखातीर मटण प्रेशर कुकरांत कितलो वेळ शिजोवंक जाय?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long should mutton be cooked in the pressure cooker for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: हाडां सयत हुमणाखातीर कापिल्ल्या मटणाक मध्यम उज्याचेर सुमार 5–6 शिट्टयो. मास हाडावयल्यान सहज सुटता तेन्ना तें शिजलां; पिराय जाल्ल्या बोकडाच्या मटणाक आनीक 1–2 शिट्टयो लागूं येतात.
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For mutton cut with bones for curry about 5–6 whistles on medium flame. When the meat comes off the bone easily, it is cooked; mutton of an aged goat may need 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: गोंगुरा मटण उणें तिखट कशें करचें?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How to make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 ल्हान चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात वा ताचे बदला सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालात, आनी 2 हिरव्यो मिरसांगो वापरात. थोडी तिखटसाण दवरात, कारण ती गोंगुराच्या आंबटसाणेक तोल दिता.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or add Sannam chilli powder instead of it, and use 2 green chillies. Keep a little heat, because it balances gongura's sourness.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: గోంగూర మాంసం. गुंटूर पद्दतीचें गोंगुरा मटण: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी हळदीचो पिठो घालून शिजयिल्लें मटण, मागीर आंबट गोंगुराच्या पानां वांगडा घट्ट जायसर मंद उज्याचेर शिजयिल्लें.
seg.df5186f8f459.back: గోంగూర మాంసం. Guntur-style gongura mutton: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder added, then cooked on low flame with sour gongura leaves until thick.

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: गोंगुरा मामसम: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी म्हणजे ती चटणी जिचे खातीर आंध्र सगळ्यांत चड नामनेचो: आंबट गोंगुराचीं (अंबाडीचीं) पानां तेलांत विरगळटात मेरेन भाजतात आनी भाजिल्ले मसाले, लसूण आनी तांबडी मिरसांग घालून वाटतात. गुंटूर आनी पल्नाडु वाठारांत ती जवळ जवळ दर दिसा जेवणांत आसता, ऊन शितांत एक चमचो तूप घालून मिसळून, कुशीक कापिल्लो कांदो.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi means that chutney for which Andhra is most famous: sour gongura (ambadi) leaves are fried in oil until they melt and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli added. In the Guntur and Palnadu regions it is in the meal almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee added, cut onion on the side.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो तिका गाढो तांबडो रंग आनी ती तीख तिखटसाण दिता जी पानांच्या आंबटसाणेक तोंड दिता. ह्या रेसिपीन सुमार 1½ कप जाता, 6 जाणांक पुरो.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that sharp heat which faces the leaves' sourness. With this recipe about 1½ cups are made, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: एकूण वेळांत वाटचे आदीं पानां आनी मसाले थंड करपाचो वेळ धरला.
seg.1689d390a49e.back: In the total time the time to cool the leaves and spices before grinding is counted.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: गोंगुराचीं पानां तेलांत भाजात, तांचें काळसर भरीत जायसर, मागीर भाजिल्ले धणे, मेथयो, लसूण, तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालून वाटात. निमाणें सांसव आनी दाळीची फोडणी दियात.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry the gongura leaves in oil, until they become a dark bharta, then grind with roasted coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt added. At the end give a tempering of mustard seeds and dals.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 कप गोंगुराचीं पानां ⟦1⟧2 व्हड जुडयांतल्यान काडिल्लीं, सुमार 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧removed from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 व्हड चमचो तिळाचें तेल ⟦1⟧जिंजली तेल, पानां भाजपाक⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, to fry the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ ल्हान चमचो मेथयो ⟦1⟧मेंतुलु; हाचेपरस चड न्हय, नाजाल्यार पच्चडी कडू जाता⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 ल्हान चमचे तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧खूब तिखट; सौम्य पच्चडीखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो वापरात⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a mild pachadi use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.7e344ce94138.t: ¾ ल्हान चमचो मीठ ⟦1⟧वा रुची प्रमाण⟦/1⟧
seg.7e344ce94138.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: गोंगुराचीं पानां देंठांवयल्यान काडात आनी 2–3 फावटीं उदक बदलून धुयात. तीं कपड्यार पातळायात आनी पुरायपणान सुकीं जायसर थापटात; पानांचेर उरिल्लें उदक तेलांत उडटा आनी पच्चडी उरपाचो वेळ उणो करता.
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Remove the gongura leaves from the stems and wash changing the water 2–3 times. Spread them on a cloth and pat until fully dry; water remaining on the leaves splatters in the oil and reduces the pachadi's keeping time.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: धणे, जिरें आनी मेथयो परमळ येता मेरेन भाजात; थंड जावंक दियात. मंद उज्याचेर सुकें आयदन वापरात आनी सारकें ढवळीत रावात: मेथयो एक छटा काळसर जावंक जाय, सुमार 2 मिनटां, पूण तपकिरी न्हय.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander seeds, cumin and fenugreek seeds until aroma comes; let them cool. Use a dry vessel on low flame and keep stirring evenly: the fenugreek seeds should become one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: गोंगुराचीं पानां 1 व्हड चमचो तेलांत भाजात, तीं सुकून काळसर भरीत जायसर, 6–8 मिनटां. मध्यम उज्याचेर रुंद आयदन वापरात आनी सारकें ढवळात; पानां बेगीन आकुंचतात, पाचव्या रंगाचीं थावन फिकट ऑलिव्ह-तपकिरी जातात, आनी तांचें जवळ जवळ सगळें उदक आटता.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil, until they wilt and become a dark bharta, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide vessel on medium flame and stir evenly; the leaves shrink quickly, turn from green to light olive-brown, and almost all their water dries up.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: पानां एका ताटांत पातळायात आनी पुरायपणान थंड जावंक दियात, सुमार 10 मिनटां.
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool fully, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: मसाले लसूण, मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालून वाटात, मागीर पानां घालून थोडें थोडें चलयात. पयलीं भाजिल्ले मसाले, 6 लसणीच्यो पाकळ्यो, तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ जाडसर पिठो जायसर वाटात.
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt added, then add the leaves and pulse little by little. First grind the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt until a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: थंड जाल्लीं पानां घालात आनी उदक बगर 3–4 फावटीं चलोवन जाडसर वाटप करात. आंध्राचीं जायतीं घरां ताचे बदला तें फातराच्या उखळांत (रोलु) कुटटात.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and without water pulse 3–4 times to make a coarse paste. Many homes of Andhra instead pound it in a stone mortar (rolu).

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: रुच पळयात: ती आंबट, तिखट आनी बरी खारट जावंक जाय. आंबटसाण चड तीख दिसल्यार आनीक एक चिमूट मीठ घालात.
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salty. If the sourness seems too sharp add one more pinch of salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: उरिल्ल्या तेलांत सांसव, दाळी, तांबड्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्त्याची फोडणी करात; मिसळात. एका ल्हान आयदनांत 2 व्हड चमचे तिळाचें तेल तापयात, सांसव तडतडूंक दियात, चण्याची दाळ आनी उडदाची दाळ भांगरा रंगाची जायसर भाजात, मागीर तांबड्यो मिरसांगो, ठेंचिल्लें लसूण, कडिपत्तो आनी हिंग थोड्या सेकंदांखातीर घालात. ही फोडणी पच्चडीचेर ओतात आनी बरी ढवळात.
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: In the remaining oil make a tempering of mustard seeds, dals, red chillies and curry leaves; mix. Heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil in a small vessel, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal until golden coloured, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour this tempering over the pachadi and stir well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: शक्य आसल्यार पच्चडी 30 मिनटां दवरात, म्हणजे रुची एकठांय येतल्यो, मागीर ती एका निवळ, सुक्या काचेच्या बरणेंत भरात.
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible keep the pachadi 30 minutes, so the flavours will come together, then fill it in a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: भाजचे आदीं पानां पुरायपणान सुकयात म्हणजे पच्चडी चड दीस उरतली.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi will keep more days.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो खूब तिखट आसा. सौम्य पच्चडीखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो वापरात, वा अर्दो तेजा आनी अर्दो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो.
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a mild pachadi use 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: मेथयो ¼ ल्हान चमचोच दवरात आनी फकत एक छटा काळसर भाजात; चड घातल्यार, वा चड काळसर भाजल्यार, पच्चडी कडू जाता.
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep the fenugreek seeds at ¼ teaspoon only and roast only one shade darker; if too much is added, or roasted too dark, the pachadi becomes bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: थोडें थोडें चलयात, बारीक वाटूं नाकात: गोंगुरा पच्चडी जाडसर जावंक जाय, पानांचे कुडके दिसपाक जाय.
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse little by little, do not grind fine: gongura pachadi should be coarse, the pieces of leaves should be visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: तेलांत काटकसर करूं नाकात; वयल्या तेलाच्या थराक लागून पच्चडी चड उरता.
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not economise on oil; because of the oil layer on top the pachadi keeps longer.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: कांद्या वांगडा: वाडचे पयलीं एका वांट्यांत 1 ल्हान कांदो, बारीक कापिल्लो, घालून ढवळात, आनी ती त्याच दिसा खायात.
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: before serving add 1 small onion, finely cut, into a portion and stir, and eat it the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: आख्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो: मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्या बदला 12–15 सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो थोड्या तेलांत भाजात आनी मसाल्यां वांगडा वाटात.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dry red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: हिरवी मिरसांग गोंगुरा: 6–8 हिरव्यो मिरसांगो पानां वांगडा भाजात आनी मिरसांगेचो पिठो उणो करून 1 ल्हान चमचो करात; तिखटसाण चड तीख आनी हिरवी जातली.
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and reduce the chilli powder to 1 teaspoon; the heat will become sharper and green.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: एक चमचो ऊन शितांत तूप घालून मिसळात आनी कुशीक कापिल्ल्या कच्च्या कांद्या वांगडा खायात. दोसो, इडली वांगडाय आनी खंयच्याय आंध्राच्या जेवणाच्या ताटांत कुशीक ती बरी लागता.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix one spoon into hot rice with ghee added and eat with cut raw onion on the side. It also tastes good with dosa, idli and on the side in any Andhra meal plate.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: एका निवळ, सुक्या काचेच्या बरणेंत फ्रिजांत 2 हप्ते मेरेन दवरात, सदांच सुको चमचो वापरात. वयर तेलाचो पातळ थर आसल्यार ती चड उरता.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, always use a dry spoon. If there is a thin layer of oil on top it keeps longer.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: गोंगुरा म्हणजे रोझेल (roselle) झाडाचें पान, जें चड करून सॉरेल पानां वा रेड सॉरेल ह्या नांवान विकतात. हिंदी आनी मराठी उलोवपी वाठारांनी ताका अंबाडी म्हणटात.
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura means the leaf of the roselle (roselle) plant, which is mostly sold by the names sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi and Marathi speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी उणी आंबट कशी करची?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How to make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: थोडें आनीक मीठ आनी मिरसांग घालात, वा 1 ल्हान चमचो किसल्लो गोड घालून ढवळात. पानां बरीं भाजल्यारूय तांची आंबटसाण नरम जाता.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or add 1 teaspoon grated jaggery and stir. If the leaves are fried well their sourness also softens.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: म्हजी गोंगुरा पच्चडी कडू कित्याक जाली?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why did my gongura pachadi become bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: चड करून मेथयो चड घातल्यो, वा चड काळसर भाजल्यो म्हणून. त्यो ¼ ल्हान चमचोच दवरात आनी एक छटा काळसर जातकच भाजप बंद करात.
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Mostly because too much fenugreek was added, or it was roasted too dark. Keep it at ¼ teaspoon only and stop roasting as soon as it becomes one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How many days does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: सुक्या काचेच्या बरणेंत फ्रिजांत सुमार 2 हप्ते, पानां बरीं सुकयल्लीं आसल्यार आनी तुमी सदांच सुको चमचो वापरल्यार. फ्रिजा भायर, 2–3 दिसां भितर खायात.
seg.693b158b80df.back: In a dry glass jar in the fridge about 2 weeks, if the leaves were dried well and if you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat within 2–3 days.

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. गुंटूर पद्दतीची गोंगुरा पच्चडी: अंबाडीचीं पानां भाजून, भाजिल्ले मसाले, लसूण आनी तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून वाटिल्लीं, मागीर फोडणी दिल्ली. 6 जाणांक.
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Guntur-style gongura pachadi: ambadi leaves fried, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder added, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हींत आंध्राचें तांत्यांचें हुमण)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra's egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु म्हणजे आंध्राचें तांत्यांचें हुमण, जें जायतीं घरां घरांत मास नासतना करतात: उकडिल्लीं तांतीं चिंच आनी हळूहळू भाजिल्ल्या कांद्यांच्या आंबट-चुरचुरीत ग्रेव्हींत मंद उज्याचेर शिजयतात. तें उत्तर भारताच्या तांत्यांच्या हुमणापरस पातळ आनी चड आंबट आसता, आनी खूब ऊन शितांत मिसळून खावपाखातीर करतात.
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu means Andhra's egg curry, which many homes make when there is no meat in the house: boiled eggs are cooked on low flame in a sour-pungent gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onions. It is thinner and more sour than north India's egg curry, and is made for eating mixed into very hot rice.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: आमचो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो पुलुसुक तांबडो रंग आनी थीर मध्यम तिखटसाण दिता, आनी आमचो हळदीचो पिठो (पसुपु) भांगरा रंगाचो आदार दिता. थोडो गोड आंबटसाणेक तोल दिता.
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden-coloured base. A little jaggery balances the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: तांतीं उकडात आनी चिरे मारात. कांदे भाजात, हळद, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी चिंचेचें उदक घालात, मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात, मागीर ग्रेव्ही घट्ट जायसर तांतीं तातूंत शिजयात.
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and make slits. Fry the onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, cook on low flame, then cook the eggs in it until the gravy becomes thick.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.t: एक चिमूट हळदीचो पिठो ⟦1⟧तांतीं भाजपाक (जाय जाल्यार)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: A pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧to fry the eggs (if wanted)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g चिंच ⟦1⟧लिंबा इतलो गोळो, 1½ कप कोमट उदकांत भिजयिल्लो⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 व्हड चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧शेंगदाण्याचें वा तिळाचें तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 ल्हान चमचे सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧मध्यम तिखटसाण; सौम्य जाय जाल्यार 1½ ल्हान चमचो वापरात⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; if you want mild use 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: चिंच कोमट उदकांत 15 मिनटां भिजयात. बरी पिळात, गाळात आनी चिंचेचें उदक दवरात; धागे आनी बियो उडयात.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in lukewarm water 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away the fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: तांतीं 10 मिनटां उकडात, सालीं काडात आनी दरेकाचेर 3–4 उथळ चिरे मारात. तीं कुडाच्या तापमानाच्या उदकांत घालून सुरवात करात, उकळ आयल्या उपरांत 10 मिनटां मेजात, मागीर सालीं काडचे आदीं उदकांत थंड करात. बलक भितरमेरेन घट्ट आनी फिकट पिवळो जावंक जाय.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, remove the shells and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start by putting them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes after the boil comes, then cool in water before removing the shells. The yolk should be firm through to the inside and light yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: जाय जाल्यार: 1 ल्हान चमचो तेल एक चिमूट हळदी वांगडा तापयात आनी तांतीं तातूंत 2 मिनटां घुंवडायात, तांचेर हळूच फोड येतात मेरेन. बाजूक दवरात.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: If wanted: heat 1 teaspoon oil with a pinch of turmeric and swirl the eggs in it 2 minutes, until blisters gently come on them. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: उरिल्लें तेल कढयेंत मध्यम उज्याचेर तापयात. मेथयो घालात आनी त्यो फिकट तपकिरी जावंक दियात; काळ्यो जाल्यार त्यो कडू जातात.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in the kadai on medium flame. Add fenugreek seeds and let them become light brown; if they become black they become bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: सांसव, कडिपत्तो आनी कांदे तेलांत मोव आनी भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर भाजात. पयलीं सांसव घालात आनी तडतडूंक दियात, मागीर कडिपत्तो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी हिंग, मागीर कांदे सुमार 8 मिनटां.
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil until soft and golden coloured. First add the mustard seeds and let them crackle, then curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: उजो मंद करात. हळद, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालात, मागीर चिंचेचें उदक; 10 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर उकळूंक दियात. धण्यांचो पिठो मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्या वांगडाच घालात म्हणजे तो पयलीं थोडे सेकंद भाजतलो.
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Lower the flame. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; let it simmer 10 minutes on low flame. Add the coriander powder along with the chilli powder so that it will fry a few seconds first.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: चिंचेचो कच्चो वास गेल्लो आसूंक जाय आनी ग्रेव्ही चकचकीत दिसूंक जाय. ती चड बेगीन घट्ट जाल्यार ½ कप उदक घालात.
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of tamarind should have gone and the gravy should look glossy. If it becomes thick too quickly add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: तांतीं हळूच भितर सोडात आनी ग्रेव्ही घट्ट जायसर आनीक 5 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात. मदीं मदीं चमच्यान तांत्यांचेर ग्रेव्ही ओतात.
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Gently slide in the eggs and cook 5 more minutes on low flame until the gravy becomes thick. In between pour gravy over the eggs with a spoon.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: गोड घालून ढवळात, रुच पळोवन मीठ वा आंबटसाण सारकी करात, आनी कोंथिंबीर शिंपडात.
seg.299781c49104.back: Add jaggery and stir, taste and adjust salt or sourness, and sprinkle coriander leaves.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: उजो बंद करात आनी वाडचे आदीं पुलुसु 10 मिनटां दवरात म्हणजे तांत्यांक ग्रेव्ही लागतली.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Switch off the flame and keep the pulusu 10 minutes before serving so the gravy will cling to the eggs.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: चिऱ्यांक लागून आंबट-चुरचुरीत ग्रेव्ही तांत्यांभितर वता.
seg.feebbb94999b.back: Because of the slits the sour-pungent gravy goes inside the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: सालीं काडचे आदीं उकडिल्लीं तांतीं उदकांत थंड करात; सालीं निवळ सुटटात.
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool the boiled eggs in water before removing the shells; the shells come off clean.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो मध्यम तिखटसाण दिता; चड तिखट पुलुसुखातीर ताचे वांगडा ½ ल्हान चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालात.
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder along with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: दवरल्या उपरांत पुलुसुची रुच बरी लागता, आनी दुसऱ्या दिसा आनीकूय, कारण तांतीं चिंच शोशून घेतात.
seg.fc1643db807e.back: After keeping, the pulusu's taste feels better, and even more the next day, because the eggs absorb the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: टोमॅटो: मोव, उणी आंबट ग्रेव्हीखातीर कांद्यां उपरांत 1 कापिल्लो टोमॅटो घालात.
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a soft, less sour gravy add 1 cut tomato after the onions.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: तीळ: चड घट्ट, बियांसारक्या रुचीच्या ग्रेव्हीखातीर निमाण्या 5 मिनटांनी 1 व्हड चमचो भाजिल्ल्या तिळांचो पिठो घालून ढवळात.
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thicker, nut-like-tasting gravy add 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes and stir.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: मामिडिकाया: गिमांत अर्द्या चिंचे बदला तोराचे थोडे कुडके घालात आनी ग्रेव्हींत शिजयात.
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer instead of half the tamarind add a few pieces of raw mango and cook in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: ऊन वाफेच्या शिता आनी एक चमचो तूप वांगडा वाडात, कुशीक कुरकुरीत तळण वा पापड (अप्पडालु). चपाती वा दोशा वांगडाय बरें लागता.
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, a crispy fry or papad (appadalu) on the side. Also tastes good with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: उरिल्लें हुमण धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 दिसां भितर खायात. पुलुसु आयदनांत थोडें उदक घालून हळूच ऊन करात.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Keep the leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Gently heat the pulusu in a vessel with a little water added.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: तांत्यांच्या हुमणाखातीर तांतीं कितलो वेळ उकडूंक जाय?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long should eggs be boiled for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: उदक उकळटा त्या वेळावयल्यान सुमार 10 मिनटां. तांतीं ग्रेव्हींत घालचे आदीं बलक भितरमेरेन घट्ट आनी फिकट पिवळो जावंक जाय, मदीं पातळ आसूं नज.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. Before adding the eggs to the gravy the yolk should be firm through to the inside and light yellow, it must not be runny in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits made on the eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: उथळ चिऱ्यांक लागून चिंचेची ग्रेव्ही तांत्याच्या धव्या भागांत भितर वता. ते नासल्यार ग्रेव्ही वयरूच उरता आनी तांत्याची रुच फिकी लागता.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: Because of the shallow slits the tamarind gravy goes inside into the white part of the egg. Without them the gravy stays only on top and the egg's taste feels bland.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How to reduce the pulusu's sourness?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: थोडीं मिनटां आनीक मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात, एक ल्हान चमचो किसल्लो गोड घालात, वा थोडें उदक घालून ढवळात. फुडल्या फावटीं चिंचेचो ल्हान गोळो वापरात.
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Cook a few more minutes on low flame, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or add a little water and stir. Next time use a small ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: तांत्यांचें पुलुसु आनी तांत्यांचें हुमण हांचेमदीं कितें फरक आसा?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: पुलुसु म्हणजे शितांत मिसळपाखातीर केल्ली पातळ, आंबट-चुरचुरीत चिंचेची ग्रेव्ही. सादारण तांत्यांचें हुमण चड करून कांदो आनी टोमॅटो घालून करतात, चिंच नासतना आनी घट्ट मसाल्या वांगडा.
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu means a thin, sour-pungent tamarind gravy made for mixing into rice. The usual egg curry is mostly made with onion and tomato added, without tamarind and with a thick masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · तांत्यांच्या पुलुसुची रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg pulusu's recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु, आंध्राचें तांत्यांचें हुमण: उकडिल्लीं तांतीं आंबट-चुरचुरीत चिंच-कांद्याच्या ग्रेव्हींत शिजयिल्लीं, सन्नम मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्यान आनी हळदीन रंगयिल्ली. 4 जाणांक.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra's egg curry: boiled eggs cooked in a sour-pungent tamarind-onion gravy, coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु (चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हींत आंध्राचें तांत्यांचें हुमण) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra's egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा म्हणजे भरिल्ल्या वायंगणांची भाजी, जी आंध्राचीं घरां आयतारच्या दनपारच्या जेवणाक, लग्नांक आनी सोयरे येतात तेन्ना करतात. ल्हान, वाटकुळीं, जांबळीं वायंगणां चिरतात, तांचेंत भाजिल्ले शेंगदाणे, तीळ आनी खोबऱ्याचो मसालो भरतात, आनी तेलांत हळूहळू शिजयतात, तीं मोव जातात आनी मसालो तांकां चिकटता मेरेन.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya koora means the vegetable dish of stuffed brinjals, which Andhra's homes make for Sunday lunch, for weddings and when relatives come. Small, round, purple brinjals are slit, a masala of roasted groundnuts, sesame and copra is filled in them, and they are slowly cooked in oil, until they become soft and the masala sticks to them.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: आमचो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो भरपाच्या मसाल्याक तांबडो रंग आनी मध्यम तिखटसाण दिता, आनी हळदीचो पिठो ताका पुराय करता. ऊन शीत वा चपाती वांगडा वाडात. ही रेसिपी 4 जाणांक आसा.
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing masala red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder completes it. Serve with hot rice or chapati. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: शेंगदाणे, तीळ, सुकें खोबरें आनी धणे भाजात, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालून वाटात, ल्हान वायंगणांनी भरात आनी तेलांत मोव जायसर हळूहळू शिजयात.
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast groundnuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt added, fill into small brinjals and slowly cook in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 व्हड चमचे शेंगदाणे ⟦1⟧कच्चे, सालां सयत वा सालां बगर⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons groundnuts ⟦1⟧raw, with skins or without skins⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 ल्हान चमचे सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧चड तिखट भाजेखातीर 1 व्हड चमचो मेरेन⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧for a hotter dish up to 1 tablespoon⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12 ल्हान वायंगणां ⟦1⟧सुमार 500 g, ल्हान वाटकुळीं जांबळीं⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧cut, to add at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: शेंगदाणे, तीळ, खोबरें आनी धणे तेल बगर भाजात; मसाल्यां वांगडा वाटात. पयलीं शेंगदाणे मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर 3–4 मिनटां भाजात, मागीर धणे, जिरें आनी तीळ 1 मिनीट घालात, आनी खोबरें निमाण्या 30 सेकंदांखातीर, तें फिकट भांगरा रंगाचें जायसर. थंड जावंक दियात.
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Roast groundnuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds without oil; grind with the spices. First roast the groundnuts on medium-low flame 3–4 minutes, then add coriander seeds, cumin and sesame 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it becomes light golden coloured. Let it cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: मिक्सरांत भाजिल्लें मिश्रण लसूण, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो, मीठ आनी चिंच घालून उदक बगर जाडसर पिठो जायसर वाटात. दाबल्यार तें गुठळी जावंक जाय.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In the mixer grind the roasted mixture with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind added, without water, until a coarse powder. If pressed it should form a lump.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: वायंगणां धुयात आनी पाचवी टोपी थोडी कातरात, देंठ उरोवन दवरात.
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, keeping the stem.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: दरेक वायंगण सकयल्यान फुलीसारकें (+) चिरात, देंठ उरोवन, आनी मसालो भरात. सुमार तीन-चतुर्थांश वयर मेरेन कापात म्हणजे चारूय भाग वयर जोडून उरतले. दरेक कापतकच मिठाच्या उदकाच्या वाटयेंत घालीत वचात, मागीर उदक निथळात.
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Slit each brinjal from below like a plus (+), keeping the stem, and fill the masala. Cut about three-quarters up so that all four parts will stay joined at the top. As you cut each one keep putting it into a bowl of salt water, then drain the water.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: दरेक वायंगणांत सुमार 1 भरून ल्हान चमचो मसालो दाबून भरात. उरिल्लो मसालो बाजूक दवरात.
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press-fill about 1 heaped teaspoon of masala into each brinjal. Keep the remaining masala aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: एका रुंद, जाड आयदनांत मध्यम उज्याचेर तेल तापयात. सांसव घालात आनी, ते तडतडटात तेन्ना, कडिपत्तो आनी, वापरता जाल्यार, कांदो. कांदो मोव जायसर भाजात, सुमार 3 मिनटां.
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat oil in a wide, heavy vessel on medium flame. Add mustard seeds and, when they crackle, curry leaves and, if using, onion. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: भरिल्लीं वायंगणां आयदनांत एकाच थरांत मांडात.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Arrange the stuffed brinjals in the vessel in a single layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: वायंगणां ऊन तेलांत, धांकून, मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात, दर 4–5 मिनटांनी हळूच परतयात. चमचो वा चिमटो वापरात म्हणजे मसालो भितर उरतलो, आनी 15–18 मिनटां शिजयात, सालीक सुरकुत्यो पडटात मेरेन.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals in the hot oil, covered, on low flame, gently turning every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the masala will stay inside, and cook 15–18 minutes, until wrinkles form on the skin.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: उरिल्लो मसालो ½ कप उदका वांगडा घालात; वायंगणां मोव जायसर मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात. धांकून मंद उज्याचेर आनीक 8–10 मिनटां शिजयात, मसालो घट्ट जाता आनी देगेक तेल दिसता मेरेन.
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the remaining masala with ½ cup water; cook the brinjals on low flame until soft. Cook covered on low flame 8–10 more minutes, until the masala becomes thick and oil appears at the sides.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: शिजलां काय तें तपासात: सगळ्यांत जाड वायंगणांत सुरी कसलीच आडखळ नासतना भितर वचूंक जाय. कोंथिंबीर शिंपडात आनी उजो बंद करात.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check whether it is cooked: in the thickest brinjal a knife should go in without any resistance. Sprinkle coriander leaves and switch off the flame.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: देंठ उरोवन दवरात म्हणजे शिजतना आनी परतयतना वायंगणां जोडून उरतलीं.
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Keep the stem so that while cooking and turning the brinjals will stay joined.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: एकाच आकाराचीं ल्हान, चकचकीत वायंगणां वेंचात, म्हणजे तीं सारकीं शिजतलीं; व्हड वायंगणां मदीं घट्ट उरतात.
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small, shiny brinjals of the same size, so they will cook evenly; large brinjals stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: शेंगदाणे आनी तीळ मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर भाजात; करपिल्ले तीळ सगळो मसालो कडू करतात.
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast the groundnuts and sesame on medium-low flame; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: सौम्य भाजेखातीर 1½ ल्हान चमचो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात; चड तिखटसाणेखातीर 1 व्हड चमचो मेरेन घालात.
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a mild dish use 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for more heat add up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: कांद्याच्या मसाल्या वांगडा: मोव, थोडी गोड ग्रेव्हीखातीर भरपाच्या मसाल्यांत 1 ल्हान कांदो वाटून घालात.
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a soft, slightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion and add into the stuffing masala.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: खोबऱ्या बगर: खोबरें घालूं नाकात आनी आनीक 1 व्हड चमचो शेंगदाणे आनी तीळ वापरात.
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: do not add coconut and use 1 more tablespoon groundnuts and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: ग्रेव्हीवाली: शितांत मिसळपाखातीर पातळ भाजी जावंक, निमाण्या पावलार ½ कपा बदला 1 कप उदक घालात.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: Gravy-style: to make a thin dish for mixing into rice, in the last step add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: ऊन वाफेच्या शिता आनी एक चमचो तूप वांगडा वाडात, वा चपाती वा जोन्ना रोट्टे वांगडा.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 दिसां भितर खायात. थोडें उदक घालून हळूच ऊन करात.
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Gently heat with a little water added.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: गुत्ति वंकायाखातीर खंयचीं वायंगणां सगळ्यांत बरीं?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: ल्हान, वाटकुळीं, जांबळीं वायंगणां, सुमार तांत्या इतलीं, चकचकीत साल आनी पाचवो देंठ आशिल्लीं. मसालो शिजता तितल्या वेळांतूच तीं भितरमेरेन शिजतात आनी मसालो बरो धरून दवरतात.
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Small, round, purple brinjals, about the size of an egg, having shiny skin and a green stem. In the same time that the masala cooks they cook through to the inside and hold the masala well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.t: वायंगणां शिजल्यांत हें म्हाका कशें कळटलें?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How will I know the brinjals are cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: सालीक सुरकुत्यो पडटात आनी ती मोव जाता, आनी सगळ्यांत जाड वायंगणांत सुरी कसलीच आडखळ नासतना भितर वता. उणीं शिजिल्लीं वायंगणां मदीं घट्ट आनी स्पंजासारकीं लागतात.
seg.c65656faa952.back: Wrinkles form on the skin and it becomes soft, and in the thickest brinjal a knife goes in without any resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel hard and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: हांव खोबऱ्या बगर गुत्ति वंकाया करूं येता?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: हय. खोबऱ्या बदला आनीक 1 व्हड चमचो शेंगदाणे आनी आनीक 1 व्हड चमचो तीळ वापरात; मसाल्याक बियांसारकी रुच चड येता.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut use 1 more tablespoon groundnuts and 1 more tablespoon sesame; the masala gets more nut-like taste.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why do my brinjals split open?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: देंठ काडिल्लो वा फुलीसारको चीर पुराय आरपार कापिल्लो. देंठ उरोवन दवरात, चीर वयल्यान सुमार एक चतुर्थांश आदींच थांबयात आनी तीं हळूच परतयात.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stem was removed or the plus-like slit was cut fully through. Keep the stem, stop the slit about one quarter before the top and turn them gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · गुत्ति वंकाया कूराची रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Koora's recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. ल्हान वायंगणांनी भाजिल्ले शेंगदाणे, तीळ आनी खोबरें भरिल्लें, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी हळदीचो पिठो घालून वाटिल्लें, मागीर तेलांत हळूहळू शिजयिल्लीं.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals filled with roasted groundnuts, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder added, then slowly cooked in oil.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि म्हणजे काजू भजी, जी आंध्राचीं मिठायेचीं दुकानां आनी घरां चाच्या वेळार, परबांक आनी सोयऱ्यांखातीर तळटात: आखे काजू बेसन आनी तांदळाच्या पिठाच्या पातळ, मसालेदार थरांत, कुरकुरीत जायसर तळिल्ले. कांदो नासतना केल्ल्यान ती बरणेंत जायते दीस उरता, देखून जायतीं घरां दिवाळी आनी संक्रांतीच्या सोयऱ्यांखातीर एक घाणो तळून दवरतात.
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi means cashew bhaji, which Andhra's sweet shops and homes fry at tea time, for festivals and for relatives: whole cashews in a thin, spicy coating of besan and rice flour, fried until crispy. Because it is made without onion it keeps many days in a jar, so many homes fry and keep a batch for Diwali and Sankranti relatives.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: आमच्या जीडिपप्पु पॅकांतले आखे काजू थरा भितर कुरकुरीत उरतात, आनी सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो मध्यम तिखटसाण आनी उबदार तांबडो रंग दिता. ही रेसिपी 4 जाणांक आसा.
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: एकूण वेळांत पकोडि थंड आनी कुरकुरीत जावपाक 5 मिनटां धरल्यांत.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: In the total time 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and become crispy are counted.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: आखे काजू बेसन, तांदळाचें पीठ, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो, मीठ आनी एक चमचो ऊन तेल घालून घोळात, फकत थर बसता इतलें उदक शिंपडात, आनी भांगरा रंगाचे आनी कुरकुरीत जायसर भरपूर तेलांत तळात.
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle only as much water as the coating sets, and fry in plenty of oil until golden coloured and crispy.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 कप आखे काजू ⟦1⟧सुमार 150 g; खूब व्हड काजू आसल्यार अर्दे करात⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; if the cashews are very large make halves⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ कप बेसन ⟦1⟧चण्याचें पीठ, सुमार 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 व्हड चमचे तांदळाचें पीठ ⟦1⟧चड कुरकुरीत थराखातीर⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crispier coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 ल्हान चमचो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧मध्यम तिखटसाण; चड तिखट पकोडिखातीर आनीक ½ ल्हान चमचो घालात⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for a hotter pakodi add ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.40a2a51a64aa.t: ½ ल्हान चमचो मीठ ⟦1⟧वा रुची प्रमाण⟦/1⟧
seg.40a2a51a64aa.back: ½ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 व्हड चमचो ऊन तेल ⟦1⟧तळपाच्या तेलांतल्यान घेतिल्लें⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: भरपूर तेलांत तळपाखातीर तेल ⟦1⟧सादारणपणान शेंगदाण्याचें तेल वापरतात⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: Oil for frying in plenty of oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: काजू हळूच धुयात आनी उदक बरें निथळात; थोडो ओलसर पृश्ठभाग आसल्यार पीठ चिकटता.
seg.8423a6481648.back: Gently wash the cashews and drain the water well; if there is a slightly moist surface the flour sticks.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: कढयेंत मध्यम उज्याचेर तळपाखातीर तेल तापयात.
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat the frying oil in a kadai on medium flame.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: बेसन, तांदळाचें पीठ, मिरसांगेचो पिठो, मीठ, आलें-लसणीचें वाटप आनी कडिपत्तो मिसळात. रुंद वाटी वापरात, आनी तेन्नाच हिरव्यो मिरसांगो, कोंथिंबीर आनी हिंग घालात.
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and at that time add green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 व्हड चमचो ऊन तेल घालून चोळात, काजू घालात आनी पीठ फकत तांचेर लागता इतलें उदक शिंपडात. कढयेंतलें ऊन तेल काळजी घेवन चमच्यान काडात आनी पयलीं बोटांच्या तोंकांनी पिठाच्या मिश्रणांत चोळात, मागीर काजू घालात आनी एका फावटीं 1 व्हड चमचो उदक शिंपडीत हालयात, दरेक काजूक पीठ लागता मेरेन. मिश्रण ओलसर चुऱ्यासारकें दिसूंक जाय, पिठयेसारकें न्हय.
seg.346911fb291b.back: Add 1 tablespoon hot oil and rub, add the cashews and sprinkle only as much water as the flour just coats them. Carefully take the hot oil from the kadai with a spoon and first rub it into the flour mixture with fingertips, then add the cashews and toss sprinkling 1 tablespoon water at a time, until flour coats every cashew. The mixture should look like moist crumbs, not like batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: तेल तपासात: मिश्रणाची एक चिमूट घातल्यार ती 2–3 सेकंदांनी थीर बुडबुड्यां वांगडा वयर येवंक जाय. ती रोखडीच तपकिरी जाल्यार, तेल चड ऊन आसा.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Check the oil: if a pinch of the mixture is put in it should rise up after 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it becomes brown immediately, the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: मध्यम ऊन तेलांत ल्हान ल्हान घोंस घालात. एका फावटीं 3–4 पीठ लायिल्ले काजू बोटांनी उखलात आनी सैलपणान तेलांत सोडात, कढय भरून वचूंक दिवची न्हय.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Put small small clusters in medium hot oil. Pick up 3–4 flour-coated cashews at a time with fingers and loosely drop into the oil, the kadai must not be allowed to get crowded.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: परतयत भांगरा रंगाचे आनी कुरकुरीत जायसर तळात, 5–6 मिनटां; कागदाचेर काडात. पकोडि तयार जातना तिच्या भोंवतणचे बुडबुडे ल्हान आनी मंद जातात.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry turning until golden coloured and crispy, 5–6 minutes; take out onto paper. When the pakodi is getting ready the bubbles around it become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: उरिल्लें तशेंच घाण्यांनी तळात, दोन घाण्यां मदीं तेल परत ऊन जावंक दियात.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the remaining the same way in batches, letting the oil become hot again between two batches.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: पकोडि कागदाचेर 5 मिनटां दवरात; थंड जातना ती आनीक कुरकुरीत जाता. जाय जाल्यार वयर एक चिमूट मीठ वा मिरसांगेचो पिठो शिंपडात.
seg.8ab193492427.back: Keep the pakodi on paper 5 minutes; while cooling it becomes even crispier. If wanted sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: पिठो घट्ट आनी सुको दवरात, पातळ न्हय, नाजाल्यार पकोडि मोव जाता.
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the flour mix thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi becomes soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: मध्यम उज्याचेर तळात: काजू बेगीन तपकिरी जातात, आनी व्हड उज्याचेर भितरलो काजू भाजचे आदींच थराचो रंग बदलता.
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium flame: cashews quickly become brown, and on high flame the coating's colour changes before the cashew inside roasts.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: पिठांत चोळिल्लो एक चमचो ऊन तेल पकोडि हलकी आनी कुरकुरीत करता.
seg.76602f605fc8.back: A spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crispy.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो मध्यम तिखटसाण आनी बरो तांबडो रंग दिता; भुरग्यांखातीर ½ ल्हान चमचो वापरात.
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a good red colour; for children use ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: चड तिखट: अर्द्या सन्नम मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्या बदला तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात, जो खूब चड तिखट आसा.
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: instead of half the Sannam chilli powder use Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: कांद्या वांगडा: मोव, गोडसर पकोडिखातीर काजूं वांगडा 1 ल्हान कांदो, पातळ उबो कापिल्लो, घालात, आनी ती त्याच दिसा खायात.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a soft, sweetish pakodi add 1 small onion, thinly sliced lengthwise, with the cashews, and eat it the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: पुदिनो: कोंथिंबिरी वांगडाच 2 व्हड चमचे कापिल्लीं पुदिन्याचीं पानां घालात.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: along with the coriander leaves add 2 tablespoons cut mint leaves.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: सांजेच्या चा वा फिल्टर कॉफी वांगडा ऊन वाडात. ती डब्यांत वा शीत-पप्पुच्या जेवणाच्या कुशीकय वता.
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve hot with evening tea or filter coffee. It also goes in a tiffin box or on the side of a rice-pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: पुरायपणान थंड जाल्या उपरांत, ती कुडाच्या तापमानाक हवाबंद बरणेंत दवरात आनी 4–5 दिसां भितर खायात. मोव जाल्यार, सुक्या आयदनांत मंद उज्याचेर 2–3 मिनटां ऊन करात.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After fully cooling, keep it at room temperature in an airtight jar and eat within 4–5 days. If it becomes soft, heat it in a dry vessel on low flame 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: म्हजी काजू पकोडि मोव कित्याक जाली?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: पिठांत चड उदक, वा मंद उज्याचेर तळप. मिश्रण ओलसर चुऱ्यासारकें दवरात आनी बुडबुडे मंद जायसर मध्यम उज्याचेर तळात.
seg.346050614d3a.back: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low flame. Keep the mixture like moist crumbs and fry on medium flame until the bubbles become slow.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.t: पकोडि करचे आदीं काजू भिजोवंक जाय?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Should cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: भिजोवपाची गरज ना. पीठ चिकटपाक बेगीन धुवप पुरो; चड वेळ भिजयिल्ले काजू आपलो थोडो कुरकुरीतपण वगडायतात.
seg.e6e487728264.back: There is no need to soak. For the flour to stick a quick wash is enough; cashews soaked a long time lose a little of their crunchiness.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: हांव तांदळाच्या पिठा बगर काजू पकोडि करूं येता?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: हय. आनीक 2 व्हड चमचे बेसन, वा 1 व्हड चमचो कॉर्नफ्लोर वापरात. तांदळाच्या पिठान सगळ्यांत कुरकुरीत थर जाता, देखून ताचे बगर पकोडि थोडी मोव जातली.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Use 2 more tablespoons besan, or 1 tablespoon cornflour. Rice flour makes the crispiest coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little soft.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: काजू पकोडि कितले दीस कुरकुरीत उरता?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How many days does cashew pakodi stay crispy?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: हवाबंद बरणेंत सुमार 4–5 दीस, भितर घालचे आदीं ती पुरायपणान थंड जाल्ली आसल्यार.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: In an airtight jar about 4–5 days, if it was fully cooled before putting inside.

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. आमच्या जीडिपप्पु पॅकांतले आखे काजू, बेसन, तांदळाचें पीठ आनी सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून कुरकुरीत काजू पकोडि. पावलां-पावलांनी पद्धत, सुचोवण्यो आनी प्रस्न-जाप.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crispy cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder added. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.7d26dc20462c.back: Oil for frying in plenty of oil

seg.f99e3a7cfd38.back: Jeedipappu Upma ⟦1⟧(rava uppit with cashews added)⟦/1⟧

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: उपमा म्हणजे आंध्राचें दर दिसाचें टिफिन: रवो कांदो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो घालून फोडणी दिल्ल्या उदकांत मोव शिजयतात. जीडिपप्पु उपमा म्हणजे ताचें सजयिल्लें रूप, तुपांत भांगरा रंगाचे तळिल्ल्या काजूंची भरून मूठ घालून, सोयऱ्यांखातीर, परबेच्या सकाळीं आनी लग्नांनी करतात तशें, आनी चड करून पेसरट्टु वांगडा वा एक चमचो साकर घालून वाडटात.
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma means Andhra's everyday tiffin: rava is cooked soft in water tempered with onion, green chillies and curry leaves added. Jeedipappu upma means its decorated form, with a full fistful of cashews fried golden coloured in ghee added, as made for relatives, on festival mornings and at weddings, and it is mostly served with pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar added.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: आमचे जीडिपप्पु काजू आखे आनी सादे आसात, देखून ते सारके तळटात आनी मोव रव्या मदीं कुरकुरीत उरतात. सुमार 25 मिनटांनी तें जेवणाक तयार जाता. ही रेसिपी 3 जाणांक आसा.
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy in the soft rava. In about 25 minutes it becomes ready to eat. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: रवो भाजात, काजू तुपांत तळात, मागीर फोडणी दियात आनी कांदो आनी मिरसांगो मोव करात. मीठ घालून उदक उकळयात, रवो घालून ढवळात, धांकात आनी निमाणें काजू घालात.
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the rava, fry the cashews in ghee, then give the tempering and make the onion and chillies soft. Boil water with salt added, add the rava and stir, cover and at the end add the cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 कप बॉम्बे रवो ⟦1⟧मध्यम रवो (सुजी), सुमार 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium rava (suji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for a thick upma use 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ कप काजू ⟦1⟧आखे वा अर्दे, सुमार 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halves, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 व्हड चमचे तूप ⟦1⟧वा 2 व्हड चमचे तेल आनी 1 व्हड चमचो तूप⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 हिरव्यो मिरसांगो ⟦1⟧मदीं फाडिल्ल्यो; चड तिखट उपम्याखातीर 3 वापरात⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit in the middle; for a hotter upma use 3⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: कांदो, आलें आनी कोंथिंबीर कापात, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो मदीं फाडात, आनी उदक मेजून घेयात.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Cut the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies in the middle, and measure the water.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: रवो सुक्या आयदनांत भाजिल्लो परमळ येता मेरेन भाजात, सुमार 5 मिनटां. ताचो रंग फिकटूच दवरात. मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर सारको ढवळीत रावात, मागीर तो एका ताटांत ओतात.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the rava in a dry vessel until a roasted aroma comes, about 5 minutes. Keep its colour light only. Keep stirring evenly on medium-low flame, then pour it onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: एका रुंद, जाड आयदनांत मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर तूप तापयात.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat ghee in a wide, heavy vessel on medium-low flame.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: काजू तुपांत भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर तळात; ते काडून दवरात. हाका सुमार 1–2 मिनटां लागतात; तूप आयदनांतूच उरोवन दवरात.
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry the cashews in the ghee until golden coloured; take them out and keep. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee remaining in the vessel itself.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: सांसव, दाळी आनी कडिपत्त्याची फोडणी करात. कांदो आनी मिरसांगो मोव करात, उदक आनी मीठ घालात, आनी उकळयात. कडिपत्तो घालचे आदीं सांसव तडतडूंक दियात आनी दाळी फिकट भांगरा रंगाच्यो जावंक दियात, मागीर कांद्या वांगडा आलें घालात आनी कांदो मोव जायसर 3–4 मिनटां शिजयात.
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Make a tempering of mustard seeds, dals and curry leaves. Make the onion and chillies soft, add water and salt, and boil. Before adding curry leaves let the mustard seeds crackle and let the dals become light golden coloured, then add ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion becomes soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: उदक उकळ्ळें म्हणजे ताची रुच पळयात; तें थोडें खारट लागूंक जाय, कारण रवो मीठ शोशून घेता.
seg.be01d433ae80.back: When the water has boiled taste it; it should taste a little salty, because the rava absorbs the salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: उजो मंद करात. ढवळीत रवो पातळ धारेन घालात. 3 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर धांकून दवरात; वयर काजू घालात.
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Lower the flame. Add the rava in a thin stream while stirring. Keep covered on low flame 3 minutes; add cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: काजू घालचे आदीं उपमा तपासात: रवो मोव जावंक जाय, एकूय घट्ट कण आसूं नज, आनी उपमा आयदनाच्यो कुशी सोडूंक जाय. अजून कणकणीत आसल्यार, 2 व्हड चमचे ऊन उदक शिंपडात, धांकात आनी आनीक 1 मिनीट शिजयात.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Check the upma before adding cashews: the rava should be soft, there must not be even one hard grain, and the upma should leave the sides of the vessel. If still grainy, sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 more minute.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: वापरता जाल्यार आनीक एक चमचो तूप आनी कोंथिंबीर, वांगडा चडशे काजू, घालून ढवळात.
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: If using, add one more spoon of ghee and coriander leaves, along with most of the cashews, and stir.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: उरिल्ले काजू वयर घालून ऊन वाडात.
seg.351e9512c914.back: Add the remaining cashews on top and serve hot.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: ढवळीत रवो पातळ धारेन घालात म्हणजे गुठळ्यो जावच्यो नात.
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Add the rava in a thin stream while stirring so lumps will not form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: पयलीं रवो भाजल्यार दरेक कण वेगळो उरता; हें सोडल्यार उपमा चिकट जाता.
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: If the rava is roasted first each grain stays separate; if this is skipped the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: काजू मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर तळात आनी भांगरा रंगाचे जातकच काडात; ऊन तुपांत ते काळसर जायतच उरतात.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry the cashews on medium-low flame and take them out as soon as they become golden coloured; in hot ghee they keep becoming darker.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: दवरल्यार उपमा घट्ट जाता, देखून तुमकां जाय त्यापरस थोडें मोव आसतनाच उज्यावयल्यान काडात.
seg.975560a8a158.back: If kept the upma becomes thick, so take it off the flame while it is a little softer than you want.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: भाजयेचें उपमा: कांद्या वांगडा ½ कप कापिल्ली गाजर, बिन्स आनी वाटाणे घालात आनी उदक घालचे आदीं 3–4 मिनटां शिजयात.
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: with the onion add ½ cup cut carrot, beans and peas and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: टोमॅटो उपमा: कांद्या उपरांत 1 कापिल्लो टोमॅटो घालात आनी उदक घालचे आदीं मोव जायसर शिजयात.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: after the onion add 1 cut tomato and cook until soft before adding water.
