seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: गोधुमा रवा उपमा: तितलोच गंवाचो रवो 3 कप उदका वांगडा वापरात आनी धांकून 5–6 मिनटां शिजयात.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: न्याहारेचें टिफिन म्हूण नाल्लाची चटणी, अल्लम पच्चडी (आल्याची चटणी) वा एक चमचो साकर वांगडा ऊन वाडात, वा पेसरट्टु उपम्याखातीर पेसरट्टु वांगडा.
seg.01300d94ad36.back: As a breakfast tiffin serve hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi (ginger chutney) or a spoon of sugar, or for pesarattu upma with pesarattu.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: उपमा केल्ले उपरांत बेगीन ऊन ऊन खावप सगळ्यांत बरें. उरिल्लें उपमा धांकून फ्रिजांत 1 दीस मेरेन दवरात आनी परत ऊन करचे आदीं उदक शिंपडात.
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: It is best to eat the upma hot hot quickly after it is made. Keep leftover upma covered in the fridge up to 1 day and sprinkle water before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How to make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: उदक उकळटें दवरात, उजो मंद करात आनी एका हातान रवो पातळ धारेन घालात आनी दुसऱ्या हातान ढवळीत रावात.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, lower the flame and with one hand add the rava in a thin stream and with the other hand keep stirring.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: उपम्याखातीर रवो आनी उदक हांचें योग्य प्रमाण कितें?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right proportion of rava and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: मोव आंध्र पद्दतीच्या उपम्याखातीर, 1 कप बॉम्बे रव्याक 2½ कप उदक वापरात. घट्ट, चड सुटसुटीत उपम्याखातीर 2 कप वापरात.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For a soft Andhra-style upma, for 1 cup Bombay rava use 2½ cups water. For a thick, more separate upma use 2 cups.

seg.2cc94b02b5b4.back: Why does my upma become sticky?

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: रवो भाजूंक ना, वा चड उदक पडलें. रवो भाजिल्लो परमळ येता मेरेन भाजात, आनी दर कपाक 2½ कप उदकाच्या लागसार उरात.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava until a roasted aroma comes, and stay near 2½ cups of water for every cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When to add cashews to upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: पयलीं ते तुपांत तळून काडात, मागीर निमाणें घालून ढवळात. आदीं घातल्यार ते उपम्यांत मोव जातात.
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry them in ghee and take out, then add at the end and stir. If added earlier they become soft in the upma.

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. तुपांत भांगरा रंगाचे तळिल्ले जीडिपप्पु काजू घालून आंध्राचें रव्याचें उपमा, मोव आनी बेगीन जावपी सकाळचें टिफिन. पावलां-पावलांनी पद्धत, सुचोवण्यो आनी प्रस्न-जाप. 3 जाणांक.
seg.8b57b24af158.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra's rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden coloured in ghee added, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers. For 3 people.

seg.5eecbe415597.back: Jeedipappu Upma (rava uppit with cashews added) · 1acrefarms

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: जीडिपप्पु उपमा: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: कोडी वेपुडु म्हणजे आंध्राचें सुकें कोंबयेचें फ्राय: कोंबयेचे ल्हान कुडके आपल्याच रसांत शिजयतात, मागीर कडिपत्तो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी आतांच भाजिल्लो मसालो घालून तेलांत जोरान तळटात, ते काळसर आनी मसाल्यान चिकट जायसर. आंध्राच्या लग्नांनी हें स्टार्टर, आनी घरा रसम-शीत वा पप्पु वांगडा कुशीक दवरपी पदार्थ.
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu means Andhra's dry chicken fry: small pieces of chicken are cooked in their own juice, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and freshly roasted masala added, until they are dark and sticky with masala. At Andhra's weddings this is a starter, and at home a side dish kept with rasam-rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: आमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो ताका गाढो तांबडो रंग आनी ती तिखटसाण दिता जिचे खातीर आंध्राचीं फ्रायां नामनेचीं, आमचो हळदीचो पिठो मुरोवपाच्या मसाल्यांत वता, आनी आमचो आखो काजूगर, भांगरा रंगाचो तळिल्लो, निमाणें वता. कुशीचो पदार्थ म्हूण 4 जाणांक.
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that heat for which Andhra's fries are famous, our turmeric powder goes into the marinating masala, and our whole cashew nuts, fried golden coloured, go in at the end. As a side dish for 4 people.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: कोंबी तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो, आलें-लसणीचें वाटप आनी लिंबू घालून मुरयात, तिच्याच रसांत शिजयात, मागीर कडिपत्तो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो, भाजिल्लो मसालो आनी काजू घालून सुकी तळात.
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Marinate the chicken with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon added, cook in its own juice, then fry dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and cashews added.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g हाडां बगर कोंबी ⟦1⟧1 इंचाचे कुडके कापिल्ली; वा 600 g हाडां सयत ल्हान कुडके⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1 inch pieces; or 600 g small pieces with bones⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15 काजू ⟦1⟧आखो काजूगर; व्हड आसल्यार अर्दे करात⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew nuts; if large make halves⟦/1⟧

seg.e43b68ea429f.back: 2 sprigs of curry leaves ⟦1⟧leaves removed, about 30⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: कोंबी कपड्यान थापटून सुकी करात म्हणजे मसालो चिकटतलो.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the masala will stick.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: कोंबी तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळद, आलें-लसणीचें वाटप, लिंबाचो रस आनी मीठ घालून 30 मिनटां मुरयात. हातांनी बरें मिसळात म्हणजे दरेक कुडक्याक मसालो लागतलो.
seg.075327f4deca.back: Marinate the chicken 30 minutes with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt added. Mix well with hands so masala will coat every piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: ते मदीं, धणे, जिरें, बडीशेप, लवंग आनी दालचिनी एका ल्हान आयदनांत मंद उज्याचेर तेल बगर भाजात, परमळ येता आनी एक छटा काळसर जाता मेरेन, सुमार 2 मिनटां. थंड करून जाडसर पिठो वाटात. हो फ्रायाचो मसालो.
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile, dry-roast coriander seeds, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon in a small vessel on low flame without oil, until aroma comes and it becomes one shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: कोंबी उदक बगर एका जाड कढयेंत घालात, धांकात आनी मध्यम उज्याचेर दवरात.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken without water in a heavy kadai, cover and keep on medium flame.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: गुलाबी रंग उरना मेरेन धांकून तिच्याच रसांत शिजयात, सुमार 12 मिनटां. एक-दोन फावटीं ढवळात; शिजतना कोंबी उदक सोडटा.
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook covered in its own juice until no pink colour remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; while cooking the chicken releases water.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: धांपण काडात आनी व्हड उज्याचेर ढवळीत शिजयात, उदक जवळ जवळ आटता मेरेन, 3–4 मिनटां. कोंबी एका ताटांत काडात आनी कढय पुसून घेयात.
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Remove the lid and cook on high flame stirring, until the water almost dries up, 3–4 minutes. Take the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadai on medium flame.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: काजू तेलांत भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर तळात; काडात. हाका एक मिनटा परस उणो वेळ लागता, देखून सारके ढवळीत रावात आनी झाऱ्यान काडात.
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden coloured; take out. This takes less time than a minute, so keep stirring evenly and take out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: वापरता जाल्यार कांदो घालात, आनी भांगरा रंगाचो जायसर भाजात. हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो भाजात. फाटीं सरात; पानां तडतडटात आनी उडटात.
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If using add the onion, and fry until golden coloured. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Move back; the leaves crackle and splatter.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: कोंबी आनी फ्रायाचो मसालो घालात. व्हड उज्याचेर सुकें आनी काळसर जायसर तळात, मागीर काजू घालून हालयात. 6–8 मिनटां हालयत रावात, मसालो कुडक्यांक चिकटता आनी देगो काळसर आनी कुरकुरीत जातात मेरेन.
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and the fry masala. Fry on high flame until dry and dark, then add the cashews and toss. Keep tossing 6–8 minutes, until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges become dark and crispy.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: रुच पळयात, गरज आसल्यार मीठ घालात, कोंथिंबीर शिंपडात आनी ऊन वाडात.
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, add salt if needed, sprinkle coriander leaves and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: निमाणें व्हड उज्याचेर तळात म्हणजे मसालो दरेक कुडक्याक चिकटतलो.
seg.349c72ce839a.back: At the end fry on high flame so the masala will stick to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो खूब तिखट आसा. मध्यम तिखटसाणेखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो वापरात, वा तांबड्या रंगाखातीर आनी उण्या तिखटसाणेखातीर ताचे बदला सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour and less heat use Sannam chilli powder instead of it.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: कुडके ल्हान आनी सारके कापात म्हणजे ते एकाच वेळार भितरमेरेन शिजतले आनी फ्रायांत बरे कुरकुरीत जातले.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and even so they will cook through to the inside at the same time and become nicely crispy in the fry.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: फ्रायाचो मसालो रांदचे पयलींच वाटात; भाजिल्ल्या मसाल्यांचो परमळूच बऱ्या वेपुडुचो जीव.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the fry masala just before cooking; the aroma of the roasted spices is the soul of a good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: हाडां सयत: 600 g हाडां सयत ल्हान कुडके वापरात आनी तांच्याच रसांत 18–20 मिनटां शिजयात, हाडा लागीं गुलाबी रंग उरना मेरेन.
seg.62d6684e446e.back: With bones: use 600 g small pieces with bones and cook 18–20 minutes in their own juice, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: कोब्बरी वेपुडु: फ्रायांत मसाल्या वांगडा 3 व्हड चमचे किसल्लें सुकें खोबरें घालात आनी तें तांबूस जायसर हालयात.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari vepudu: in the fry add 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut with the masala and toss until it becomes brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: मटण वेपुडु: 500 g हाडां बगर मटण मुरोवपाचो मसालो आनी ½ कप उदक घालून प्रेशर कुकरांत 5–6 शिट्टयो काडून शिजयात, मागीर तशेंच तळात.
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinating masala and ½ cup water added in the pressure cooker taking 5–6 whistles, then fry the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: रसम-शीत, पप्पु आनी शीत वा सांबार-शीत वांगडा कुशीचो पदार्थ म्हूण ऊन वाडात, वा कापिल्ल्या कांद्या आनी लिंबाच्या फोडी वांगडा स्टार्टर म्हूण एकटेंच.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot as a side dish with rasam-rice, pappu and rice or sambar-rice, or alone as a starter with cut onions and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: धांकून फ्रिजांत 2 दीस मेरेन दवरात. ऊन आयदनांत तेलाचे थोडे थेंब घालून भितरलेमेरेन वाफ येता इतलें ऊन करात; तें परत कुरकुरीत जाता.
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days. In a hot vessel with a few drops of oil added heat so hot that steam comes through to the inside; it becomes crispy again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: आंध्रांत कोंबयेचें फ्राय आनी कोंबयेचें हुमण हांचेमदीं कितें फरक आसा?
seg.551573b4b443.back: In Andhra what is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: वेपुडु सुकें आसता: कोंबी आपल्याच रसांत शिजयतात, मागीर ग्रेव्ही नासतना मसालो तिका लागता मेरेन तळटात. कोडी कूरा म्हणजे शिताखातीर कांद्या-टोमॅटोच्या ग्रेव्हीचें हुमण.
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juice, then fried without gravy until the masala coats it. Kodi koora means a curry of onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: वेपुडुखातीर हाडां बगरची कोंबी वापरची काय हाडां सयतची?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: For vepudu should boneless chicken be used or with bones?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: दोनूय चलतात. हाडां बगरची बेगीन शिजता आनी चड कुरकुरीत जाता; हाडां सयत ल्हान कुडक्यांक चड रुच आसता पूण तांकां आपल्या रसांत सुमार 8 मिनटां आनीक लागतात.
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crispier; small pieces with bones have more taste but they need about 8 more minutes in their own juice.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: सगळ्यांत जाड कुडको कापून उगडात. मदीं (वा हाडा लागीं) गुलाबी रंग उरना आनी रस नितळ येता तेन्ना कोंबी शिजल्या.
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut open the thickest piece. When no pink colour remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice comes clear, the chicken is cooked.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: कोडी वेपुडु उणें तिखट कशें करचें?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How to make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 ल्हान चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात, वा ताचे बदला सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालात, आनी फकत 2 हिरव्यो मिरसांगो फाडात. काजू आनी कडिपत्तो रुच भरपूर दवरतात.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or add Sannam chilli powder instead of it, and slit only 2 green chillies. Cashews and curry leaves keep the taste full.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: కోడి వేపుడు · कोडी वेपुडु (आंध्राचें कोंबयेचें फ्राय) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra's chicken fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: కోడి వేపుడు. आंध्राचें कोंबयेचें फ्राय: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी हळदीचो पिठो लायिल्ली कोंबी, कडिपत्तो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो, भाजिल्लो मसालो आनी आमचे काजू घालून सुकी तळिल्ली.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra's chicken fry: chicken coated with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and our cashews added.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: कोडी वेपुडु: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा म्हणजे आंध्राच्या घरांतलें चकचकीत पिवळें लिंबाचें शीत: शिजयिल्लें शीत शेंगदाणे, चण्याची दाळ, उडदाची दाळ, सांसव, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्त्याच्या तडतडटा फोडणे वांगडा मिसळटात, मागीर लिंबाच्या रसान आंबट करतात. रेल्वेच्या प्रवासाक, शाळेच्या डब्याक आनी देवळाच्या दिसांनी हें शीत भरून दितात, आनी परबांक आनी पुजांक व्हड प्रमाणांत करतात.
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora means the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra's homes: cooked rice is mixed with a crackling tempering of groundnuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then made sour with lemon juice. For railway journeys, for school tiffin boxes and on temple days this rice is packed and given, and for festivals and pujas it is made in large quantity.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: आमचो हळदीचो पिठो थोड्या सेकंदांखातीर ऊन तेलांत वता, ताका लागून दरेक शिताचो कण सारको भांगरा-पिवळो जाता आनी ताचो कच्चेपणाचो वास वता. ही रेसिपी 4 जाणांक आसा.
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into hot oil for a few seconds, because of which every grain of rice becomes evenly golden-yellow and its raw smell goes. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: एकूण वेळांत शीत शिजोवप आनी रुची थीर जावपाक 15 मिनटां दवरप धरलां.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: In the total time cooking the rice and keeping 15 minutes for the flavours to settle are counted.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: शेंगदाणे, दाळी, सांसव, मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो तेलांत भाजात, हळदीचो पिठो आनी हिंग घालात, मागीर थंड शीत, मीठ आनी लिंबाचो रस घालून मिसळात.
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry groundnuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and asafoetida, then add cold rice, salt and lemon juice and mix.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 कप तांदूळ ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, सुमार 200 g; हातूंतल्यान सुमार 3 कप शीत जाता⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; from this about 3 cups of cooked rice are made⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 कप शीत ⟦1⟧थोडें घट्ट शिजयिल्लें, कण सुटसुटीत⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 व्हड चमचे लिंबाचो रस ⟦1⟧सुमार 2 लिंबांचो; रुची प्रमाण आनीक घालात⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧of about 2 lemons; add more as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 व्हड चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧सादारणपणान शेंगदाण्याचें तेल वापरतात⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: तांदूळ धुयात आनी 2 कप उदका वांगडा फकत शिजता मेरेन शिजयात, म्हणजे कण सुटसुटीत उरतले. तुमकां सुमार 3 कप शीत जाय.
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook with 2 cups water only until it is cooked, so the grains will stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: शीत थंड जावपाक एका ताटांत पातळायात; मीठ घालात. काट्यान तें सुटें करात आनी कोमट जायसर सुमार 10 मिनटां दवरात, ऊन न्हय, म्हणजे मिसळटना कण मोडचे नात.
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Loosen it with a fork and keep about 10 minutes until lukewarm, not hot, so the grains will not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: तेल तापयात; शेंगदाणे, दाळी, सांसव, मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो भाजात. मध्यम उज्याचेर शेंगदाण्यांनी सुरवात करात आनी ते तडतडटात आनी सालीं काळसर जातात मेरेन सुमार 2 मिनटां भाजात.
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat oil; fry groundnuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. On medium flame start with the groundnuts and fry about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins become dark.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: चण्याची दाळ आनी उडदाची दाळ घालात आनी फिकट भांगरा रंगाची जायसर भाजात, सुमार 1 मिनीट.
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden coloured, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: सांसव घालात आनी तडतडूंक दियात, मागीर सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो, आलें आनी कडिपत्तो घालात आनी पानां कुरकुरीत जायसर थोडे सेकंद भाजात.
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard seeds and let them crackle, then add dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves become crispy.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: हळदीचो पिठो आनी हिंग घालून ढवळात; उजो बंद करात. फकत 5–10 सेकंद ढवळात म्हणजे हळद ऊन तेलांत शिजतली पूण करपची ना.
seg.6e856356980b.back: Add turmeric powder and asafoetida and stir; switch off the flame. Stir only 5–10 seconds so the turmeric will cook in the hot oil but will not burn.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: शितार ओतात, लिंबाचो रस घालात आनी हळूच मिसळात. बोटां वा सपाट उलथणें वापरात आनी शीत सकयल्यान उखलात म्हणजे दरेक कण पिवळो जातलो पूण लगदो जावचो ना.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add lemon juice and gently mix. Use fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain will become yellow but it will not become mush.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: रुच पळयात आनी गरज आसल्यार आनीक मीठ वा लिंबाचो रस घालात. शिताची रुच स्पश्टपणान आंबट आनी खारट लागूंक जाय, कारण दवरल्यार रुच सौम्य जाता.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and if needed add more salt or lemon juice. The rice's taste should feel clearly sour and salty, because if kept the taste becomes mild.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: वाडचे आदीं पुलिहोरा धांकून 15 मिनटां दवरात म्हणजे शिताक लिंबू आनी फोडणी लागतली.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving keep the pulihora covered 15 minutes so the lemon and tempering will soak into the rice.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: लिंबाचो रस उज्यावयल्यान काडून घालात म्हणजे ताची आंबटसाण तीख उरतली. शिजयिल्लो लिंबाचो रस कडू जाता.
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice off the flame so its sourness will stay sharp. Cooked lemon juice becomes bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: शीत थोडें घट्ट शिजयात आनी मिसळचे आदीं थंड जावंक दियात; ऊन, मोव शीत लगद्यासारकें जाता.
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice a little firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice becomes like mush.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: हळदीचो पिठो तेलांत फकत थोडे सेकंदूच दवरात; करपिल्ली हळद काळसर रंग आनी कडू रुच दिता.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: सकाळचें उरिल्लें शीत बरें चलता, कारण ताचे कण आदींच घट्ट आनी सुटसुटीत आसतात.
seg.747474140bbf.back: Morning's leftover rice works well, because its grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: काजू: परबेच्या पुलिहोराखातीर शेंगदाण्यां वांगडा 10 काजूचे अर्दे तळात.
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for a festival pulihora fry 10 cashew halves with the groundnuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: मामिडिकाया पुलिहोरा: लिंबाच्या रसा बदला फोडणे वांगडा 1 कप किसल्लें तोर मिसळात.
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: instead of lemon juice mix 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: किसल्लें नाल्ल: सौम्य शिताखातीर लिंबाच्या रसा वांगडा 2 व्हड चमचे किसल्लें नाल्ल घालात.
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for a mild rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: कुडाच्या तापमानाक दहीं, लोणचें वा पापड (अप्पडम) वांगडा वाडात. हें डब्याचें आनी प्रवासाचें नामनेचें शीत.
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or papad (appadam). This is the famous tiffin-box and journey rice.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: कुडाच्या तापमानाक तें सुमार 6 वरां बरें उरता, देखूनच तें प्रवासाक व्हरतात. उरिल्लें शीत धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी एका दिसा भितर खायात.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: At room temperature it keeps well about 6 hours, that is why it is taken for journeys. Keep leftover rice covered in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: म्हज्या लिंबाच्या शिताची रुच कडू कित्याक लागता?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: एक तर लिंबाचो रस शिजयलो, वा हळद तेलांत करपली. हळद घालचे आदीं चूल बंद करात, आनी लिंबाचो रस फकत शितांत घालात, उज्या भायर.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Either the lemon juice was cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before adding turmeric, and add the lemon juice only into the rice, off the flame.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: पुलिहोरा आनी लिंबाचें शीत हांचेमदीं कितें फरक आसा?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: पुलिहोरा म्हणजे आंबट केल्ल्या शिताचें तेलुगू नांव. चिंतपंडु पुलिहोरा चिंचेच्या वाटपान आंबट करतात; निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा लिंबाचो प्रकार, करपाक बेगीन आनी रंगान फिकट.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is made sour with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon kind, quick to make and light in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: लिंबाचें शीत लगदें जावचें न्हय म्हणून कितें करचें?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: What to do so lemon rice does not become mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: उणें उदक घालून शीत थोडें घट्ट शिजयात, ताटांत थंड करात, आनी दाबचे बदला सकयल्यान उखलून हळूच मिसळात.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice a little firm adding less water, cool on a plate, and mix gently lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: सुमार 3 व्हड चमचे, 2 मध्यम लिंबांचो रस. हळूहळू घालात आनी रुच पळयात, कारण दरेक लिंबाची आंबटसाण वेगळी आसता.
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and taste, because every lemon's sourness is different.

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. आंध्राचें लिंबाचें शीत: थंड शीत शेंगदाणे आनी दाळीची फोडणी, आमचो हळदीचो पिठो आनी लिंबाचो रस घालून मिसळिल्लें. पावलां-पावलांनी पद्धत, सुचोवण्यो आनी प्रस्न-जाप.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra's lemon rice: cold rice mixed with a groundnut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice added. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: पसुपु अन्नम म्हणजे सादें शीत, हळदीन चकचकीत पिवळें केल्लें आनी सांसव, चण्याची दाळ, कडिपत्तो आनी हिरव्यो मिरसांगो हांच्या तडतडटा फोडणेंत मिसळिल्लें, वयर तळिल्ले काजू. आंध्राचीं घरां तें दनपारच्या डब्याखातीर, सादारण दिसांच्या बेगीन जेवणाखातीर आनी पुजेच्या दिसांनी प्रसाद म्हूण करतात, चड करून सकाळच्या उरिल्ल्या शितान.
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam means plain rice, made bright yellow with turmeric and mixed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, fried cashews on top. Andhra's homes make it for the lunch box, for quick meals on ordinary days and as prasad on puja days, mostly with morning's leftover rice.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: आमचो दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो (कोंडा पसुपु) शिताक गाढो पिवळो रंग आनी मातयेसारको हळदीचो परमळ दिता, देखून 4 जाणांक अर्दो ल्हान चमचो पुरो. त्याच तेलांत तळिल्ले आखे काजू (जीडिपप्पु) कुरकुरीतपण दितात.
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric aroma, so for 4 people half a teaspoon is enough. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) fried in the same oil give crunchiness.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: एकूण वेळांत शीत थंड जावपाक सुमार 15 मिनटां धरल्यांत.
seg.38badedc8d11.back: In the total time about 15 minutes for the rice to cool are counted.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: शीत शिजयात आनी थंड जावंक दियात. काजू, सांसव, चण्याची दाळ, मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो तेलांत भाजात, दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो घालात आनी शीत मिसळात.
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 कप तांदूळ ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, सुमार 200 g; हातूंतल्यान सुमार 3 कप शीत जाता⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; from this about 3 cups of cooked rice are made⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ ल्हान चमचो दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.t: 1 व्हड चमचो तूप (जाय जाल्यार) ⟦1⟧निमाणें घालून ढवळिल्लें⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (if wanted) ⟦1⟧added and stirred at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: तांदूळ 2–3 फावटीं उदक बदलून धुयात आनी उदक निथळात.
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice changing the water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: शीत अशें शिजयात की कण सुटसुटीत उरतले, मागीर थंड जावपाक एका ताटांत पातळायात. आयदनांत वा प्रेशर कुकरांत (2 शिट्टयो) 1 कप तांदळाक 2 कप उदक वापरात, आनी पातळायचे आदीं काट्यान सुटें करात.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice such that the grains will stay separate, then spread on a plate to cool. In a vessel or pressure cooker (2 whistles) use 2 cups water for 1 cup rice, and loosen with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: शीत फकत कोमट उरता मेरेन सुमार 15 मिनटां थंड जावंक दियात. ताचेर मीठ शिंपडात.
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until it stays only lukewarm. Sprinkle salt on it.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: एका रुंद कढयेंत मध्यम उज्याचेर तेल तापयात.
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadai on medium flame.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: काजू तेलांत भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर तळात; काडात. सांसव आनी चण्याची दाळ घालात. काजू एका ताटांत दवरात; ते सुमार 1 मिनटांत भांगरा रंगाचे जातात.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in oil until golden coloured; take out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they become golden coloured in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: सांसव तडतडटकच, उडदाची दाळ आनी सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो घालात आनी ढवळात.
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: As soon as the mustard seeds crackle, add urad dal and dry red chillies and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: दाळ भांगरा रंगाची जातकच, मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो घालात, मागीर मंद उज्याचेर हळद. कडिपत्त्या वांगडा आलें आनी हिंग घालात, आनी हळद फकत 5–10 सेकंद ढवळात.
seg.2688182af66a.back: As soon as the dal becomes golden coloured, add chillies and curry leaves, then on low flame the turmeric. With the curry leaves add ginger and asafoetida, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: रोखडोच उजो बंद करात म्हणजे हळद करपची ना.
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Immediately switch off the flame so the turmeric will not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: शीत, काजू आनी मीठ घालात आनी सारकें पिवळें जायसर हळूच मिसळात. सपाट उलथणें वापरात आनी दाबचे बदला उखलून घोळात, म्हणजे कण आखे उरतले.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add the rice, cashews and salt and gently mix until evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and toss lifting instead of pressing, so the grains will stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: मिठाची रुच पळयात, वापरता जाल्यार तूप घालून ढवळात, धांकात आनी वाडचे आदीं 5 मिनटां दवरात म्हणजे शिताक फोडणी लागतली.
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste for salt, if using add ghee and stir, cover and keep 5 minutes before serving so the tempering will soak into the rice.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: पयलीं शीत थंड जावपाक पातळायात म्हणजे कण मोडचे नात.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: First spread the rice to cool so the grains will not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: हळद मंद उज्याचेर घालात आनी फकत थोडे सेकंद ढवळात; करपिल्ली हळद शीत कडू करता.
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add the turmeric on low flame and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो जोरान रंग दिता; 1 कप तांदळाक ½ ल्हान चमच्यान सुरवात करात आनी गाढो पिवळो जाय जाल्यारूच आनीक एक चिमूट घालात.
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives colour strongly; for 1 cup rice start with ½ teaspoon and only if you want deep yellow add one more pinch.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: सकाळचें उरिल्लें शीत बरें चलता, कण सुटसुटीत आसल्यार.
seg.505872469eb9.back: Morning's leftover rice works well, if the grains are separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: हळदीचो पिठो: आमचो दर दिसाचो पसुपु हळदीचो पिठोय तशेंच काम करता; तितलोच ½ ल्हान चमचो वापरात.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; use the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: शेंगदाणे: चड कुरकुरीतपणाखातीर काजू आदीं तेलांत 2 व्हड चमचे कच्चे शेंगदाणे तळात.
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnuts: for more crunchiness fry 2 tablespoons raw groundnuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: लिंबू: आंबट-चुरचुरीत, पुलिहोरासारक्या शिताखातीर शिता वांगडा अर्द्या लिंबाचो रस पिळात.
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for a sour-pungent, pulihora-like rice squeeze half a lemon's juice with the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: नाल्ल: शिता वांगडाच 2 व्हड चमचे किसल्लें नाल्ल घालून मिसळात.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: along with the rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut and mix.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: ऊन वा कुडाच्या तापमानाक दहीं, पापड (अप्पडालु) वा सुक्या बटाट्याच्या भाजे वांगडा वाडात. डब्याखातीर आनी प्रवासाखातीरय तें बरें भरूं येता.
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve hot or at room temperature with curd, papad (appadalu) or dry potato dish. For the tiffin box and for journeys it can also be packed well.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: त्याच दिसा खावप सगळ्यांत बरें. उरिल्लें शीत धांकून फ्रिजांत 1 दीस मेरेन दवरात आनी थोडें उदक शिंपडून ऊन करात.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Eating it the same day is best. Keep leftover rice covered in the fridge up to 1 day and heat sprinkling a little water.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: शीत कण सुटसुटीत उरतले अशें शिजयात आनी थंड जावंक दियात. काजू, सांसव, चण्याची दाळ, मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो तेलांत भाजात, मंद उज्याचेर थोड्या सेकंदांखातीर हळद घालात, मागीर मीठ घालून शीत मिसळात.
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low flame for a few seconds, then add salt and mix in the rice.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: हळदीच्या शितांत कितलो हळदीचो पिठो घालतात?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder is added in turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 कप तांदळाक (सुमार 3 कप शीत) सुमार ½ ल्हान चमचो. दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो जोरान रंग दिता, देखून उण्यान सुरवात करात आनी गरज आसल्यार आनीक एक चिमूट घालात.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: For 1 cup rice (about 3 cups cooked rice) about ½ teaspoon. Hill turmeric powder gives colour strongly, so start with less and if needed add one more pinch.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: म्हजें हळदीचें शीत कडू कित्याक लागता?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why does my turmeric rice taste bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: हळद ऊन तेलांत करपली, वा चड पडली. ती मंद उज्याचेर घालात, फकत थोडे सेकंद ढवळात आनी शीत घालचे आदीं उजो बंद करात.
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low flame, stir only a few seconds and switch off the flame before adding the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: हांव उरिल्ल्या शिताचें पसुपु अन्नम करूं येता?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can I make pasupu annam from leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: हय. सुटसुटीत कणांचें उरिल्लें शीत बरें चलता. फोडणेंत घोळचे आदीं बोटांनी गुठळ्यो मोडात.
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice of separate grains works well. Before tossing in the tempering break the lumps with fingers.

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: పసుపు అన్నం. पसुपु अन्नम, आंध्राचें हळदीचें शीत: शिजयिल्लें शीत सांसव, चण्याची दाळ आनी कडिपत्त्याच्या फोडणेंत, दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो आनी तळिल्ले काजू घालून मिसळिल्लें. 4 जाणांक.
seg.720281a9dc26.back: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra's turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed in a tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal and curry leaves, with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews added. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: पसुपु अन्नम: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ ल्हान चमचो दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: रागी जावा म्हणजे नाचणेचें पीठ उदकांत शिजोवन केल्ली पातळ, पियेवपाची पेज, जी आंध्र आनी रायलसीमाच्या जायत्या घरांनी दर दिसाचें पेय. खारट प्रकार ताक घालून करतात; हो गोड प्रकार दूद घालून पातळ करतात आनी गोड घालून गोड करतात, आनी न्याहारेक वा सांजेर स्टीलाच्या गिलासांतल्यान ऊन ऊन पियेतात.
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java means a thin, drinkable porridge made by cooking ragi flour in water, which is the everyday drink in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty kind is made with buttermilk added; this sweet kind is thinned with milk added and sweetened with jaggery added, and drunk hot hot from a steel glass at breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: आमचो ताटि बेल्लम ताडाचो गोड नाचणेच्या मातयेसारक्या रुचीक बरो जुळटा आनी जावाक टॉफीसारको तांबूस रंग दिता. सुरवाती सावन निमाणें मेरेन सुमार 15 मिनटां लागतात. ही रेसिपी 2 जाणांक आसा.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery matches well with ragi's earthy taste and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. From start to end it takes about 15 minutes. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: एकूण वेळांत गोड घालचे आदींचीं 2 मिनटां दवरप धरलां.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: In the total time keeping 2 minutes before adding jaggery is counted.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: नाचणेचें पीठ उदकांत घोळात, उकळटा उदकांत घट्ट आनी चकचकीत जायसर शिजयात, मागीर दूद घालात. उजो बंद करून ताडाचो गोड आनी वेलची घालून ढवळात.
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Mix the ragi flour in water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. Switch off the flame and add palm jaggery and cardamom and stir.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ कप नाचणेचें पीठ ⟦1⟧रागीचें पीठ, सुमार 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 कप उदक ⟦1⟧1 कप पीठ घोळपाक, 1 कप उकळपाक⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 व्हड चमचे किसल्लो ताडाचो गोड ⟦1⟧सुमार 30 g; चड गोड जाय जाल्यार आनीक एक चमचो⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; one more spoon if you want it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: नाचणेचें पीठ 1 कप उदकांत गुठळ्यो नासतना गुळगुळीत जायसर घुसळात. व्हिस्क वा काटो वापरात आनी खंयचीय गुठळी वाटयेच्या कुशीक दाबून मोडात.
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk the ragi flour in 1 cup water until smooth without lumps. Use a whisk or fork and break any lump by pressing it against the side of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: उरिल्लें 1 कप उदक एका जाड बुडाच्या आयदनांत ओतात आनी मध्यम उज्याचेर दवरात.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Pour the remaining 1 cup water into a heavy-bottomed vessel and keep on medium flame.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: दुसरो कप उदक उकळयात, नाचणेचें मिश्रण ओतात आनी मंद उज्याचेर घट्ट आनी चकचकीत जायसर ढवळात, 6–8 मिनटां. ओतचे आदीं मिश्रण परत एक फावट ढवळात, कारण पीठ वाटयेच्या बुडाक बसता.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the second cup of water, pour the ragi mixture and stir on low flame until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Before pouring stir the mixture once again, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: सारकें ढवळीत रावात. जावा फिकट गुलाबी-तपकिरी रंगा थावन काळसर, चकचकीत तपकिरी जाता आनी चमच्याच्या फाटल्या वटेक लागता तेन्ना ती शिजल्या.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring evenly. When the java turns from light pink-brown colour to a dark, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon, it is cooked.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: दूद घालात आनी 2 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर उकळूंक दियात. उजो बंद करात आनी 2 मिनटां दवरात. उकळटना एक-दोन फावटीं ढवळात म्हणजे बुडाक लागची ना.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add milk and let it simmer 2 minutes on low flame. Switch off the flame and keep 2 minutes. While simmering stir once or twice so it will not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: जावा दवरल्या तितले भितर ताडाचो गोड बारीक किसात, म्हणजे तो बेगीन वितळटलो.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java is kept, finely grate the palm jaggery, so it will melt quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: ताडाचो गोड आनी वेलची घालून ढवळात. ऊन वाडात. गोड पुरायपणान वितळटा मेरेन ढवळात, मागीर रुच पळयात आनी गरज आसल्यार थोडो आनीक घालात.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Add the palm jaggery and cardamom and stir. Serve hot. Stir until the jaggery fully melts, then taste and if needed add a little more.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: गिलासांनी वा वाटयांनी ओतात. पियेवपाक चड घट्ट आसल्यार, थोडे चमचे ऊन दूद घालून ढवळात.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into glasses or bowls. If too thick to drink, add a few spoons of hot milk and stir.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: नाचणेचें पीठ सदांच पयलीं उदकांत घोळात; थेट उकळटा उदकांत घातिल्ल्या पिठाच्यो गुठळ्यो जातात त्यो मोडनात.
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always first mix the ragi flour in water; flour added directly to boiling water forms lumps that do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: शिजोवपाक घाय करूं नाकात; उणी शिजिल्ली नाचणी कच्ची आनी पिठासारकी लागता.
seg.966098732312.back: Do not hurry the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: गिलासांतल्यान पियेवपाक पातळ जावाखातीर 2 व्हड चमचे नाचणेचें पीठ वापरात; चमच्यान खावपाच्या पेजेखातीर ⅓ कप वापरात.
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: For a thin java to drink from a glass use 2 tablespoons ragi flour; for a porridge to eat with a spoon use ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: सुक्या मेव्या वांगडा: निमाणें थोडे कापिल्ले काजू वा बदाम आनी एक चमचो किसमिस घालून ढवळात.
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dry fruits: at the end add a few cut cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins and stir.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: दुदा बगर: नाचणी 2½ कप उदकांत शिजयात आनी उकळप थांबल्या उपरांत गोड घालून ढवळात; पातळ, काळसर जावा जातली.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and after the boiling stops add jaggery and stir; it will be a thin, dark java.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: न्याहारेक स्टीलाच्या गिलासांत वा वाटयेंत ऊन वाडात, वा सांजेर थोडीं बिस्कुटां वा मुरुकुलु वांगडा पेय म्हूण. कांय जाणांक गिमांत ती थंड करून पियेवंक आवडटा.
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve hot at breakfast in a steel glass or bowl, or in the evening as a drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some people like to drink it cooled in summer.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: केल्ल्या दिसाच पियेवप सगळ्यांत बरें. उरिल्ली जावा धांकून फ्रिजांत 1 दीस मेरेन दवरात आनी परत ऊन करतना, उज्या भायर, थोडें ऊन दूद घालून ढवळात.
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Drinking it on the day it is made is best. Keep leftover java covered in the fridge up to 1 day and while reheating, off the flame, add a little hot milk and stir.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: गुठळ्यो नासतना रागी जावा कशी करची?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How to make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: पयलीं नाचणेचें पीठ कुडाच्या तापमानाच्या उदकांत गुळगुळीत जायसर घुसळात, मागीर सारकें ढवळीत हें मिश्रण उकळटा उदकांत ओतात.
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk the ragi flour in room-temperature water until smooth, then pour this mixture into boiling water while stirring evenly.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: रागी जावा शिजल्या हें म्हाका कशें कळटलें?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How will I know the ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: ती काळसर आनी चकचकीत जाता, चमच्याच्या फाटल्या वटेक लागता इतली घट्ट जाता, आनी तिची रुच पिठासारकी लागना. मंद उज्याचेर हाका सुमार 6–8 मिनटां लागतात.
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes dark and glossy, becomes thick enough to coat the back of the spoon, and its taste does not feel floury. On low flame this takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: हांव रागी जावांत ताडाचो गोड वापरूं येता?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: हय. ताडाचो गोड (ताटि बेल्लम) बारीक किसात आनी चूल बंद केल्या उपरांत घालून ढवळात, म्हणजे दूद फाटचें ना. ताका लागून गाढो रंग आनी थोडी धुंवरासारकी गोडसाण येता.
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Finely grate the palm jaggery (tati bellam) and add and stir after switching off the stove, so the milk will not split. Because of it a deep colour and a slightly smoke-like sweetness come.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: रागी जावा आनी रागी माल्ट हांचेमदीं कितें फरक आसा?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: हीं एकाच पेयाचीं वेगवेगळीं नांवां. रागी जावा हें तेलुगू नांव; रागी माल्ट हें नांव चड करून दुकानांनी आनी मेनूंत मेळटा.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: These are different names of the same drink. Ragi java is the Telugu name; the name ragi malt is mostly found in shops and on menus.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: రాగి జావ · गोड रागी जावाची रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: రాగి జావ · Sweet ragi java's recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: రాగి జావ. आंध्र पद्दतीची गोड रागी जावा: नाचणेचें पीठ उदकांत चकचकीत जायसर शिजयिल्लें, दुदान पातळ केल्लें आनी ताटि बेल्लम ताडाच्या गोडान गोड केल्लें. पद्धत आनी सुचोवण्यो.
seg.708e3c523d72.back: రాగి జావ. Andhra-style sweet ragi java: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with tati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: रागी जावा: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: इगुरु म्हणजे मास वा सुंगटां घट्ट कांद्याच्या मसाल्यांत जवळ जवळ सुकीं जायसर शिजोवपाची आंध्राची पद्दत, म्हणजे मसाले दरेक कुडक्याक चिकटटात. रोय्याला इगुरु दर्यादेगेच्या जिल्ह्यांतलें, नेल्लोर सावन गोदावरी आनी श्रीकाकुलम मेरेन, जंय खाड्यांतलीं आनी दर्यांतलीं सुंगटां आयतारच्या दनपारच्या जेवणाक शिता वांगडा खातात.
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru means Andhra's way of cooking meat or prawns in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices stick to every piece. Royyala iguru is from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where creek and sea prawns are eaten with rice for Sunday lunch.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: आमचो दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो (कोंडा पसुपु) पयलीं सुंगटांक लायतात आनी मागीर मसाल्यांत घालतात. तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो गाढो तांबडो रंग आनी दर्यादेगेच्या घरांक आवडटा ती जोरदार तिखटसाण दिता, देखून तुमच्या कुटुंबा प्रमाण तो उणो-चड करात.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) is first applied to the prawns and then added in the masala. Teja chilli powder gives a deep red colour and the strong heat that coastal homes like, so adjust it less-more as per your family.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: तयारेंत सुंगटां निवळ करप आनी हळद लावन 10 मिनटां दवरप धरलां.
seg.885826f68de3.back: In the preparation cleaning the prawns and keeping 10 minutes with turmeric applied are counted.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: सुंगटांक हळद आनी मीठ चोळात. कांदे आनी आलें-लसणीचें वाटप भाजात, तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी धण्यांचो पिठो घालात, मागीर मसालो सुंगटांक लागता मेरेन तीं मसाल्यांत शिजयात.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt on the prawns. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g सुंगटां ⟦1⟧मध्यम आकाराचीं, सालीं आनी काळो धागो काडिल्लीं, निवळ केल्या उपरांत मेजिल्लीं⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium sized, shells and black thread removed, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ ल्हान चमचो मीठ ⟦1⟧वांटून, वा रुची प्रमाण⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧divided, or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ ल्हान चमचो दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु; ¼ ल्हान चमचो सुंगटांखातीर, ¼ ल्हान चमचो मसाल्याखातीर⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ ल्हान चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧खूब तिखट; मध्यम तिखटसाणेखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो, सौम्य जाय जाल्यार ½ ल्हान चमचो वापरात⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, if you want mild ½ teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: सुंगटांचीं सालीं आनी काळो धागो काडात, बरीं धुयात आनी चाळणेंत उदक निथळात.
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the shells and black thread of the prawns, wash well and drain the water in a sieve.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: सुंगटांक अर्दी हळद आनी थोडें मीठ चोळात; 10 मिनटां बाजूक दवरात. ¼ ल्हान चमचो हळद आनी ¼ ल्हान चमचो मीठ वापरात.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt on the prawns; keep aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: एका जाड कढयेंत मध्यम उज्याचेर तेल तापयात आनी सांसव घालात. सांसव तडतडटकच, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्तो घालात.
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat oil in a heavy kadai on medium flame and add mustard seeds. As soon as the mustard seeds crackle, add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: कांदे तेलांत भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर भाजात, मागीर आलें-लसणीचें वाटप शिजिल्लो परमळ येता मेरेन. कांद्यांक सुमार 8–10 मिनटां लागतात; वाटपाक सुमार 1 मिनीट, कच्चो वास वता मेरेन.
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onions in the oil until golden coloured, then the ginger-garlic paste until a cooked aroma comes. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: टोमॅटो वापरता जाल्यार, आतां घालात आनी मोव आनी गरासारको जायसर शिजयात, सुमार 4 मिनटां.
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If using tomato, add now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: उजो मंद करात. उरिल्ली हळद, तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी धण्यांचो पिठो घालात; 1 मिनीट भाजात. उरिल्लें मीठ घालात आनी ढवळीत रावात म्हणजे मसाले बुडाक लागचे नात.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Lower the flame. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and keep stirring so the spices will not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: उदक ओतात आनी देगेक तेल वेगळें जावंक लागता मेरेन मसालो मध्यम उज्याचेर शिजयात, सुमार 3–4 मिनटां.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Pour water and cook the masala on medium flame until oil starts to separate at the sides, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: सुंगटां घालात आनी तीं वळटात आनी गुलाबी जातात मेरेन शिजयात, 5–6 मिनटां. निमाणें गरम मसालो घालात. मध्यम-व्हड उज्याचेर सारकें ढवळात म्हणजे मसालो सुकून सुंगटांक लागतलो.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until they curl and become pink, 5–6 minutes. At the end add garam masala. On medium-high flame stir evenly so the masala will dry and coat the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: शिजलां काय तें तपासात: सुंगटां भितरमेरेन गुलाबी आनी अपारदर्शक जातात आनी सैल C सारकीं वळटात तेन्ना तीं शिजल्यांत. खात्री नासल्यार, एक कापून उगडात; मदीं राखाडी, पारदर्शक भाग आसूं नज.
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check whether cooked: when the prawns become pink and opaque through to the inside and curl like a loose C, they are cooked. If not sure, cut one open; there must not be a grey, translucent part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: मिठाची रुच पळयात, कोंथिंबीर शिंपडात आनी उजो बंद करात. सुंगटां शिजल्या उपरांत आनीक शिजोवंक नाकात, नाजाल्यार तीं रबरासारकीं जातात.
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste for salt, sprinkle coriander leaves and switch off the flame. After the prawns are cooked do not cook them more, otherwise they become like rubber.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: तेजा खूब तिखट आसा: 1½ ल्हान चमच्यान दर्यादेगेच्या घरांक आवडटा तशें खूब तिखट इगुरु जाता; मध्यम तिखटसाणेखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो, वा सौम्यखातीर ½ ल्हान चमचो वापरात.
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: with 1½ teaspoons a very hot iguru is made as coastal homes like; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for mild ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: कांदे बरे भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर भाजात; इगुरुचो रंग आनी घट्टसाण बऱ्या तांबूस भाजिल्ल्या कांद्यांवयल्यानूच येता.
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onions until nicely golden coloured; the colour and thickness of the iguru come only from well browned fried onions.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: सुंगटां बेगीन शिजतात. सैल C आकार म्हणल्यार शिजल्यांत; घट्ट O म्हणल्यार चड शिजल्यांत आनी चाबपाक कठीण.
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A loose C shape means cooked; a tight O means overcooked and hard to chew.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: धुतल्या उपरांत सुंगटां थापटून सुकीं करात म्हणजे तीं उदकांत उकडचे बदला मसाल्यांत भाजतलीं.
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing pat the prawns dry so they will fry in the masala instead of boiling in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: थोड्या तेलांत सुकयिल्लीं आनी चेपिल्लीं ½ कप गोंगुराचीं पानां सुंगटां वांगडा घालून ढवळात.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: add ½ cup gongura leaves wilted and mashed in a little oil along with the prawns and stir.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: नाल्ल: मोव, दाट मसाल्याखातीर निमाण्या 2 मिनटांनी 2 व्हड चमचे किसल्लें नाल्ल वा 3 व्हड चमचे घट्ट नाल्लाचो रोस घालात.
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a soft, thick masala in the last 2 minutes add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: ग्रेव्हीवालें: शिताचेर ओतपाक पातळ रोय्याला कूराखातीर सुंगटां उपरांत ¾ कप उदक घालात.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: Gravy-style: for a thin royyala koora to pour over rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: ऊन वाफेच्या शिता आनी एक चमचो तूप वांगडा वाडात, वा रसम वा सांबार-शिता वांगडा. चपाती वांगडाय बरें लागता.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar-rice. Also tastes good with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: उरिल्लें धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 1 दिसा भितर खायात. आयदनांत हळूच ऊन करात; चड वेळ ऊन केल्यार सुंगटां घट्ट जातात.
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Gently heat in a vessel; if heated a long time the prawns become hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: सुंगटां शिजल्यांत हें म्हाका कशें कळटलें?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How will I know the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: तीं भितरमेरेन गुलाबी आनी अपारदर्शक जातात आनी सैल C आकारांत वळटात, चड करून ऊन मसाल्यांत 5–6 मिनटांनी. मदीं राखाडी, पारदर्शक भाग म्हणल्यार तांकां थोडो आनीक वेळ जाय.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and opaque through to the inside and curl into a loose C shape, mostly after 5–6 minutes in hot masala. A grey, translucent part in the middle means they need a little more time.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: इगुरु आनी वेपुडु हांचेमदीं कितें फरक आसा?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: इगुरु कांद्याच्या मसाल्यांत घट्ट आनी जवळ जवळ सुकें जायसर शिजयतात, आनी मसालो सुंगटांक चिकटून उरता. वेपुडु म्हणजे फ्राय, कांद्याची ग्रेव्ही उणी वा मुळींच नासतना, सुंगटांचे देगो कुरकुरीत जायसर शिजयतात.
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, and the masala stays stuck to the prawns. Vepudu means fry, with less or no onion gravy at all, the prawns are cooked until the edges become crispy.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: रोय्याला इगुरु उणें तिखट कशें करचें?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How to make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: मध्यम तिखटसाणेखातीर 1 ल्हान चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो वा सौम्यखातीर ½ ल्हान चमचो वापरात, आनी हिरव्यो मिरसांगो घालूं नाकात. निमाणें एक व्हड चमचो दहीं वा नाल्लाचो रोस घातल्यारूय तिखटसाण नरम जाता.
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: For medium heat use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or for mild ½ teaspoon, and do not add green chillies. Adding a tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: हय. तीं फ्रिजांत वितळूंक दियात, उदक बरें निथळात आनी हळद आनी मीठ चोळचे आदीं थापटून सुकीं करात. गोठयल्लीं सुंगटां चड उदक सोडटात, देखून मसालो थोडो आनीक शिजयात.
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Let them thaw in the fridge, drain the water well and pat dry before rubbing turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little more.

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. रोय्याला इगुरु, दर्यादेगेच्या आंध्राचें सुंगटांचें रोस्ट: दोंगरी हळदीचो पिठो आनी खूब तिखट तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून कांद्याच्या मसाल्यांत शिजयिल्लीं सुंगटां. 4 जाणांक.
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra's prawn roast: prawns cooked in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and very hot Teja chilli powder added. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: रोय्याला इगुरु: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: सुन्नुंडलु म्हणजे आंध्राचे उडदाच्या दाळीचे लाडू: सालां बगरची उडदाची दाळ बियांसारको परमळ येता मेरेन भाजतात, गोडा वांगडा बारीक वाटतात आनी ऊन तुपान एकठांय धरतात. पाक करचो पडना, देखून ते सुमार अर्द्या वरांत जातात. आंध्राचीं घरां संक्रांती आनी दिवाळेखातीर एक डबो भरतात, परदेशांत वचपी सोयऱ्यांखातीर भरून दितात, आनी सांजेर चा वांगडा गोड म्हूण दवरतात.
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu means Andhra's urad dal laddus: skinless urad dal is roasted until a nut-like aroma comes, ground fine with jaggery and held together with hot ghee. No syrup has to be made, so they are made in about half an hour. Andhra's homes fill a box for Sankranti and Diwali, pack and give for relatives going abroad, and keep as a sweet with tea in the evening.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: आमचो ताटि बेल्लम ताडाचो गोड सुन्नुंडलुक गाढो तांबूस रंग आनी भरभरीत, थोडी धुंवरासारकी गोडसाण दिता, जी भाजिल्ल्या दाळीक बरी जुळटा. ह्या रेसिपीन सुमार 15 लाडू जातात.
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoke-like sweetness, which matches well with the roasted dal. With this recipe about 15 laddus are made.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: एकूण वेळांत वाटचे आदीं भाजिल्ली दाळ थंड करपाचो वेळ धरला.
