seg.b1400f429b2f.back: In the total time the time to cool the roasted dal before grinding is counted.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: उडदाची दाळ भांगरा रंगाची जायसर भाजात, थंड करून बारीक वाटात, मागीर ताडाचो गोड आनी वेलची घालून वाटात. ऊन तूप घालून मिसळात आनी लाडू वळयात.
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast the urad dal until golden coloured, cool and grind fine, then grind with palm jaggery and cardamom added. Add hot ghee and mix and roll laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 कप धवी उडदाची दाळ ⟦1⟧फोडिल्ली, सालां बगर (मिनपप्पु), सुमार 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, without skins (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 कप किसल्लो ताडाचो गोड ⟦1⟧सुमार 180 g, हळूच दाबून भरिल्लो; पयलीं कुडके कुटात वा किसात⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly pressed and filled; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ कप तूप ⟦1⟧वितळायिल्लें आनी ऊन; आनीक 1–2 व्हड चमचे लागसार दवरात⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons more nearby⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: उडदाच्या दाळींतले ल्हान फातर वेंचून काडात. ती धुवंक नाकात; भाजपाखातीर ती सुकी उरूंक जाय.
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick out the small stones from the urad dal. Do not wash it; for roasting it should stay dry.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: दाळ एका जाड आयदनांत मंद उज्याचेर दवरात.
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Keep the dal in a heavy vessel on low flame.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: उडदाची दाळ मंद उज्याचेर तेल बगर भांगरा रंगाची आनी बियांसारको परमळ येता मेरेन भाजात, सुमार 10 मिनटां. सारकी ढवळीत रावात म्हणजे दरेक कणाक सारको रंग येतलो; तिका भाजिल्लो परमळ येवंक जाय आनी एक कण चाबल्यार कडकडीत मोडूंक जाय.
seg.65588a76c883.back: Roast the urad dal on low flame without oil until golden coloured and a nut-like aroma comes, about 10 minutes. Keep stirring evenly so every grain will get even colour; it should get a roasted aroma and if one grain is chewed it should break crisply.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: दाळ एका ताटांत ओतात आनी पातळायात. थंड करात, मागीर बारीक पिठो वाटात. ल्हान झटक्यांनी वाटात म्हणजे मिक्सर ऊन जावचो ना, आनी जाड कुडके चाळून परत वाटात.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Pour the dal onto a plate and spread. Cool, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer will not get hot, and sieve out the coarse pieces and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: ताडाचो गोड बारीक किसात, वा कुडके उखळांत कुटात, घट्ट गुठळ्यो मोडीत.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Finely grate the palm jaggery, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking the hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: मिक्सराच्या बरणेंत दाळीच्या पिठ्यांत गोड आनी वेलचीपिठो घालात. गोड आनी वेलची सारकी मिसळटा मेरेन वाटात. थोडे झटके पुरो; सगळें एका रुंद वाटयेंत ओतात.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixer jar add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind until the jaggery and cardamom mix evenly. A few bursts are enough; pour everything into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: एका ल्हान आयदनांत तूप ऊन जायसर वितळायात पूण धुंवर येवंक दिवचो न्हय.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: Melt the ghee in a small vessel until hot but smoke must not be allowed to come.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: ऊन तूप ओतात, बरें मिसळात आनी दाबून ल्हान लाडू वळयात. पयलीं चडशें तूप घालात, चमच्यान मिसळात, मागीर हात लावपासारकें थंड जातकच हातांनी मिसळात.
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Pour the hot ghee, mix well and press and roll small laddus. First add most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then as soon as it becomes cool enough to touch mix with hands.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: एक ल्हान मूठ घेयात आनी मुठींत घट्ट दाबात, मागीर तळहातां मदीं वाटकुळो वळयात. भुरभुरीत जाल्यार, वाटयेंत आनीक एक चमचो ऊन तूप घालून मिसळात.
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a small fistful and press tightly in the fist, then roll round between the palms. If crumbly, add one more spoon of hot ghee in the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: भरून दवरचे आदीं लाडू एका ताटांत 15–20 मिनटां घट्ट जावंक दियात.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before filling and storing let the laddus become firm on a plate 15–20 minutes.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: दाळ मंद उज्याचेर भाजात म्हणजे ती करपनासतना भितरमेरेन भाजतली.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low flame so it will roast through to the inside without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: दाळ पुरायपणान थंड जाल्या उपरांतूच वाटात; ऊन दाळ मिक्सरांत लगद्यासारकी जाता.
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after it has fully cooled; hot dal becomes like a paste in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: मिश्रण ऊन आसतनाच लाडू वळयात; तुपाच्या उबेन तें सगळ्यांत बरें एकठांय धरता.
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Roll the laddus while the mixture is still hot; with the ghee's warmth it binds together best.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: ताडाच्या गोडाच्या कुडक्यांची घट्टसाण वेगवेगळी आसता, देखून मिक्सरांत घालचे आदीं ते किसात वा ल्हान ल्हान कुटात.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: The hardness of palm jaggery pieces varies, so grate them or pound small small before putting in the mixer.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: उसाचो गोड: तितलोच किसल्लो उसाचो गोड वापरात; रंग फिकट आनी गोडसाण कॅरमेलसारकी जातली.
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery; the colour will be light and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: सालां सयत: चड काळसर, कणकणीत सुन्नुंडलुखातीर सालां सयतची काळी उडदाची दाळ वापरात, जशें कांय गांवचीं घरां करतात.
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skins: for darker, grainy sunnundalu use black urad dal with skins, as some village homes make.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: साकरे वांगडा: गोडा बदला ¾ कप पिठी साकर वापरात; फिकट, तोंडांत विरगळपी लाडू जातले.
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: instead of jaggery use ¾ cup powdered sugar; light, melt-in-the-mouth laddus will be made.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: सांजेर चा वा कॉफी वांगडा गोड म्हूण वाडात, वा संक्रांती आनी दिवाळेच्या गोडाच्या ताटांत.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet with tea or coffee in the evening, or in the sweet plate of Sankranti and Diwali.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: कुडाच्या तापमानाक हवाबंद स्टीलाच्या डब्यांत दवरात आनी 2 हप्त्यां भितर खायात. ऊन हवामानांत फ्रिजांत ते चड दीस उरतात; खावचे आदीं ते कुडाच्या तापमानाक येवंक दियात.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep at room temperature in an airtight steel box and eat within 2 weeks. In hot weather they keep more days in the fridge; before eating let them come to room temperature.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.t: म्हजे सुन्नुंडलु आपलो आकार कित्याक धरनात?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why do my sunnundalu not hold their shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: मिश्रणाक आनीक ऊन तूप जाय, वा तें थंड जालां. एक-दोन चमचे तूप ऊन करात, मिसळात आनी मिश्रण ऊन आसतनाच लाडू वळयात.
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has become cold. Heat one-two spoons of ghee, mix and roll the laddus while the mixture is hot.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: हांव ताडाच्या गोडान सुन्नुंडलु करूं येता?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: हय. ताडाचो गोड (ताटि बेल्लम) बारीक किसात वा कुटात आनी उसाच्या गोडा इतलोच वापरात. लाडू काळसर जातात आनी तांची रुच चड खोल आनी थोडी धुंवरासारकी लागता.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Finely grate or pound the palm jaggery (tati bellam) and use the same as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become darker and their taste feels deeper and a little smoke-like.

seg.946f64207639.back: How many days do sunnundalu keep?

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: कुडाच्या तापमानाक हवाबंद डब्यांत सुमार 2 हप्ते, आनी फ्रिजांत चड दीस. ते काडपाक सुको चमचो वा सुके हात वापरात.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: At room temperature in an airtight box about 2 weeks, and in the fridge more days. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: उडदाची दाळ सालां सयत वापरची काय सालां बगर?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should urad dal be used with skins or without skins?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: आंध्रांत दोनूय करतात. सालां बगरच्या धव्या उडदाच्या दाळीन गुळगुळीत, फिकट तांबूस लाडू जातात; सालां सयतच्या काळ्या उडदाच्या दाळीन काळसर, कणकणीत.
seg.b12320430e22.back: In Andhra both are made. With skinless white urad dal smooth, light brown laddus are made; with black urad dal with skins, darker, grainy.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: సున్నుండలు. आंध्राचे सुन्नुंडलु: भाजिल्ली उडदाची दाळ ताटि बेल्लम ताडाच्या गोडा वांगडा वाटून ऊन तुपान एकठांय धरून केल्ले लाडू. पावलां-पावलांनी पद्धत, सुचोवण्यो आनी प्रस्न-जाप.
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: సున్నుండలు. Andhra's sunnundalu: laddus made by grinding roasted urad dal with tati bellam palm jaggery and binding with hot ghee. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: सुन्नुंडलु: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी म्हणजे आंध्रांतल्या घरांच्या रांदपांतली दर दिसाची चटणी: पिकिल्ले टोमॅटो भाजिल्ल्या दाळीं वांगडा तेलांत विरगळटात मेरेन शिजयतात, मागीर मिरसांग, लसूण आनी थोडी चिंच घालून जाडसर वाटतात. जायतीं घरां अजूनय ती वाटपाच्या फातराचेर (रोटि) वाटतात, खरखरीत, चमच्यान खावपासारकी जावंक, जरी मिक्सरांत ल्हान झटक्यांनीय तें काम जाता. ती ऊन शीत आनी तूप, दोसो, इडली आनी पेसरट्टु वांगडा खातात.
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra home kitchens: ripe tomatoes are cooked in oil with roasted dals until they melt down, then chilli, garlic and a little tamarind are added and it is ground coarse. Many homes still grind it on the grinding stone (roti), to make it coarse and like something to eat with a spoon, though in a mixer with short pulses too the job gets done. It is eaten with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: आमचो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो तिका गाढो तांबडो रंग आनी थीर, मध्यम तिखटसाण दिता, आनी टोमॅटो वांगडा थोडो हळदीचो पिठो वता. ह्या रेसिपीन सुमार 1½ कप जाता.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes with the tomatoes. With this recipe about 1½ cups are made.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: एकूण वेळांत वाटचे आदीं टोमॅटो थंड जावपाक 5 मिनटां धरल्यांत.
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: In the total time 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding are counted.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: दाळी आनी मेथयो तेलांत भाजात, टोमॅटो हळद आनी मीठ घालून विरगळटात मेरेन शिजयात, मागीर सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो, लसूण आनी चिंच घालून जाडसर वाटात. निमाणें सांसव आनी कडिपत्त्याची फोडणी दियात.
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry the dals and fenugreek seeds in oil, cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt added until they melt, then coarsely grind with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind added. At the end give a tempering of mustard seeds and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 व्हड चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧शेंगदाण्याचें वा तिळाचें तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ ल्हान चमचो मेथयो ⟦1⟧मेथी; हाचेपरस चड न्हय, नाजाल्यार पच्चडी कडू जाता⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧methi; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 मध्यम टोमॅटो ⟦1⟧सुमार 500 g, पिकिल्ले आनी तांबडे, कापिल्ले⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, cut⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 ल्हान चमचे सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧चड तिखट पच्चडीखातीर 1 व्हड चमचो मेरेन⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧for a hotter pachadi up to 1 tablespoon⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: गोटी इतली चिंच ⟦1⟧सुमार 5 g, बियो काडिल्ली⟦/1⟧

seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.back: ¼ cup coriander leaves (if wanted) ⟦1⟧coarsely cut⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: एका कढयेंत मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर 2 व्हड चमचे तेल तापयात.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a kadai on medium-low flame.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: उडदाची दाळ, चण्याची दाळ आनी मेथयो तेलांत भांगरा रंगाच्यो जायसर भाजात; काडात. हाका 2–3 मिनटां लागतात; सारकें ढवळीत रावात, कारण मेथयो बेगीन करपून कडू जातात.
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek seeds in the oil until golden coloured; take out. This takes 2–3 minutes; keep stirring evenly, because fenugreek seeds quickly burn and become bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: त्याच तेलांत कापिल्ले टोमॅटो घालात आनी मध्यम उज्याचेर एक मिनीट ढवळात.
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add the cut tomatoes and stir on medium flame for a minute.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: टोमॅटो हळद आनी मीठ घालून मोव जायसर आनी रस आटता मेरेन शिजयात. पयलीं 5 मिनटां धांकात, मागीर मदीं मदीं ढवळीत धांपण नासतना शिजयात, सगळें मेळून सुमार 12–15 मिनटां, टोमॅटो गरासारके जातात आनी देगेक तेल दिसता मेरेन.
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt added until soft and until the juice dries up. First cover 5 minutes, then cook without a lid stirring in between, altogether about 12–15 minutes, until the tomatoes become pulpy and oil appears at the sides.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: उजो बंद करात, चिंच घालून ढवळात म्हणजे उबेन ती मोव जातली, आनी सगळें सुमार 5 मिनटां थंड जावंक दियात.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Switch off the flame, add the tamarind and stir so it will become soft with the warmth, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: वाटपाच्या फातराचेर वा मिक्सराच्या बरणेंत, पयलीं तळिल्ल्यो दाळी आनी मेथयो जाडसर पिठो वाटात.
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On the grinding stone or in the mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and fenugreek seeds to a coarse powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: दाळी, लसूण, चिंच, मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी टोमॅटो जाडसर वाटात. मिक्सरांत, दाळीच्या पिठ्यांत लसूण, मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी शिजयिल्ले टोमॅटो घालात आनी उदक बगर 4–5 फावटीं चलयात; अजून खरखरीतपण आसतनाच थांबात. वापरता जाल्यार कोंथिंबीर घालून ढवळात.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Coarsely grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes. In the mixer, add garlic, chilli powder and the cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it is still coarse. If using add coriander leaves and stir.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: रुच पळोवन सारकें करात: आनीक एक चिमूट मीठ, वा चड तिखट जाय जाल्यार थोडो आनीक मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून चलयात.
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and adjust: one more pinch of salt, or if you want it hotter add a little more chilli powder and pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: पच्चडी एका वाटयेंत काडात. एका ल्हान आयदनांत 1 व्हड चमचो तेल तापयात आनी सांसव घालात; ते तडतडटकच, उडदाची दाळ घालात आनी भांगरा रंगाची जायसर भाजात.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Take the pachadi out into a bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a small vessel and add mustard seeds; as soon as they crackle, add urad dal and fry until golden coloured.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: तांबड्यो मिरसांगो, हिंग आनी कडिपत्तो घालात आनी थोडे सेकंद ढवळात.
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: सांसव, तांबड्यो मिरसांगो आनी कडिपत्त्याची फोडणी करात; वयर ओतात. वाडचे पयलींच मिसळात.
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Make a tempering of mustard seeds, red chillies and curry leaves; pour on top. Mix just before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: टोमॅटो रस आटता मेरेन शिजयात म्हणजे पच्चडी चड दीस उरतली आनी कच्ची लागची ना.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook the tomatoes until the juice dries up so the pachadi will keep more days and will not taste raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: पिकिल्ले, गाढे तांबडे टोमॅटो सगळ्यांत बरो रंग दितात; तुमचे टोमॅटो आंबट आसल्यार, चिंच अर्दी करात.
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour, halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: थोडें थोडें चलयात, मिक्सर सारको चलोवंक नाकात: आंध्राच्या घरांक जाडसर पच्चडी आवडटा, आनी गुळगुळीत वाटपांत तो खरखरीतपण वता.
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Pulse little by little, do not run the mixer continuously: Andhra's homes like a coarse pachadi, and in a smooth paste that coarseness goes.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो मध्यम तिखटसाण दिता. 2 ल्हान चमच्यांनी सुरवात करात आनी रुच पळयल्या उपरांत आनीक घालात; पच्चडी दवरल्यार तिखटसाण थोडी देंवता.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and add more after tasting; if the pachadi is kept the heat comes down a little.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: हिरवी मिरसांग: मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्या बदला 4–5 हिरव्यो मिरसांगो वापरात, दाळीं वांगडा भाजिल्ल्यो.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder use 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: कांदो-टोमॅटो: टोमॅटो घालचे आदीं 1 कापिल्लो कांदो मोव जायसर भाजात.
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding tomatoes fry 1 cut onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: चड तिखट: 1 ल्हान चमचो सन्नमा बदला 1 ल्हान चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात; तेजा खूब तिखट आसा, देखून हळूहळू घालात.
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: instead of 1 teaspoon Sannam use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so add slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: लसणी बगर: लसूण घालूं नाकात आनी फोडणेंत आनीक एक चिमूट हिंग घालात.
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: do not add garlic and add one more pinch of asafoetida in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: एक चमचो ऊन शितांत थोडें तूप घालून मिसळात, वा दोसो, इडली, पेसरट्टु वा उपम्या वांगडा वाडात.
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix one spoon into hot rice with a little ghee added, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: एका निवळ, सुक्या काचेच्या बरणेंत फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 4 दिसां भितर खायात. सदांच सुको चमचो वापरात.
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How is Andhra's tomato pachadi made?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: उडदाची दाळ, चण्याची दाळ आनी मेथयो तेलांत भाजात, कापिल्ले टोमॅटो हळद आनी मीठ घालून रस आटता मेरेन शिजयात, मागीर सगळें मिरसांगेचो पिठो, लसूण आनी चिंच घालून जाडसर वाटात. निमाणें सांसव, तांबडी मिरसांग आनी कडिपत्त्याची फोडणी दियात.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek seeds in oil, cook cut tomatoes with turmeric and salt added until the juice dries up, then coarsely grind everything with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind added. At the end give a tempering of mustard seeds, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: म्हजी टोमाटो पच्चडी कडू कित्याक जाली?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why did my tomato pachadi become bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: चड करून मेथयो करपल्यो वा चड पडल्यो. 500 g टोमॅटोक फकत ¼ ल्हान चमचो वापरात आनी त्यो मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर भाजात, भांगरा रंगाच्यो जातकच काडात.
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Mostly the fenugreek seeds burnt or too much went in. For 500 g tomatoes use only ¼ teaspoon and fry them on medium-low flame, take out as soon as they become golden coloured.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: हांव चिंचे बगर टोमाटो पच्चडी करूं येता?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: हय, तुमचे टोमॅटो पुरो आंबट आसल्यार. शिजयल्या उपरांत रुच पळयात; पिकिल्ल्या, गोड टोमॅटोक तोल सांबाळपाक चिंचेचो तो ल्हान कुडको जाय.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need that small piece of tamarind to maintain balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How many days does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: एका निवळ, सुक्या बरणेंत फ्रिजांत सुमार 4 दीस, टोमॅटो बरे शिजयल्ले आसल्यार आनी तुमी सुको चमचो वापरल्यार.
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: In a clean, dry jar in the fridge about 4 days, if the tomatoes were cooked well and if you use a dry spoon.

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి. आंध्राची टोमाटो पच्चडी: हळदीचो पिठो घालून विरगळटात मेरेन शिजयिल्ले टोमॅटो, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो, लसूण आनी चिंच घालून जाडसर वाटिल्ले, मागीर फोडणी दिल्ली.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra's tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked with turmeric powder added until they melt, coarsely ground with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind added, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: टोमाटो पप्पु म्हणजे आंध्राच्या घरांतली दर दिसाची दाळ: तुरीची दाळ (कंदि पप्पु) टोमॅटो आनी हिरव्यो मिरसांगो घालून मोव शिजयतात, चेपून गुळगुळीत करतात आनी लसणीची फोडणी दिवन पुराय करतात. ती सप्तकांतल्या चडशा दिसांनी जाता आनी ऊन शीत, एक चमचो तूप आनी कुशीक पापड (अप्पडम) वा लोणच्या वांगडा खातात.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu means the everyday dal in Andhra's homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) is cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies added, mashed smooth and completed by giving a garlic tempering. It is made on most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and papad (appadam) or pickle on the side.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: आमचो हळदीचो पिठो दाळी वांगडा कुकरांत वता आनी तिका गाढो पिवळो रंग दिता. सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो तांबडी झांक आनी थीर, मध्यम तिखटसाण दिता, जी आंबट टोमॅटोच्या फाटल्यान उरता. ही रेसिपी 4 जाणांक आसा.
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder gives a red tinge and steady, medium heat, which stays behind the sour tomatoes. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: एकूण वेळांत कुकराची वाफ सुटपाचो वेळ धरला.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: In the total time the time for the cooker's steam to release is counted.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: तुरीची दाळ टोमॅटो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी हळदीचो पिठो घालून प्रेशर कुकरांत शिजयात, सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालून चेपात, आनी निमाणें लसूण आनी सांसवाची फोडणी दियात.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook the toor dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder added, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt added, and at the end give a tempering of garlic and mustard seeds.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ कप तुरीची दाळ ⟦1⟧कंदि पप्पु, सुमार 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ ल्हान चमचो हळदीचो पिठो ⟦1⟧कुकरांत वता⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes into the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 ल्हान चमचो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧चेपल्या उपरांत वता; चड तिखटसाणेखातीर 2 ल्हान चमचे मेरेन⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; for more heat up to 2 teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ कप उदक ⟦1⟧आनी सारकें करपाक आनीक ½ कप⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧and ½ cup more to adjust⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 व्हड चमचो चिंचेचें उदक (जाय जाल्यार) ⟦1⟧टोमॅटो खूब आंबट नासल्यार⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (if wanted) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: तुरीची दाळ 2–3 फावटीं उदक बदलून धुयात आनी उदक निथळात.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal changing the water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: दाळ टोमॅटो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो, कांदो आनी 2½ कप उदका वांगडा प्रेशर कुकरांत घालात.
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: दाळ टोमॅटो, हिरव्यो मिरसांगो आनी हळदीचो पिठो घालून प्रेशर कुकरांत 4 शिट्टयो काडून शिजयात. धांपण लायचे आदीं हळदीचो पिठो उदकांत ढवळात, मागीर मध्यम उज्याचेर शिजयात.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal in the pressure cooker with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder added taking 4 whistles. Before putting the lid stir the turmeric powder into the water, then cook on medium flame.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: प्रेशर आपसूक देंवूंक दियात, सुमार 10 मिनटां. एक कण दोन बोटां मदीं पुरायपणान चेपता तेन्ना दाळ शिजल्या.
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure come down by itself, about 10 minutes. When one grain mashes fully between two fingers the dal is cooked.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: बरी चेपात; मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालात. लांकडाचें घोटणें (पप्पु गुत्ति) वा डावाची फाटली वट वापरात आनी दाळ ऊन आसतनाच चेपात, टोमॅटो आनी दाळ एक गुळगुळीत मिश्रण जायसर.
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash the dal while it is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal become one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: थोडें उदक घालून 5 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर उकळूंक दियात. ओतपासारकी पातळ करपाक ½ कप मेरेन उदक घालात, आनी वापरता जाल्यार चिंचेचें उदक, आनी उजो मंद दवरात म्हणजे बुडाक लागची ना.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Add a little water and let it simmer 5 minutes on low flame. To make it thin enough to pour add up to ½ cup water, and if using the tamarind water, and keep the flame low so it will not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: मीठ आनी आंबटसाणेची रुच पळयात, मागीर कोंथिंबीर घालून ढवळात आनी उजो बंद करात.
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste for salt and sourness, then add coriander leaves, stir and switch off the flame.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: एका ल्हान आयदनांत मध्यम उज्याचेर तूप तापयात आनी सांसव घालात; तडतडूंक दियात.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: Heat ghee in a small vessel on medium flame and add mustard seeds; let them crackle.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: तुपांत सांसव, जिरें, लसूण आनी कडिपत्तो भाजात; वयर ओतात. सांसवा उपरांत जिरें, लसूण आनी सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो घालात आनी लसूण भांगरा रंगाचें जायसर भाजात, मागीर कडिपत्तो आनी हिंग घालात, आनी चुरचुरटी फोडणी दाळीचेर ओतात.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard seeds, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour on top. After the mustard seeds add cumin, garlic and dry red chillies and fry until the garlic becomes golden coloured, then add curry leaves and asafoetida, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: 2 मिनटां धांकात म्हणजे फोडणेची रुच दाळीक लागतली, मागीर ढवळात आनी ऊन वाडात.
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Cover 2 minutes so the tempering's taste will soak into the dal, then stir and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: गुळगुळीत पप्पुखातीर दाळ ऊन आसतनाच चेपात. थंड जाल्यार कण घट्ट जातात आनी गुठळ्यो उरतात.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For a smooth pappu mash the dal while it is hot. If it cools the grains become firm and lumps remain.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो मध्यम तिखट आसा. 1 ल्हान चमच्यान सुरवात करात; चड तिखट पप्पुखातीर 2 ल्हान चमचे मेरेन घालात.
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; for a hotter pappu add up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: पिकिल्ले, आंबट गांवटी टोमॅटो (नाटु टोमॅटो) सगळ्यांत बरी रुच दितात; सौम्य हायब्रीड टोमॅटो आसल्यार चिंचेचें उदक घालात.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best taste; if they are mild hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: कडिपत्तो घालचे आदीं फोडणेंत लसूण भांगरा रंगाचें जावंक दियात; फिकें लसूण कच्चें लागता.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Before adding curry leaves let the garlic become golden coloured in the tempering; pale garlic tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो: चड तिखट पप्पुखातीर सन्नमा बदला ½ ल्हान चमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात. तेजा खूब तिखट आसा, देखून 1 ल्हान चमच्यापरस चड घालूं नाकात.
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu use ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not add more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: पालकूरा टोमाटो पप्पु: चेपल्या उपरांत दाळींत 2 कप कापिल्लो पालक घालात आनी 5 मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात.
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomato pappu: after mashing add 2 cups cut spinach to the dal and cook 5 minutes on low flame.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: पेसरपप्पु: ही पिवळ्या मुगाच्या दाळीन करात आनी फकत 2 शिट्टयो काडात.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make this with yellow moong dal and take only 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: ऊन वाफेचें शीत, एक चमचो तूप आनी कुशीक पापड (अप्पडम) वा आवकाया (आंब्याचें लोणचें) वांगडा ऊन वाडात. चपाती वांगडाय बरी लागता.
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot with hot steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and papad (appadam) or avakaya (mango pickle) on the side. Also tastes good with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: उरिल्ली दाळ धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 दिसां भितर खायात. थंड जाल्यार दाळ घट्ट जाता; वाडचे आदीं थोडें ऊन उदक घालून बरी ऊन करात.
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Keep leftover dal covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. If it cools the dal becomes thick; before serving add a little hot water and heat well.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: प्रेशर कुकरांत तुरीच्या दाळीक कितल्यो शिट्टयो?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: मध्यम उज्याचेर सुमार 4 शिट्टयो, मागीर प्रेशर आपसूक देंवूंक दियात. पोरणी दाळ वा बरी धुवंक नाशिल्ली दाळ आसल्यार 5 लागूं येतात.
seg.562abdd39933.back: On medium flame about 4 whistles, then let the pressure come down by itself. If it is old dal or dal not washed well 5 may be needed.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: टोमाटो पप्पु आनी सांबार हांचेमदीं कितें फरक आसा?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: टोमाटो पप्पु म्हणजे सादी फोडणी आशिल्ली घट्ट, चेपिल्ली दाळ, सांबार पिठो वा भाजी नासतना. सांबार पातळ आसता, आनी तातूंत चिंच, भाजी आनी भाजिल्ल्या मसाल्याचो पिठो वता.
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu means a thick, mashed dal having a simple tempering, without sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thin, and in it tamarind, vegetables and roasted spice powder go.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: हांव प्रेशर कुकरा बगर टोमाटो पप्पु करूं येता?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: हय. दाळ 30 मिनटां भिजयात आनी धांकिल्ल्या आयदनांत 3½ कप उदका वांगडा सुमार 40–45 मिनटां शिजयात, मदीं मदीं ढवळीत, ती सहज चेपता मेरेन.
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered vessel with 3½ cups water about 40–45 minutes, stirring in between, until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: म्हजो टोमाटो पप्पु चड आंबट कित्याक जाला?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why did my tomato pappu become too sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: कांय टोमॅटो खूब आंबट आसतात. दाळ आनीक थोडीं मिनटां मंद उज्याचेर शिजयात आनी तोल सांबाळपाक एक चिमूट गोड वा आनीक एक चमचो चेपिल्ली दाळ घालून ढवळात.
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Cook the dal a few more minutes on low flame and to maintain balance add a pinch of jaggery or one more spoon of mashed dal and stir.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: టమాటో పప్పు · आंध्राच्या टोमॅटोच्या दाळीची रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra's tomato dal's recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: టమాటో పప్పు. आंध्राची टोमॅटोची दाळ: टोमॅटो आनी हिरव्यो मिरसांगो, आमची हळद आनी सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून मोव शिजयिल्ली तुरीची दाळ, आनी लसणीची फोडणी. 4 जाणांक.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra's tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder added, and a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: टोमाटो पप्पु: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम म्हणजे आंध्राच्या जेवणाच्या मेजार दवरतात तो लसूण-मिरसांगेचो पोडि: तांबड्या मिरसांगेचो पिठो खूब लसूण, भाजिल्ले धणे आनी जिरें, आनी मीठ घालून कुटटात. ऊन शिताच्या पयल्या घांसांत तूप घालून मिसळून, वा इडली आनी दोशाचेर थोडें तेल घालून शिंपडून, तो गडबडीच्या दिसांनी बेगीन जेवण आनी डब्यांतलो नेमाचो पदार्थ.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam means the garlic-chilli podi that is kept on Andhra's dining table: red chilli powder is pounded with lots of garlic, roasted coriander seeds and cumin, and salt added. Mixed with ghee added into the first mouthful of hot rice, or sprinkled on idli and dosa with a little oil added, it is the quick meal on busy days and a regular item in the tiffin box.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: आमचो तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो ताका गाढो तांबडो आनी खूब तिखट करता, जशें गुंटूरच्या घरांक आवडटा. उण्या तिखटसाणेखातीर, अर्दो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात.
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, as Guntur's homes like. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: एकूण वेळांत वाटचे आदीं बियो आनी लसूण थंड करपाचो वेळ धरला.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: In the total time the time to cool the seeds and garlic before grinding is counted.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: धणे आनी जिरें भाजात, वाटात, मागीर तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, मीठ आनी हळूच ऊन केल्लें लसूण घालून थोडें थोडें चलोवन जाडसर पोडि करात. तो ऊन शीत आनी तूप, इडली वा दोशा वांगडा खायात.
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin, grind, then add Teja chilli powder, salt and gently heated garlic and pulse little by little to make a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 लसणीच्यो पाकळ्यो ⟦1⟧सुमार ½ कप, सोलिल्ल्यो; भितरली पातळ साल उरूं येता⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can remain⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ कप तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो ⟦1⟧खूब तिखट; सौम्य करपाक सुचोवण्यो पळयात⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; to make mild see the tips⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 ल्हान गोटी इतली चिंच (जाय जाल्यार) ⟦1⟧सुकी, बियो काडिल्ली⟦/1⟧
seg.33ac26ca8201.back: 1 small marble-sized tamarind (if wanted) ⟦1⟧dry, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: तूप वा तेल ⟦1⟧दर वाटपाक 1 ल्हान चमचो⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon per serving⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: लसूण सोलात आनी पाकळ्यो कपड्यान पुरायपणान सुक्यो करात; खंयचेंय उदक पोडि उरपाचो वेळ उणो करता.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and make the cloves fully dry with a cloth; any water reduces the podi's keeping time.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: धणे आनी जिरें परमळ येता मेरेन तेल बगर भाजात; थंड जावंक दियात. मध्यम-मंद उज्याचेर ल्हान आयदन वापरात; हाका 1–2 मिनटां लागतात, आनी धणे एक छटा काळसर जावंक जाय, तपकिरी न्हय.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin without oil until aroma comes; let them cool. Use a small vessel on medium-low flame; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander seeds should become one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: लसूण 1 ल्हान चमचो तेलांत 2 मिनटां ऊन करात. उजो मंद दवरात आनी ढवळात; पाकळ्यो देगेक थोड्यो मोव जावंक जाय पूण तपकिरी न्हय. थंड जावंक दियात.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Heat the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil for 2 minutes. Keep the flame low and stir; the cloves should become a little soft at the edges but not brown. Let it cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: बियो पिठो जायसर वाटात, मागीर मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालून थोडें थोडें चलयात. वापरता जाल्यार चिंच बियां वांगडाच घालात, म्हणजे ती सारकी वाटतली.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds to a powder, then add chilli powder and salt and pulse little by little. If using add the tamarind together with the seeds, so it will grind evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: लसूण घालात आनी ल्हान ल्हान झटक्यांनी चलोवन जाडसर, ओलसर पिठो करात. दर 2–3 झटक्यां उपरांत थांबून बरणेच्यो कुशी खरवडात, कारण लसूण कुशींक चिकटता.
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and pulse in short short bursts to make a coarse, moist powder. After every 2–3 bursts stop and scrape the sides of the jar, because garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: फातराच्या उखळांत, पयलीं बियो कुटात, मागीर मीठ घालून लसूण, आनी निमाणें मिरसांगेचो पिठो मिसळात.
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar, first pound the seeds, then the garlic with salt added, and at the end mix in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: एक चिमूट थोडें शीत आनी तूप वांगडा चाखून पळयात, आनी गरज आसल्यार मीठ घालात.
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and if needed add salt.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: पोडि 10 मिनटां एका ताटांत पातळायात म्हणजे वाफ भायर सरतली, मागीर एका निवळ, सुक्या बरणेंत भरात.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Spread the podi on a plate 10 minutes so the steam will go out, then fill in a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: तेजा खूब तिखट आसा; सौम्य पोडिखातीर अर्दो सन्नम वापरात, वा तितल्याच लसणीक मिरसांगेचो पिठो उणो करून 3 व्हड चमचे करात.
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a mild podi use half Sannam, or for the same garlic reduce the chilli powder to 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: लसूण बरें सुकयात आनी तेलांत ऊन करात; ओलें लसूण पोडि बेगीन बिघडायता.
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and heat in oil; wet garlic spoils the podi quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: थोडें थोडें चलयात, मिक्सर सारको चलोवंक नाकात: चड वेळ चलयल्यार लसणीचें वाटप जाता.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Pulse little by little, do not run the mixer continuously: if run a long time the garlic becomes a paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: एक कप ऊन शितांत 1 ल्हान चमचो पोडि 1 ल्हान चमचो तुपा वांगडा मिसळात; रुची प्रमाण उणें-चड करात.
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 teaspoon podi with 1 teaspoon ghee into one cup of hot rice; adjust less-more as per taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: दाळीं वांगडा: बियांसारक्या रुचीच्या, थोड्या सौम्य पोडिखातीर बियां वांगडा 1 व्हड चमचो चण्याची दाळ आनी 1 व्हड चमचो उडदाची दाळ तेल बगर भाजात.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dals: for a nut-like-tasting, slightly mild podi dry-roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal without oil with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: कच्चें लसूण: चड तीख रुचीखातीर लसूण ऊन करूं नाकात, आनी एका हप्त्या भितर खायात.
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste do not heat the garlic, and eat within one week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: मध्यम तिखटसाण: 2 व्हड चमचे तेजा आनी 2 व्हड चमचे सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात.
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: use 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: ऊन शिताच्या पयल्या घांसांत तूप घालून मिसळात, वा इडली, दोसो वा पेसरट्टुचेर थोडें तेल वा तूप घालून शिंपडात.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix into the first mouthful of hot rice with ghee added, or sprinkle on idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee added.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: एका निवळ, सुक्या, हवाबंद बरणेंत कुडाच्या तापमानाक सुमार 2 हप्ते, वा फ्रिजांत एक म्हयनो दवरात. सदांच सुको चमचो वापरात.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge one month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: धणे आनी जिरें भाजात, वाटात, मिरसांगेचो पिठो आनी मीठ घालात, मागीर सोलिल्ल्यो लसणीच्यो पाकळ्यो घालून थोडें थोडें चलोवन जाडसर, ओलसर पिठो करात. आंध्राचीं घरां चड करून तो फातराच्या उखळांत कुटटात.
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin, grind, add chilli powder and salt, then add peeled garlic cloves and pulse little by little to make a coarse, moist powder. Andhra's homes mostly pound it in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: लसणीचो पोडि उणो तिखट कसो करचो?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How to make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: अर्द्या तेजा बदला अर्दो सन्नम मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात, वा सगळें मेळून 3 व्हड चमचे मिरसांगेचो पिठो वापरात. खूब तूप घालून खाल्यारूय तिखटसाण नरम जाता.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Instead of half the Teja use half Sannam chilli powder, or use 3 tablespoons chilli powder altogether. Eating it with lots of ghee added also softens the heat.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How many days does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: सुक्या, हवाबंद बरणेंत कुडाच्या तापमानाक सुमार 2 हप्ते, वा फ्रिजांत एक म्हयनो. लसूण बरें सुकयात आनी पयलीं तेलांत ऊन करात म्हणजे तो चड दीस उरतलो.
seg.a620f29950c0.back: In a dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge one month. Dry the garlic well and first heat it in oil so it will keep more days.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: हांव मिरसांगेच्या पिठ्या बदला आख्यो सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो वापरूं येता?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can I use whole dry red chillies instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: हय. सुमार 20 सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो तेलाचे थोडे थेंब घालून कुरकुरीत जायसर भाजात, थंड करात आनी लसूण घालचे आदीं वाटात.
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dry red chillies with a few drops of oil added until crispy, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. आंध्राचो लसूण-मिरसांगेचो पोडि: भाजिल्ले धणे आनी जिरें लसूण, मीठ आनी तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो घालून कुटिल्ले. ऊन शीत आनी तूप, वा इडली आनी दोशा वांगडा मिसळात.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra's garlic-chilli podi: roasted coriander seeds and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder added. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or with idli and dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: कोंबयेक दहीं, तेजा मिरसांगेचो पिठो, हळदीचो पिठो आनी मीठ चोळात. 30 मिनटां दवरात. आयदन धांकात आनी तें दवरिल्लें आसता तितलो वेळ फ्रिजांत दवरात.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt on the chicken. Keep it 30 minutes. Cover the vessel and for the time it is kept, keep it in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g नुस्त्याचे कुडके ⟦1⟧घट्ट मासाचें नुस्तें, जाड वाटकुळे कुडके कापिल्ले: रोहू, कतला (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (मरल) वा विसवण (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish, cut into thick round pieces: rohu, katla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g चिंच ⟦1⟧लिंबा इतले सुमार दोन गोळे, 2 कप कोमट उदकांत 15 मिनटां भिजयिल्ले⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups of lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: उरिल्लें धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 दिसां भितर खायात. आयदनांत हळूच, ढवळनासतना, भितरलेमेरेन पुराय वाफ येता इतलें ऊन जायमेरेन ऊन करात.
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat it in a pan slowly, without stirring, until it is hot enough that steam comes fully right to the inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: न्हंयचें वा दर्यांतलें घट्ट मासाचें नुस्तें, जाड कुडके कापिल्लें: रोहू, कतला (बोच्चा), मरल (कोरमीनु) वा विसवण. काट्यांचीं ल्हान नुस्तींय चलतात, पूण तीं हळूच हाताळूंक जाय.
seg.379b410c6994.back: Firm-fleshed river or sea fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu, katla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Small bony fish also work, but they must be handled gently.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: उरिल्लें हुमण धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 दिसां भितर खायात. पुलुसु आयदनांत थोडें उदक घालून, भितरलेमेरेन पुराय वाफ येता इतलें ऊन जायमेरेन ऊन करात.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftover curry, keep it in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan adding a little water, until it is hot enough that steam comes fully right to the inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: मटण वेपुडु: 500 g हाडां बगर मटण मुरोवपाचो मसालो आनी ½ कप उदक घालून प्रेशर कुकरांत 5–6 शिट्टयो काडून, मोव जायमेरेन शिजयात, मागीर तशेंच तळात.
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade masala and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles, until soft, then fry it the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: दोनूय चलतात. हाडां बगरची बेगीन शिजता आनी चड कुरकुरीत जाता; हाडां सयत ल्हान कुडक्यांक चड रुच आसता पूण तांकां आपल्या रसांत 6–8 मिनटां आनीक लागतात.
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but they need 6–8 minutes more in their own juices.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: डब्याखातीर वा ल्हान प्रवासाखातीर बांदून व्हरल्यार सुमार 4 वरां भितर खायात. उरिल्लें शीत धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी एका दिसा भितर खायात.
seg.d20a641bec03.back: If packed and taken for a tiffin box or a short journey, eat within about 4 hours. Cover the leftover rice, keep it in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: एक तर लिंबाचो रस शिजयलो, वा हळद तेलांत करपली. हळद सगळ्यांत निमाणी घालात, ते उपरांत रोखडीच चूल बंद करात आनी फकत 5–10 सेकंद ढवळात; लिंबाचो रस उज्या भायर शितांत घालात.
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last of all, after that immediately turn off the stove and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice off the fire.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: उरिल्लें एक कप उदक एका जाड बुडाच्या आयदनांत ओतात; पातळ आयदनांत रागी बुडाक लागता.
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the remaining one cup of water into a heavy-bottomed vessel; in a thin vessel the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: हांव रागी जावांत उसाचो गोड वापरूं येता?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can I use sugarcane jaggery in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: हय. तितलोच किसल्लो उसाचो गोड (चेरुकु बेल्लम) घेयात आनी चूल बंद केल्या उपरांत घालून ढवळात, म्हणजे दूद फाटचें ना. ताका लागून फिकट रंग आनी हलकी, कॅरमेलसारकी गोडसाण येता.
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and add and stir it in after turning off the stove, so the milk will not split. Because of it a pale colour and a light, caramel-like sweetness comes.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: उरिल्लें धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 1 दिसा भितर खायात. आयदनांत फकत भितरलेमेरेन पुराय वाफ येता इतलें ऊन जायमेरेनूच ऊन करात; चड वेळ ऊन केल्यार सुंगटां घट्ट जातात.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan only until it is hot enough that steam comes fully right to the inside; if heated a long time the prawns become hard.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: हांव उसाच्या गोडान सुन्नुंडलु करूं येता?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can I make sunnundalu with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: हय. उसाचो गोड (चेरुकु बेल्लम) बारीक किसात आनी ताडाच्या गोडा इतलोच वापरात. लाडवांचो रंग फिकट जाता, आनी गोडसाण हलकी, कॅरमेलसारकी लागता.
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Grate the sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as the palm jaggery. The laddus' colour becomes pale, and the sweetness feels light, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: कच्चें लसूण: चड तीख रुचीखातीर लसूण ऊन करूं नाकात; तें फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 3 दिसां भितर खायात.
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste do not heat the garlic; keep it in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: एका निवळ, सुक्या, हवाबंद बरणेंत फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी 2 हप्त्यां भितर वापरात. सदांच सुको चमचो वापरात.
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: सुक्या, हवाबंद बरणेंत फ्रिजांत 2 हप्ते मेरेन. लसूण बरें सुकयात आनी पयलीं तेलांत ऊन करात, आनी सदांच सुको चमचो वापरात.
seg.367798df40e3.back: Up to 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry, airtight jar. Dry the garlic well and first heat it in oil, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: हय. सुमार 20 सुक्यो तांबड्यो मिरसांगो तेलाच्या थोड्या थेंबांनी कुरकुरीत जायसर भाजात, थंड करात आनी लसूण घालचे आदीं वाटात.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dry red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool them and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet flattened rice with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु हें तेलुगू घरांतलें 10 मिनटांचें गोडशें. कृष्णाष्टमीक कृष्णाक दाखयतात ते हे फोव, कुचेलाच्या भेटयेची याद करून दिवपी; आनी शाळेंतल्यान आयल्या उपरांत भुरग्यांक बेगीन करपाचें गोडशेंय. फोव फकत धुवतात, उदकांत केन्नाच शिजयनात, आनी मागीर कोमट गोडाच्या पाकांत घोळयतात.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. This flattened rice is offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, in remembrance of Kuchela's gift; and also a quick sweet for children after school. The flattened rice is only washed, never cooked in water, and then mixed into lukewarm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: आमच्या ताटी बेल्लम ताडाच्या गोडाक लागून हाका गाढ तपकिरी रंग आनी भरपूर रुचीची, थोडी धुंवरासारकी झांक आशिल्ली गोडसाण येता. ही रेसिपी 2 जाणांक पुरता.
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Because of our Tati Bellam palm jaggery this gets a deep brown colour and a full-flavoured sweetness with a slight smoke-like hint. This recipe is enough for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: तयारेंत धुयिल्ले फोव मोव जावपाक लागपी 5 मिनटां धरल्यांत.
seg.25e28614accb.back: Prep includes 5 minutes for the washed flattened rice to soften.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: जाड फोव मोव करात, नाल्ल आनी वेलची वांगडा कोमट ताडाच्या गोडाच्या पाकांत घोळयात, आनी निमाणें तूप घालात.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Soften the thick flattened rice, mix into lukewarm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and add ghee at the end.

seg.04f65369bdaa.back: 1 cup thick flattened rice ⟦1⟧atukulu, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ कप किसल्लो ताडाचो गोड ⟦1⟧सुमार 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ कप किसल्लें नाल्ल ⟦1⟧फकत धवो भाग⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ ल्हान चमचो वेलचीपिठो ⟦1⟧वा 2–3 वेलच्यांचे कुटिल्ले बी⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ teaspoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.5f1854fd1277.t: 6–8 काजू, जाय जाल्यार ⟦1⟧तुपांत भांगरा रंगाचे तळिल्ले⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: फोव चाळणेंत घालात आनी तुसाचे कुडके आसल्यार वेंचून काडात.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the flattened rice in a sieve and pick out husk pieces, if any.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: फोव चाळणेंत व्हांवत्या उदकाखाला थोडे सेकंद धुवात, उदक निथळूं दियात, आनी मोव जावपाक 5 मिनटां दवरात. दाबल्यार ते मोव लागूंक जाय, पूण वले न्हय.
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Wash the flattened rice in the sieve under running water for a few seconds, let the water drain, and leave 5 minutes to soften. When pressed they should feel soft, but not wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: ताडाचो गोड बारीक किसात, घट्ट गुठळ्यो आसल्यार फोडात.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking hard lumps if any.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: ताडाचो गोड 2 व्हड चमचे उदका वांगडा मंद उज्याचेर वितळयात, मागीर गाळून घेयात. आयदन पुसात आनी पाक परत तातूंत ओतात.
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tablespoons of water on low flame, then strain. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: काजू घालतात जाल्यार, ते थोड्या तुपांत भांगरा रंगाचे जायसर तळात.
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If using cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: कोमट पाकांत फोव, नाल्ल आनी वेलची घालात आनी मंद उज्याचेर 1–2 मिनटां हळूच घोळयात, दरेक फोवाक पाक लागता मेरेन. हळू हातान करात, म्हणजे फोव मोडचे नात.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Add the flattened rice, coconut and cardamom to the lukewarm syrup and gently mix on low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated with syrup. Work with a light hand so the flakes do not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: फोवाक पाक लागलो कीं लगेच आयदन उज्यावयल्यान देंवयात; चड वेळ शिजयल्यार ते चिवट जातात.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the flakes are coated with syrup, take the pan off the flame immediately; cooking longer makes them chewy.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: तूप आनी काजू घालून सोंपयात. कोमट वा कुडाच्या तापमानाक वाडात.
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: Finish by adding ghee and cashews. Serve lukewarm or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: जाड फोव वापरात. पातळ फोव पाकांत लगदो जातात.
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick flattened rice. Thin flattened rice turns mushy in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: फोव वाटयेभर उदकांत भिजयनात; बेगीन धुवप पुरो, नाजाल्यार ते चड मोव आनी चिकट जातात.
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not soak the flattened rice in a bowlful of water; a quick wash is enough, otherwise it becomes too soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: फोव घालतना पाक कोमट दवरात, उकळटा तसो न्हय, म्हणजे फोवाक पाक सारको लागता.
seg.972f174730fe.back: Keep the syrup lukewarm, not boiling, when adding the flattened rice, so that every flake gets coated evenly with syrup.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: दुदा वांगडा: चड मोव गोडशाखातीर तयार फोवाचेर 2–3 व्हड चमचे कोमट दूद ओतात.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: for a softer sweet, pour 2–3 tablespoons of lukewarm milk over the finished flattened rice.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: तिळा वांगडा: नाल्ला वांगडाच 1 व्हड चमचो भाजिल्ले तीळ घालात.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 tablespoon of roasted sesame along with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: कृष्णाष्टमीक नैवेद्य म्हूण वाडात, वा शाळेंतल्यान आयल्या उपरांत भुरग्यांक बेगीन गोडशें म्हूण दियात.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or give to children after school as a quick sweet.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: केल्ल्या दिसाच खाल्ल्यार सगळ्यांत बरें. उरिल्लें धांकून फ्रिजांत दवरात आनी दुसऱ्या दिसा खायात; दवरल्यार फोव घट्ट जातात.
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Best eaten the same day it is made. Cover the leftover, keep in the fridge and eat the next day; when kept, the flattened rice becomes hard.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलुखातीर खंयचे फोव सगळ्यांत बरे?
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which flattened rice is best for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: जाड फोव (अटुकुलु). ते कोमट पाकांत आपलो आकार सांबाळटात; पातळ फोव लगदो जातात.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick flattened rice (atukulu). It keeps its shape in lukewarm syrup; thin flattened rice turns mushy.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: उसाच्या गोडान बेल्लम अटुकुलु करूं येता?
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can Bellam Atukulu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: हय. तितलोच किसल्लो उसाचो गोड (चेरुकु बेल्लम) वापरात. रंग उजळ जाता, आनी कॅरमेलसारकी गोडसाण येता.
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (Cheruku Bellam). The colour is lighter, and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: म्हजे बेल्लम अटुकुलु चिकट कित्याक जाले?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why did my Bellam Atukulu become sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: फोव भिजयल्ले वा चड वेळ शिजयल्ले. ते फकत थोडे सेकंद धुवात, आनी दरेक फोवाक पाक लागलो कीं लगेच आयदन उज्यावयल्यान देंवयात.
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The flattened rice was soaked or cooked too long. Wash it only a few seconds, and as soon as every flake is coated with syrup, take the pan off the flame immediately.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is this made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: कुचेलाची कथा हें याद करून दिता: ताणें आपल्या इश्टा कृष्णाक आपली एकूच भेट म्हूण मूठभर फोव हाडले.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of flattened rice to his friend Krishna as his only gift.

seg.5080241b3883.src: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra bellam atukulu: thick poha tossed in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and FAQs.
seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. आंध्राचे बेल्लम अटुकुलु: कोमट ताटी बेल्लम ताडाच्या गोडाच्या पाकांत नाल्ल, वेलची आनी तूप घालून घोळयिल्ले जाड फोव. 10 मिनटांचें गोडशें, सुचोवण्यो आनी सदांचे प्रस्न सयत.
seg.5080241b3883.back: Bellam Atukulu. Andhra Bellam Atukulu: thick flattened rice tossed in lukewarm Tati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee added. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and frequently asked questions.

seg.4239bed21420.src: Bellam Atukulu (Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.back: Bellam Atukulu (sweet flattened rice with palm jaggery) · 1acrefarms

seg.8dafb14d8ade.src: Bellam Atukulu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु: 1acrefarms चें रेसिपी कार्ड, साहित्य आनी पद्धती सयत
seg.8dafb14d8ade.back: Bellam Atukulu: 1acrefarms' recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu
seg.753ec27036d4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · कोब्बरी उंडलु · नारियल गुड़ के लड्डू

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: कोब्बरी उंडलु म्हणजे नाल्लाचे लाडू, जे आंध्राच्या घरांनी परबांक, नैवेद्याक आनी सदांच्या गोडशाखातीर करतात. तांकां फकत नाल्ल, गोड, वेलची आनी एक चमचो तूप जाय. गोड वितळावन गाळटात, तातूंत नाल्ल मंद उज्याचेर मिश्रण एकठांय येता मेरेन शिजयतात, आनी लाडू कोमट आसतनाच हातान वळयतात.
